scenarios.title: A cold load on Fast 4G with a slow CPU paints the viewer within its budget, on a phone and a tablet
scenarios.asserts: cache off, Chrome DevTools' Fast 4G (CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions) and a 4x CPU slowdown; Mapbox GL JS's files given a cold CDN fetch's time (three round trips and their gzip bytes at Fast 4G) -> the first contentful paint under 1,800 ms at 412x915 and at 800x1280
scenarios.notes: The Pixel Tablet, 2026-11-12: a cold first paint of 5,376 ms against 764 ms warm. DECISIONS-for-review.md §178. scripts/site/src/page.ts (Mapbox GL async), packages/engine/src/mount.ts (mapboxOf), packages/ui/src/map/mapbox-adapter.ts; e2e/specs/viewer/cold-load.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A slow Mapbox CDN does not hold back the first paint: the viewer paints before Mapbox GL JS has arrived
scenarios.asserts: the same profile with two more seconds on Mapbox GL JS -> at 412x915 and 800x1280 the first contentful paint comes before mapbox-gl.js has arrived (resource timing) and within the budget
scenarios.notes: Before the fix the engine, a module script, ran only after the deferred mapbox-gl.js (526 KB gzip): the first paint waited for it; then, with the CDN slow, the page's render-blocking mapbox-gl.css (2.9 s; the viewer links its own in the shadow root). Unit tests in packages/engine/test/mount-browser.test.ts, packages/ui/test/map/mapbox-adapter-pending.test.ts, scripts/site/test/page.test.ts.

scenarios.asserts: Layers panel slider of the fixture raster at 30 % -> pixel probe blends 30 % of the layer over the basemap while dragging, before release; slider aria-valuenow 30 and aria-valuetext 30 %; the live region announces the new opacity
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A finger dragged sideways along an opacity slider moves its value
scenarios.asserts: Chromium's own touch events (CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent) from the 100 % end to 30 % of the fixture raster's slider -> aria-valuenow 30
scenarios.notes: The Pixel Tablet, 2026-11-12. packages/ui/src/components/slider.ts (touchIntent, TOUCH_SLOP_PX); unit tests in packages/ui/test/components/slider.test.ts. e2e/specs/viewer/slider-touch.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A finger swiping up or down across an opacity slider leaves its value alone
scenarios.asserts: a 120 px downward and a 120 px upward touch swipe, 6 px slanted, starting on the track's left third -> aria-valuenow unchanged and the slider not focused (touch-action pan-y; the value moves only after 8 px more sideways than up or down; pointercancel ends the press)
scenarios.notes: The Pixel Tablet, 2026-11-12: a swipe meant to scroll the Layers panel set 1977 to 4 %. packages/ui/src/components/slider.ts; unit tests in packages/ui/test/components/slider.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The photos opacity slider fades the camera icons and the view cones together
scenarios.asserts: photos slider at 50 % -> pixel probes at a camera icon and inside a view cone show half the contrast against the basemap; other overlays unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A POI category slider fades only that category's icons, lines and fills
scenarios.asserts: Vanished buildings slider at 20 % -> the point icon and the block fill fade (pixel probes); the vanished street line of another category keeps its opacity
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Keyboard input past either end keeps the opacity within 0 to 100 %
scenarios.asserts: End then ArrowRight -> 100 %; Home then ArrowLeft -> 0 %, the overlay is invisible but stays listed and switched on; PageUp/PageDown move by 10; no console error
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Moving the slider of a hidden overlay does not show it
scenarios.asserts: overlay switched off, slider moved to 60 % -> nothing drawn (pixel probe); switching it on shows it at 60 %
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Overlay opacities survive a reload through the URL hash
scenarios.asserts: raster 40 %, photos 70 %, Vanished buildings 20 % -> the hash carries op=<layer>:40,photos:70,cladiri:20; after reload the pixel probes and the sliders show the same values; untouched overlays are not in the hash
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3; replaces S-V05-HAPPY-OVERLAY-HASH. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: Out-of-range overlay opacities in the hash are clamped
scenarios.asserts: #...&op=<layer>:150,photos:-20 -> layer drawn at 100 % and photos at 0 % (pixel probes, slider values); the hash is rewritten with the clamped values
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: Unknown or malformed overlay entries in the hash are ignored
scenarios.asserts: op=<unknown id>:50, op=cladiri:abc and op=photos:10:5 -> ignored; every overlay keeps its manifest opacity; the rewritten hash leaves them out
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3; replaces S-V05-BAD-UNKNOWN-OVERLAY. Contract: docs/ENGINE_API.md -> URL hash v1.

scenarios.title: POIs render in their category colours and open their details in the photo sheet
scenarios.asserts: fixture POIs drawn as an icon, a line and a filled block in the category colours (pixel probes), labels from zoom 16; clicking one opens the same sheet as photos with title, category, years, the Markdown description, links and the linked photo thumbnails, and a thumbnail opens that photo
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: The timeline filters POIs by their years
scenarios.asserts: today -> all four fixture POIs; a stop at 1890 -> the block (from 1900) disappears; a stop at 1990 -> only the event without years remains (pixel probes, map features)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: Markup in a POI description is shown as text
scenarios.asserts: the description containing an HTML bold tag shows the tag characters as text; no element is created from it; only https links are rendered, with rel noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A manifest with an invalid POI is refused with a localized error
scenarios.asserts: an unclosed polygon ring or a POI in an unknown category -> error card error.manifest.invalid with the issue path and validation.ringClosed / validation.reference in RO and EN; no blank map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A manifest without POIs shows no places and no error
scenarios.asserts: the Bucharest seed manifest (no pois, no poiCategories) -> no Places group in the Layers panel, no POI map layers, no console error
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: A category icon the engine does not bundle is drawn as the default pin
scenarios.asserts: category icon celebration -> its POI is drawn with the location_on pin; no missing-image warning from the map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. PLAN Addendum 3. Fixture: the POI set scripts/seed/e2e-pois.json in the e2e fixture manifest (docs/research/M1-interfaces.md §10).

scenarios.title: An icon font that arrives after the map settled still draws the POI glyphs
scenarios.asserts: the icon font request is held until the map is idle -> the POI shows its category disc without a glyph; once the font arrives the white glyph appears with no camera move or other interaction (pixel probes)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. Found by the M1 final-gate screenshots (1280x800 dark: two POIs without their glyphs): Map.updateImage does not repaint an idle Mapbox map, so ensureIcon (packages/engine/src/map/icons.ts) triggers the repaint.

scenarios.title: On the dark ground of a satellite photo a POI line stands out on its white casing
scenarios.asserts: pixel probes over a dark basemap: the line's category colour at its centre over the casing, and a light casing band three pixels to either side, far from the ground's colour
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 36).

scenarios.title: At 0 % opacity a POI line and its casing are both gone
scenarios.asserts: with the streets' opacity at 0 in the address, the line's centre and both sides of it show the basemap's ground only
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 36).

scenarios.title: A layer's stored image adjustments are applied on load
scenarios.asserts: a pixel probe on the layer is brighter and greyer than the raw tile colour, as its adjustments say
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-core CR-11: setLayerPaint with rasterAdjustmentPaint (packages/engine/src/map/rasters.ts).

scenarios.title: Crossed brightness bounds are refused, so the image is never drawn inverted
scenarios.asserts: a manifest whose brightness minimum is above its maximum is refused (error card naming layers[0].adjustments.brightnessMax and validation.value); no inverted image is drawn
scenarios.notes: Milestone M1. engine-core CR-11: rasterAdjustmentPaint of @hcm/shared clamps the admin's live sliders (unit-tested); that preview's e2e row joins the admin in M2.

scenarios.title: Bucharest at the root and a second city under its own path, each with its own manifest
scenarios.asserts: the built Pages tree: / boots Bucharest (hcm-ready cityId bucharest) and /e2e-second/ boots the second city (hcm-ready with its id and photos), one map per page; each page's config.js and CSP name only its own manifest

scenarios.title: Bucharest's old links keep opening at the root
scenarios.asserts: the legacy zoom/lat/lng/rotation hash and a v1 #photo= link at / open Bucharest's view and photo as they did before the multi-city layout
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.10; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/specs/viewer/multi-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A city whose manifest is not in the public bucket yet says so

scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.10; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/specs/viewer/multi-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The template's three files boot the example city from jsDelivr
scenarios.asserts: templates/starter-kit served as is: Mapbox GL JS from api.mapbox.com and the engine's IIFE and stylesheet from the pinned jsDelivr folder, each with the integrity release.json publishes (recorded by the mock CDN); hcm-ready with the example city's places and no photos; no other host is asked

Until a release pins the template (scripts/release/pin-kit.ts), the spec serves its page with the engine block pinned to the digests of what the mock CDN serves and says so in the annotation kit-pins.

scenarios.asserts: the mock CDN serves engine.iife.js with one byte changed -> the browser blocks it (the console's integrity error, claimed), no map, and the page keeps its bilingual note that the map could not load, asking to reload the page (the README's check only in an HTML comment); the note first says only that the map is loading, its troubleshooting delayed 4 s by the engine's stylesheet (revealed from outside in the test)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §3.2, §3.6; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/template.spec.ts. The note's layout and accessibility: the tour state kit.loading-note (e2e/tour/kit-states.ts, every tour project).

scenarios.title: Without city.json the page says the map was not found
scenarios.asserts: city.json answers 404 -> error.manifest.notFound with Retry; Retry once the file is served boots the map
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §3.6; owner: kit-cli). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/template.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The example's placeholder token tells the owner to add their own

scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.7; owner: export). Test: e2e/specs/starter-kit/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.notes: The owner's report of 2026-11-08. Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/map-labels.spec.ts, packages/engine/test/core/map-labels.test.ts, packages/shared/test/overlays/map-labels.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A custom basemap is sent no transit property
scenarios.asserts: a custom style without the basemap import -> no points of interest switch; setMapLabels({pois: false}) writes nothing (Mapbox GL reports no showTransitLabels) and fires nothing
scenarios.notes: The owner's report of 2026-11-08. Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/map-labels.spec.ts, packages/engine/test/core/map-labels.test.ts, packages/engine/test/core/map-specs.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Compare, Street names and POIs stay pinned at the top of the docked Layers pane
scenarios.asserts: Layers open in the docked pane with Compare and map-label switches -> they sit in .pinned above hcm-overlay-list; scrolling the list leaves them in place; in a modal sheet the strip scrolls with the list, so no focused switch hides under it
scenarios.notes: Owner 2026-11-10; docked pane only since 2026-11-12 (the tour's focus-obscured and target-size findings in the compact sheets). Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/layers-pinned.spec.ts, packages/ui/test/viewer/hcm-layer-panel.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Without Compare or map labels, Layers has no pinned strip
scenarios.asserts: no historical layers and a custom basemap with no map-label kinds -> no Compare, no map-labels group, no .pinned; the overlay list still lists photos and places
scenarios.notes: Owner 2026-11-10. Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/layers-pinned.spec.ts, packages/ui/test/viewer/hcm-layer-panel.test.ts.

scenarios.title: On a phone, a tablet or a short window the pinned strip scrolls with the list
scenarios.asserts: Layers at 360 x 800 (half-height bottom sheet) -> scrolling the list to its end moves Compare up with it; the last focused switch is the element under its own centre (no strip over it)
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-13, the tour's focus-obscured and target-size findings at phone sizes. Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/layers-pinned.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer in the project's own bucket shows its tiles over the basemap, read by range
scenarios.asserts: a pmtiles source -> the archive's colour on the map, its attribution, every read a Range, no Mapbox tileset or provider script asked for
scenarios.notes: M12 (docs/research/M12-own-tiles.md). Test: e2e/specs/viewer/own-tiles.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A tile the archive leaves out is no request and no error
scenarios.asserts: a view past the archive's tiles -> only the first read, the basemap, no toast
scenarios.notes: M12 (docs/research/M12-own-tiles.md). Test: e2e/specs/viewer/own-tiles.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A server that ignores Range fails the layer once and the map keeps working
scenarios.asserts: 200 with the whole file -> the layer named in a toast, the basemap still drawn, one read only
scenarios.notes: M12 (docs/research/M12-own-tiles.md). Test: e2e/specs/viewer/own-tiles.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer whose frame covers part of the view shows the frame there and the basemap beside it
scenarios.asserts: an archive with tiles only north-west of the city, a view across its northern edge -> the archive's colour 40 px inside the edge, the basemap 40 px outside it
scenarios.notes: the owner's screenshot of 2026-11-08 (1980's frame: square pictures of other places south of its edge, a black band along it); docs/LESSONS.md. Test: e2e/specs/viewer/partial-frame.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Past a frame, after a walk across it, the map shows the basemap and never an earlier tile of the layer
scenarios.asserts: eighteen views inside the frame at z15 and z16 (more tiles than Mapbox GL's cache keeps), then a view past it -> the basemap at four probes, no colour of the archive; the source answers a hole with one transparent 256 px picture, never null, and asks no read for it
scenarios.notes: the owner's screenshot of 2026-11-08 (1980's frame: square pictures of other places south of its edge, a black band along it); docs/LESSONS.md. Tests: e2e/specs/viewer/partial-frame.spec.ts, packages/ui/test/map/pmtiles-source.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Google's consent stand-in issues a token that the fake Google APIs honour
scenarios.asserts: a popup of /__oauth/authorize lists the owner preselected and the requested read-only Cloud scope ticked -> Allow posts idToken, accessToken, scope and expiresIn from the mock APIs' origin -> tokeninfo answers the owner, the e2e OAuth client and the granted scopes in the browser's world and in the shared one the Functions emulator reaches; the consent request is recorded as allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. Google's OAuth is the only part of Google stood in for in the browser (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §2.6; e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent tells the app and grants nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the stand-in page -> the opener receives a cancellation from the mock APIs' origin and no grant; the consent request is recorded as cancelled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin's stand-in client reads it, or a closed popup, as popup-closed-by-user (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The consent grants only the chosen account and the scopes left ticked
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen and one requested scope unticked -> tokeninfo of the issued token names that account and only the scopes left ticked; the request is recorded with them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The mechanism behind S-A27-BAD-SCOPE-DENIED and S-A27-BAD-WRONG-ACCOUNT (e2e/admin/harness/consent.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The admin server serves the e2e build as Hosting does, with the emulators in its CSP
scenarios.asserts: the page holds the admin shell; firebase.json's headers with the CSP minus upgrade-insecure-requests and plus the emulators' and mock APIs' origins in connect-src; a deep link gets the app; /__/firebase/init.json is the demo-hcm web configuration and /runtime.json the e2e runtime; the legacy bundle's 45 records, the originals and the kit's fonts are served
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. e2e/mock-apis/admin-server.ts over scripts/site/src/admin/hosting.ts, whose unit tests prove the CSP is the only header that differs (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A Google host that no fake answers stays blocked in the admin projects
scenarios.asserts: a fetch of a Firestore URL from the admin's origin fails in the page; the firewall records the URL and the console guard the blocked load
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The admin projects forward the fake upstreams' hosts only, so the admin never reaches real Firestore or any Google API without a fake (e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A persona's storage state is a Firebase Auth session the Auth emulator accepts
scenarios.asserts: with the admin persona, the admin origin's IndexedDB holds Firebase Auth's user record for that account, and the Auth emulator's accounts:lookup with its ID token answers the same uid and address
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The signed-in fixtures of the admin tier (owner, invited admin, editor, stranger) are storage states with IndexedDB (e2e/admin/support/session.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The seeded owner, invitation and admin are what admin.session answers
scenarios.asserts: with mapOwner owner, invited admin and admins editor: admin.session on the Functions emulator answers the owner as admin with role owner and the claim, the invited persona as not an admin with an invitation pending, the editor as admin with role admin and the claim, and the stranger as neither, with the map claimed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. The seeds of the admin tier (setup/owner, invites/{sha256 of the address}, admins/{uid} and the admin claim) match what the callables leave (e2e/admin/support/emulators.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Without a persona the admin opens signed out
scenarios.asserts: no persona -> no Firebase Auth user record in the admin origin's IndexedDB
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A hidden server is unreachable until it is shown again
scenarios.asserts: while hidden, a call of admin-session from the admin's origin fails like an unreachable host (the console line claimed); shown again, the anonymous call is refused 401 by the callable's access rule, which the console guard of the admin tier expects
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b. 'Not deployed yet' at the network edge for the bootstrap specs (e2e/admin/support/deployment.ts; e2e/admin/harness/world.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: The fake Cloud Run hands a pipeline run to the stand-in, which writes what the pipeline writes
scenarios.asserts: jobs:run of raster-pipeline -> the stand-in runner takes the lease, records each step, holds at the scripted step until released, then leaves the job and its version awaiting approval with the version's seven files, its automatic pairs (checkpoint RMSE 6.2 m) and its output (zooms 10-16); the job's scratch files are gone and the execution succeeded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: A scripted failure, a USGS maintenance, too few pairs and an out-of-memory kill end the run as the pipeline would
scenarios.asserts: a failure at warp -> the job and its version failed with apiError.imagery.unreadableRaster and the execution failed; USGS maintenance -> waiting_usgs (usgs-maintenance) with fetch pending; too few pairs -> awaiting_gcps and the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noMatch and its corner pairs; an out-of-memory kill -> the execution failed with exit 137 and the job left running for the tick
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: The admin's cancel reaches the run as SIGTERM; without a cancel the job goes back to the queue
scenarios.asserts: cancelRequested then the execution's cancel -> the held run stops, the job and its version are cancelled, the scratch files deleted, the execution cancelled; a cancel without cancelRequested (a task timeout) -> the job queued again with retryAt and its step pending
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: A tileset the fake MTS published serves its own colour to every page
scenarios.asserts: a source uploaded, a tileset created with the raster recipe and published in the server's world -> from an admin page its TileJSON answers zooms 10-16 and a tile is painted in the tileset's own colour
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: USGS, STAC, Overpass, OpenStreetMap tiles and Mapbox Satellite stay blocked for every admin page
scenarios.asserts: an admin page that loads a USGS browse image, M2M, the STAC catalogue or its COG, Overpass, an OpenStreetMap tile, the Mapbox Satellite style or a Mapbox Satellite tile -> blocked by the firewall, each address recorded; only servers reach their fakes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §13; owner: e2e-fakes). The imagery world of the admin tier, before the screens and the backend that use it: e2e/admin/harness/imagery.spec.ts over e2e/admin/support/imagery*.ts, e2e/mock-apis/imagery.ts and the M3 fakes of @hcm/test-support (functions/test/support/upstream-imagery.test.ts).

scenarios.title: The project owner claims the map with Google and reaches the dashboard
scenarios.asserts: verified Google account signs in through the consent stand-in (no Cloud scope) -> admin.session says unclaimed -> the claim panel naming the project -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent: cloud-platform.read-only) -> admin.claim on the Functions emulator: tokeninfo of the caller's own token, testIamPermissions grants resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy on the mock Resource Manager -> admins/{uid} role owner, setup/owner and the admin claim -> the Setup Assistant open at billing; at most 2 inputs and 2 consents; no e-mail address is configured or sent besides the ID token
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); M2b smoke of the admin tier, normal mode (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, §2.1, §3.3 d2; e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: A non-admin without an invitation is told and signed out
scenarios.asserts: a verified Google account signed in, the map already claimed, no invitation -> admin.session -> adminShell.auth.notAdmin in the page language with Use another Google account -> signed out: the sign-in button again; no admins document for the account
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the notAdmin state of docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §1.3, with the stranger's storage state (e2e/admin/specs/smoke.spec.ts).

scenarios.title: Closing the sign-in popup offers Retry
scenarios.asserts: popup closed (sign-in or the claim consent) -> nothing claimed, Retry offered
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A delayed claim is picked up by a token refresh
scenarios.asserts: admins/{uid} exists but the ID token has no admin claim yet -> admin.session answers refreshToken -> the app refreshes the token once and opens the dashboard
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot claim it
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing -> apiError.claim.notOwner naming the project id; no admins document, no claim
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An access token of another account or app is refused
scenarios.asserts: tokeninfo names another e-mail address or another OAuth client -> apiError.claim.tokenMismatch; Resource Manager is never called with it; the token appears in no log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A second owner claim is refused once the map has an owner
scenarios.asserts: an owner exists -> apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed for another account (the owner's own repeat claim succeeds unchanged); the first owner keeps the role
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An invited Google account joins as admin
scenarios.asserts: admins.invite stores invites/{sha256 of the lowercase address} and returns the admin link -> the invitee signs in with Google -> admin.session shows the pending invitation -> admin.join -> admins/{uid} role admin, admin claim, invitation deleted -> dashboard
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An invalid email is rejected
scenarios.asserts: invalid address -> the e-mail field refuses it (validation.format, aria-invalid) before any call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.invite refuses it too (inviteRequestSchema): functions tests.

scenarios.title: A revoked admin loses access
scenarios.asserts: Remove access on an admin's detail asks first, naming the admin -> admins.revoke -> admins/{uid} deleted, claim removed, sessions revoked -> listed no more; the revoked admin's Save in an open editor is refused by the rules and writes nothing, and the shell, asking admin.session again, says the access was removed (keeping the draft on screen until sign-out: S-A20-BAD-REVOKED-WHILE-EDITING)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/flows/revoke.spec.ts (two browsers: the owner removes the editing admin).

scenarios.title: The owner cannot be revoked
scenarios.asserts: the owner's detail offers no Remove access and says why: the map always keeps its owner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.revoke refuses the owner anyway (apiError.revoke.owner): functions tests.

scenarios.title: An admin cannot remove themselves, so the map always keeps an admin
scenarios.asserts: an admin's own detail offers no Remove access and says another admin can; with the owner never revocable the map always keeps at least one admin
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the page in M2c (owner: ops-screens). admins.revoke refuses oneself anyway (apiError.revoke.self): functions tests.

scenarios.title: An expired invitation cannot be used
scenarios.asserts: the clock passes expiresAt (14 days) -> admin.join answers apiError.invite.expired; no admins document; ops.tick deletes the invitation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/join.test.ts (admin.join refuses it) and functions/test/ops/accounts.test.ts (ops.tick deletes it).

scenarios.title: Signing in with an address that was not invited does not join
scenarios.asserts: the invitee signs in with another Google account -> admin.session finds no invitation for it -> the not-an-admin panel and sign-out; the invitation stays pending
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An invitation stores no e-mail address
scenarios.asserts: after admins.invite the invitation document holds role, invitedBy and its times only, and the address is in no Firestore document, response or log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/admin/invite.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An invitation is created, copied and cancelled
scenarios.asserts: Invite (a dialog, one Google account address) -> the invitation opens with its expiry and its link, already copied (Copy copies it again; three inputs, CONTENT_INPUT_BUDGETS.inviteAdmin) -> Cancel invitation (asked first) -> admins.revoke for the invitation -> it is gone
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Cancelling a revocation keeps the admin
scenarios.asserts: Remove access, then Keep access -> nothing called, the admin still an admin, the focus back on Remove access
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: The Setup Assistant shows every area with its status and can re-check it
scenarios.asserts: setup.status -> billing, provision, Mapbox, USGS, analytics and crash cards with their state chips and reasons; Re-check runs setup.selfTest and updates each chip; ready once billing, provision, Mapbox and USGS are ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A partial setup opens at the first incomplete step
scenarios.asserts: partial setup/status -> the page opens at the first area that is not ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A failing self-test check names what to fix
scenarios.asserts: the mock Secret Manager refuses access -> the secrets check is invalid with apiError.secrets.unavailable and a link to Provision cloud; every other check still runs and shows its own state
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42b) the page lists every self-test check with its state; e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts refuses the secrets in the mock Secret Manager and follows the check's link to Prepare the project.

scenarios.title: setup.status returns health fields only
scenarios.asserts: a setup/status document that also holds an unexpected field -> setup.status answers only the fields of setupStatusViewSchema (the stray field never leaves the function)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/setup/status.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A USGS role still pending is checked again six hours later
scenarios.asserts: setup/status usgs pending with nextCheckAt passed and permissions without download -> ops.tick keeps it pending with the reason apiError.usgs.accessPending, checkedAt now and nextCheckAt six hours later
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/services.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The server check proves that events reach the server
scenarios.asserts: Check again -> the events check writes the probe and ops.onProbe's answer comes back -> ok among the server checks
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (the Functions emulator delivers ops/probe to ops.onProbe; the probe sent back).

scenarios.title: Events that never arrive are named with the missing role
scenarios.asserts: no answer to the probe within its wait (clock) -> invalid with apiError.setup.eventsUnreached naming roles/run.invoker and Prepare the project
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by functions/test/setup/self-test.test.ts (the emulators skip IAM, so the refusal is the functions tier's: no delivery within EVENTS_PROBE_WAIT_MS).

scenarios.title: A consent note appears only where its button asks Google
scenarios.asserts: start-up mode, only the sign-in's read-only token -> the consent note beside Prepare the project; after its consent the server's card has no note while the token lives, and its functions' count shows at most once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.8, §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 7 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A partial install shows its count once and the note only when needed
scenarios.asserts: a third of the functions installed and only the sign-in's token -> one consent note on the server's card beside the button that will ask, the count at most once, no line said twice
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.8, §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 7 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: An admin newer than its server reads the server's own answers, and the steps it recorded stay Done
scenarios.asserts: the start-up admin of M6, a server from before M5 (61 functions, admin.session without cities and projectOwner), setup/status with Mapbox and USGS done -> the admin leaves start-up mode, Setup shows the claim, Mapbox and USGS Done, no step reads Update the server to check
scenarios.notes: Live test of 2026-10-31, finding 27 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/older-server.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A setup.status the admin cannot read says Update the server to check, never To do
scenarios.asserts: setup.status answers in a shape the admin does not know -> the page says the server is older than the admin (update it in step d); sign-in, server and claim are Done (it answered this admin); Mapbox and USGS read Update the server to check, never To do; step d stays open with its update even while (b) and (c) cannot be checked (2026-11-13: it waited for them, and the owner could never update)
scenarios.notes: Live test of 2026-10-31, finding 27 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Tests: e2e/admin/steps/older-server.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/setup/controller.test.ts; tour state setup.older-server-status.

scenarios.title: A failing optional check is said quietly and Setup stays done
scenarios.asserts: the AI check refused -> listed apart as Translation drafts are off with its reason and a neutral icon; the header still says Setup done
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1, §3.2; owner: setup-ux). Finding 20, 24 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: Right after a reload every step reads Checking… until the server answers, then its own state; the header never says 0 done
scenarios.asserts: a claimed map with billing, provisioning and Mapbox done, setup.status held back -> every chip reads Checking… with the loading indicator, the header says Checking every step… with no count, Check again is off, no chip reads To do -> setup.status answers -> the chips read Done, Done, Done and To do (USGS), the header counts the steps done, no chip keeps checking
scenarios.notes: Finding 32 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-10-31). Tests: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/setup/controller.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/setup/hcm-setup-page.test.ts, hcm-setup-step.test.ts; tour state admin.setup.loading.

scenarios.title: A server record that cannot be read ends Checking…: the page says why and no chip keeps checking
scenarios.asserts: setup.status held back, then answered 503 -> the page's alert says the service is unavailable, no chip reads Checking…, Check again is offered again
scenarios.notes: Finding 32 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-10-31). Test: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Billing and the budget are detected and recorded
scenarios.asserts: one open billing account -> one click (Link billing and create the budget) and one cloud-billing consent -> billingInfo linked (Blaze) and the budget created (5 in a USD account, its BUDGET_AMOUNTS equivalent in another currency) with 50, 90 and 100 percent and forecast thresholds -> card green; after the claim setup.recordCloud stores billing ok with the budget id
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6), refined in M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Billing not enabled shows the deep link and cost explainer
scenarios.asserts: no open billing account -> the explanation and the verified deep link to Google's billing page; the card lists the accounts every 10 s and links the new one by itself once the mock shows it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6), refined in M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: An API permission error shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: a 403 from a Google API -> apiError.cloud.permission or apiError.cloud.apiDisabled naming the role or service
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: Provision cloud creates what is missing and the doctor shows each item
scenarios.asserts: Prepare the project (one click, one cloud-platform consent) against the mock Google APIs -> every doctor item observed and created once in order (APIs, service accounts, roles, buckets, CORS, lifecycle, secrets, budget topic, workload identity with the numeric ids of infra/project.json, App Check, crash alerts, API key) -> a second run writes nothing; the scheduler item stays pending until the deploy
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6), refined in M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: An organisation policy that blocks public access is reported with its fix
scenarios.asserts: the organisation policy enforces storage.publicAccessPrevention -> the Storage buckets item is invalid and names the constraint (the public read is the part it refuses); the items that do not need the buckets are provisioned, those that do wait
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: Several open billing accounts are offered as a choice
scenarios.asserts: two open accounts -> a choice with the first preselected (one more input) -> the chosen account is linked and the budget created on it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A billing account at its project quota is explained
scenarios.asserts: linking refused with the billing quota error -> adminSetup.billing.quota; billing stays as it was; Retry
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: An existing budget of the app is updated, not duplicated
scenarios.asserts: a budget with the app's name exists -> it is patched to the spec; the mock still lists one budget
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A missing billing role for the budget names the role
scenarios.asserts: billing linked but budget creation answers 403 -> apiError.cloud.permission naming roles/billing.costsManager; billing stays linked; Retry creates only the budget
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A provisioning item that fails does not stop the others
scenarios.asserts: Secret Manager answers 503 -> the secrets item and the roles that need the secrets show unavailable, every other item ok -> Retry what failed (one click) touches only those items and turns them ok
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A Google token that expires during provisioning resumes with one consent
scenarios.asserts: the access token expires mid-run (clock) -> the run stops with the remaining items pending and Continue -> Continue (one click, one consent) finishes without repeating done items
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: With no billing account the card offers to create one and waits in plain words
scenarios.asserts: no open account -> a primary Create a billing account opening Google's create page in a new tab, the card saying it waits and continues by itself with the last check's time -> the new account is linked and the budget made with no click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 3 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/billing.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: While it waits for an account the card offers nothing to click but the create page
scenarios.asserts: waiting for a new account -> no Link button, the waiting state busy and named; after 30 minutes (clock) Check again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 3 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/billing.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A provisioning failure names the button on the card
scenarios.asserts: an item fails -> its message says to use Retry what failed, never to run Prepare the project, which the card does not show then
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 5 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A server check's disabled API names the Setup step to open
scenarios.asserts: a server check answers apiError.cloud.apiDisabled -> the message names the Prepare the project step with its link, in both languages
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 5 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/status.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: An API Google is still switching on is waited for, not failed
scenarios.asserts: the fake answers SERVICE_DISABLED for iam three times after enabling it -> the item says it waits for Google and retries on the clock -> 16 of 16 with no click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.5, §1.6; owner: server-bugs). Finding 4 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (the fake's scenario service-usage.propagation; the page's clock).

scenarios.title: An API still off after the wait asks for one retry
scenarios.asserts: SERVICE_DISABLED for about three minutes (clock) -> the item missing with apiError.cloud.apiPropagation naming the API and its dependants waiting -> Retry what failed (one input) finishes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: server-bugs). Finding 4 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (the fake's scenario service-usage.propagationSlow).

scenarios.title: Provision prepares the installer, the repository, the invoker role and the service agents
scenarios.asserts: Prepare the project -> hcm-installer@ with exactly the roles of the contract and the custom role hcmInstaller, the hcm repository, roles/run.invoker for fn-events@ and fn-admin@ on the project, the Eventarc and Pub/Sub service identities generated before the role table; a second run writes nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.6; owner: server-bugs). Finding 12, 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A refused service identity is named and the rest goes on
scenarios.asserts: generateServiceIdentity for eventarc answers 403 -> the roles item names the refusal with its role; the items that do not need it are provisioned
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: server-bugs). Finding 12 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (the fake's scenario service-usage.identityRefused).

scenarios.title: A record from before M6 retries every item, so the installer's account is made
scenarios.asserts: setup/status holds 15 items ok and Artifact Registry never reported (the live map) -> Retry what failed (one click, one consent) runs every item, not only the missing one -> 16 of 16, hcm-installer@ created with its roles
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6, the M6 reviews of 2026-10-30 (docs/research/M6-status.md §5): finding 2 of the min-input review. Test: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Prepare the project lets the installer act as the App Engine default account, on that account only
scenarios.asserts: Prepare the project on a project with <project>@appspot.gserviceaccount.com -> hcm-installer@ holds roles/iam.serviceAccountUser in that account's own policy and nowhere project-wide; the custom role hcmInstaller holds cloudfunctions.functions.setIamPolicy -> Install the server passes firebase-tools' actAs check and installs
scenarios.notes: Live test of 2026-10-31, finding 28 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (DECISIONS-for-review.md §75). Tests: e2e/admin/steps/install/server.spec.ts (with S-A55-HAPPY), packages/admin/test/provision/m6-items.test.ts, project-config.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A project without the App Engine default account has nothing to grant, and that is no failure
scenarios.asserts: the GET of <project>@appspot.gserviceaccount.com answers 404 -> the iam item is ok, its doctor ok, and no policy of that account is read or written
scenarios.notes: Live test of 2026-10-31, finding 28 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (DECISIONS-for-review.md §75). Test: packages/admin/test/provision/m6-items.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Prepare the project takes Editor away from the App Engine default account, and only that
scenarios.asserts: a new project whose policy gives roles/editor to the Compute Engine and App Engine default accounts -> Prepare the project -> the project's roles/editor no longer holds the App Engine account (since §75g nor the Compute Engine account, after its builder role), roles/owner and every other binding kept -> Re-check reads the permissions done and writes nothing; a project prepared before has the Editor role as all its permissions lack, with its reason, and Retry what failed removes it in one write; a concurrent change of the policy (409) is read again and removed
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §75b (the user's decision, 2026-10-31). Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (with S-A04-HAPPY-INSTALLER-ACCOUNT), packages/admin/test/provision/app-engine-editor.test.ts, packages/admin/test/google/iam-policy.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A refused removal of the App Engine account's Editor role fails the permissions' row with what it needs
scenarios.asserts: an IAM deny policy keeps the App Engine default account's roles/editor -> Prepare the project writes the role table, the removal's setIamPolicy answers 403 -> the permissions' row is failed and names roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin, Retry what failed is offered, the Editor binding and every other binding are unchanged -> Retry what failed tries the removal alone and fails the same way; without the App Engine account nothing is removed and the item is done
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §75b. Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/provision/app-engine-editor.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Prepare the project lets the installer act as the functions' build account, gives it the builder role, then takes its Editor role
scenarios.asserts: a new project with `<number>-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com`, Editor on the project -> Prepare the project -> in this order: hcm-installer@ holds roles/iam.serviceAccountUser in that account's own policy (never project-wide), the account holds roles/cloudbuild.builds.builder on the project, then roles/editor no longer holds it (one member of one binding) -> Re-check reads the permissions done and writes nothing; a project prepared before lacks only these, its row names the reason and Retry what failed adds them; without the account nothing is granted or removed
scenarios.notes: Live test of 2026-10-31, finding 33 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (DECISIONS-for-review.md §75g, the user's decision). Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts (with S-A04-HAPPY-INSTALLER-ACCOUNT), packages/admin/test/provision/compute-build-account.test.ts, project-config.test.ts, m6-items.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A refused removal of the build account's Editor role fails the permissions' row with what it needs, its builder role kept
scenarios.asserts: an IAM deny policy keeps the Compute Engine default account's roles/editor -> Prepare the project grants the installer's actAs on it and its roles/cloudbuild.builds.builder, then the removal's setIamPolicy answers 403 -> the permissions' row is failed and names roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin, Retry what failed is offered, the actAs and the builder role are in place and the Editor binding unchanged
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §75g. Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/provision/compute-build-account.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Check again without a Google token keeps step c as recorded and says when it was last checked
scenarios.asserts: a claimed map whose setup/status records step c done, no Google token in the tab -> Check again on step c opens Google's consent, the owner closes it -> the chip still reads Done, the card says Last checked <time>; sign in to Google Cloud to check again, the doctor never ran (no Service Usage call), setup/status still records step c done
scenarios.notes: Finding 34 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live 2026-11-01). Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/setup/provision.test.ts (also a 401 during the check: its rows unchanged, nothing of it recorded); tour state admin.setup.provision-last-checked.

scenarios.title: Check again with Google's permission records the items the doctor found missing, so step c follows the project
scenarios.asserts: setup/status records every item of step c done, the project has none of its services on -> Check again with one consent -> setup/status records step c missing with the services' item missing, the chip reads To do and the services' row To do (before: a missing item was never recorded and the record turned the chip back to Done)
scenarios.notes: Finding 34 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live 2026-11-01); the gap DECISIONS-for-review.md §75b noted. Tests: e2e/admin/steps/provision.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/setup/provision.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Update the map also applies the Provision items that changed since the project was prepared
scenarios.asserts: a project prepared before M7 (no item-set version recorded), every target installed -> Home's update tile; the server card names the settings the update applies (the pipeline's repository, the storage clean-up) -> one Update the map click and one consent run those two items, no build -> setup/status.provision.setVersion is the current version, the tile and the line are gone
scenarios.notes: Finding 65 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-02. Test: e2e/admin/steps/install/update.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A run that did not bring every changed item to ok records no version
scenarios.asserts: setup.recordCloud with the items but no setVersion (an item of the update failed) -> no version recorded, so the next update runs the changed items again; a later partial report keeps a version already recorded
scenarios.notes: Finding 65 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-02. Test: functions/test/setup/record-cloud.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A Mapbox account with a card on file shows green
scenarios.asserts: an account out of the demo plan: the pasted secret token is saved at once (one input, no Save click) and mints the public tokens (proof of a card on file) -> the plan step is green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A trial or demo account leads to the payment step
scenarios.asserts: a demo account: Mapbox refuses to create tokens (mock 403 on POST tokens) -> apiError.mapbox.mintRefused with the link to add a payment method; nothing stored in the city; after the owner adds a card on Mapbox's page the same token pasted again turns the card green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A missing billing address shows a message
scenarios.asserts: an account blocked on 'confirm billing information' (mock 422 on token creation) -> apiError.mapbox.mintRefused and the billing link; the secret token is not kept
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: Every deep link's label says what its page does
scenarios.asserts: the Mapbox card -> each link's text names its page's purpose from links.json; the console link reads Open the Mapbox console, the payment advice in its hint
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 15 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/mapbox.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A hint for another page sits beside its link, not in it
scenarios.asserts: the Mapbox card -> the Rotate token advice is a hint line next to the console link and no link text holds a parenthesis
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 15 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/mapbox.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A valid secret token is saved and public tokens are auto-minted within the input budget
scenarios.asserts: valid sk -> TokenValid (sk, user) -> its scopes listed -> secret stored, tiles token minted, the viewer token (the site origin) and the admin token (web.app, firebaseapp.com) minted URL-restricted -> city mapbox.publicToken written, manifest queued -> green; input budget at most 2; the secret appears in no response, document or log line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Missing scopes are listed with a pre-filled link
scenarios.asserts: missing scopes -> apiError.mapbox.missingScopes listing them by name, plus the token page link; nothing stored
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A pasted public token is explained
scenarios.asserts: pk pasted -> apiError.mapbox.publicToken explained in the page before any call (classifyMapboxToken)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A revoked token is reported
scenarios.asserts: revoked token (401) -> apiError.mapbox.tokenInvalid; Mapbox chip invalid
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A Mapbox server error offers retry
scenarios.asserts: Mapbox 5xx -> apiError.mapbox.unavailable and the chip unavailable; nothing half-saved; once Mapbox answers, the same token saved again connects it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: Rotating the viewer token publishes the new one and retires the old
scenarios.asserts: Replace the visitors' token in the Mapbox card, confirmed -> setup.rotatePublicToken -> a new URL-restricted token in the city and the card says when the old one goes; ops.tick deletes the old token 10 minutes later (functions/test/ops/tick.test.ts with the clock, functions/test/setup/rotate-public-token.test.ts)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Since 2026-10-18 (§42b) the Mapbox card has the control: e2e/admin/steps/mapbox.spec.ts; the ten-minute retirement is a clock test of the functions, not of the browser.

scenarios.title: Saving the token again updates the minted tokens instead of adding more
scenarios.asserts: a second setup.saveMapbox -> the existing viewer, admin and tiles token ids are updated; the mock lists as many tokens as before
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/setup/save-mapbox.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A replaced public token is deleted once its retirement time passes
scenarios.asserts: setup/status mapbox retiring entries past retireAt -> ops.tick deletes those tokens at Mapbox and removes them from the list; entries not yet due stay
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/ops/services.test.ts (the functions half of S-A06-HAPPY-ROTATE).

scenarios.title: The viewer's token follows the server's viewer origins without an input
scenarios.asserts: a city whose viewer token allows only the GitHub Pages origin and a server whose viewer origins are the Hosting ones -> the tokens step of ops.tick mints a token for them, retires the old one after 10 minutes and the manifest republishes with it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.6; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/ops/viewer-tokens.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A refused re-mint keeps the old token and says why
scenarios.asserts: Mapbox refuses the mint (demo account) -> the old token stays in the manifest and setup/status.mapbox names apiError.mapbox.mintRefused
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.6; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/ops/viewer-tokens.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Viewer origins a city cannot record are refused before any token is minted
scenarios.asserts: HCM_VIEWER_ORIGINS with a trailing slash, a path, plain http or eleven origins -> runtimeConfig throws and functions/build.mjs uses the same pattern as httpsOriginSchema, so no deploy carries them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6, the M6 reviews of 2026-10-30 (docs/research/M6-status.md §5): finding 3 of the security-cost review. Tests: functions/test/deps.test.ts, functions/test/deploy-env.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A minted viewer token the city cannot hold is deleted at once
scenarios.asserts: the city write after a re-mint fails -> the new token is deleted at Mapbox, the old one stays in the city, the step fails; a failed deletion is logged and the write's failure goes on
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6, the M6 reviews of 2026-10-30 (docs/research/M6-status.md §5): finding 3 of the security-cost review (one orphaned live token per tick before). Test: functions/test/ops/viewer-tokens.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A valid token with an approved role shows green
scenarios.asserts: login-token ok and permissions include download -> username and token in Secret Manager only, logout called -> green with the download role
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An HTML 403 means a bad token
scenarios.asserts: HTML 403 from login-token -> apiError.usgs.credentials; nothing stored
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A pending role auto-polls and flips green on approval
scenarios.asserts: permissions without download -> pending, apiError.usgs.accessPending with the next check; USGS approves on the mock, the check comes due (the server's clock cannot move, so setup/status.usgs.nextCheckAt does) and ops.tick, run by the e2e world, records the download role -> after a reload the card is green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance shows a banner
scenarios.asserts: HTML 503 Application Offline -> apiError.usgs.maintenance banner; the chip is unavailable and ops.tick retries
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A USGS token close to its expiry shows a reminder
scenarios.asserts: saved with an expiry 10 days ahead (clock) -> the USGS card shows the date and the link to create a new token
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: The USGS paste box opens before the token page, with a 60-second countdown
scenarios.asserts: Open the USGS token page -> the paste box is open and focused before the ERS tab opens and a 60 s countdown runs -> pasting with the username filled saves at once (no Save click); input budget 3
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A countdown that ends with nothing pasted asks for a new token
scenarios.asserts: 60 s pass (clock) with nothing pasted -> adminSetup.usgs.expired; the box stays open and the button starts again; nothing sent
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A multi-file drop creates prefilled photos ready to publish in three inputs
scenarios.asserts: three JPEGs dropped -> three unpublished photo documents with the sticky author, source and licence and the last pin as location, uploads with progress -> after photos.onUpload each shows its thumbnail and its EXIF location, year and bearing applied (none moved by hand) -> Select all, Publish -> all three published; inputBudget 3 inputs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: A photo without EXIF stays at the last pin until its place is confirmed
scenarios.asserts: no EXIF position -> the photo keeps the last pin, marked Check the place, and bulk Publish skips it with that reason; one drag of the pin, or Confirm place, makes it publishable
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: However many photos wait for their place, none loses its mark
scenarios.asserts: a browser holding more than 500 marks, the oldest first -> the oldest photo still shows Check the place and bulk Publish still skips it: a mark forgotten would lift its publish block
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/photos/upload.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/photos/session.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Confirming a place lifts that photo's mark alone
scenarios.asserts: among hundreds of marks, Confirm place on one -> its chip goes, the others stay, also after a reload
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/photos/upload.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A duplicate photo is flagged with the photo it repeats
scenarios.asserts: the same file as an existing photo -> the item shows apiError.photo.duplicate with a link to that photo and a Delete action; nothing public is written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: HEIC or PDF uploads show an actionable error
scenarios.asserts: an HEIC file -> apiError.photo.heicUnsupported (how to export a JPEG); a PDF renamed .jpg -> apiError.photo.unsupportedType; both decided by the server's sniffing and shown on the item as text; Delete removes the draft
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: An oversized upload is refused in the page before it starts
scenarios.asserts: a file over 60 MiB (the Storage rules' limit, PHOTO_LIMITS.maxUploadBytes) -> refused before any upload with the limit named; no document created
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: An upload becomes a private original, two public WebP files and suggestions
scenarios.asserts: a JPEG uploaded under its photo document -> processing done, the original under originals/, web and thumb WebP without metadata in the public bucket, EXIF position, direction and date as suggestions, the upload deleted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The original is decoded once; the thumbnail comes upright from the web derivative
scenarios.asserts: a 3000 x 1000 JPEG with EXIF orientation 6 -> the processor is given the original once (web, 683 x 2048) and the web WebP for the thumbnail (133 x 400, upright); photos.onUpload deploys at 1 GiB
scenarios.notes: Resource audit item 10 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §4.6; 200 MP measured at 321 MB peak; track/optcloud, 2026-11-12). Tests: functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts, on-upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An original that does not decode makes no thumbnail attempt
scenarios.asserts: the web derivative's decode fails (unreadable) -> one decode only (2048), the photo fails with apiError.photo.unreadable, nothing public is written
scenarios.notes: Resource audit item 10 (track/optcloud, 2026-11-12). Test: functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An SVG or a PDF named like a photo is refused by its bytes
scenarios.asserts: the magic bytes are not JPEG, PNG, WebP or TIFF -> processing failed with apiError.photo.unsupportedType; nothing written to either bucket
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An HEIC photo is refused with a message
scenarios.asserts: an HEIC file -> processing failed with apiError.photo.heicUnsupported, whose message says how to export a JPEG; nothing written to either bucket (DECISIONS-for-review.md §20b)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An image over 200 megapixels is refused from its header alone
scenarios.asserts: a 240-megapixel PNG header -> processing failed with apiError.photo.tooLarge; the pixels are never decoded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The same file as another photo is flagged as its duplicate
scenarios.asserts: the upload's SHA-256 equals another photo's original -> processing failed with apiError.photo.duplicate and duplicateOf naming that photo; nothing public written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A Storage outage keeps the upload so Reprocess can retry it
scenarios.asserts: the bucket unavailable during processing -> processing failed with a retryable error and the upload kept; photos.reprocess processes the kept upload again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/photos/upload.test.ts and functions/test/photos/reprocess.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An EXIF position outside the city is not applied
scenarios.asserts: EXIF GPS beyond the city bounds plus 0.5 degrees -> the pin stays at the last pin, the suggestion is shown with the reason, and applying it is refused
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: An interrupted upload resumes without a second photo
scenarios.asserts: the network drops mid-upload -> the item says so and resumes once it is back (or Retry) -> one photo document and one original in the end
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.2; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Editing a photo's texts, place, direction and field of view previews live and publishes on save
scenarios.asserts: title RO and EN, years, author, licence and links edited; the pin moved with a click in Select mode (a drag waits for Terra Draw, DECISIONS-for-review.md §34g); Set direction, then a click where the camera looked, sets the bearing and the view cone turns live; the field-of-view slider widens the cone live; Save -> one stamped update, a history entry, the manifest rebuilt and the viewer shows the cone
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.3; owner: photos). Nominatim title suggestions and AI translations are M4 (the two bad rows below).

scenarios.title: A Nominatim refusal leaves the admin typing the title
scenarios.asserts: the fake Nominatim answers 429: the place set -> apiError.assist.rateLimited under the title, the field empty and editable, Save with a typed title publishes; for ten minutes no other request reaches Nominatim (the fake counts one)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/title.spec.ts (state assist.suggestions-refused).

scenarios.title: An unavailable AI gives no draft and nothing is published
scenarios.asserts: the fake Vertex AI answers 503: English draft -> apiError.assist.unavailable under the field, the English field as it was, nothing saved, the manifest unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.3; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/drafts.spec.ts (state assist.draft-refused).

scenarios.title: The pin and the direction can be set without a pointer
scenarios.asserts: latitude and longitude fields move the pin; with the map focused, the arrow keys move the crosshair's view and Point at map centre sets the direction -> the same document as with the pointer; no pointer event used
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.6, §6.3; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: A pin moved outside the city snaps back with a message
scenarios.asserts: a place typed beyond the city bounds plus 0.5 degrees -> the pin stays at its last valid place, the fields name the limit, and Save writes nothing outside the city (a dragged pin waits for Terra Draw, §34g)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.5, §6.3; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: A photo opened in its editor is brought into view on the map
scenarios.asserts: a city without a start view (the map opens at its bounds' centre, north of every photo) -> opening a photo's editor centres the map on the photo, its zoom kept and without animation, so its pin is on the map at every tour viewport
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2e review (the 2026-10-18 review screenshots showed the open photo's pin off the map; owner: photos). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-photos.tour.ts; packages/admin/test/photos/map.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A photo's place suggests titles from OpenStreetMap
scenarios.asserts: a real upload IMG_0412.jpg (a camera's naming, no place in its file) starts titled IMG 0412 at the last pin; the pin set on the map -> up to three suggestions once the queue answers, with the OpenStreetMap attribution and its link, since nobody chose that title; one click fills the Romanian (and the English, when OpenStreetMap has it) title in the draft; Save publishes (input budget suggestTitle: 1, nothing cleared by hand)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/title.spec.ts (state assist.suggestions); the admin side in packages/admin/test/{assist/assist,photos/assists}.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An English draft of the Romanian title fills the field until Save
scenarios.asserts: English draft (offered while only Romanian has text) -> the English field holds the fake model's text and the note Automatic draft: check it before you save (no model id), and no button offers to replace it; the manifest unchanged until Save; after Save the viewer shows the English title (input budget translateDraft: 2)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.3; owner: assists-notify). In e2e/admin/specs/assists/drafts.spec.ts (state assist.draft).

scenarios.title: Bulk publish rebuilds the manifest and the viewer shows the photos
scenarios.asserts: three photos selected -> Publish -> each published, one manifest build (the publish status turns to up to date) -> the viewer served that manifest shows the three markers
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Unpublishing hides the photo in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Unpublish on a published photo -> published false -> the next manifest lacks it and the viewer no longer shows it; its public files stay until the sweep
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Publishing rebuilds the manifest with every published document
scenarios.asserts: a build task -> manifest.json gzip in the public bucket with a 60-second cache; manifests/{city} records builtVersion, url, sha256, bytes and counts
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A document the manifest refuses is skipped and listed
scenarios.asserts: one published document fails its manifest schema -> the manifest is published without it and manifests/{city}.skipped names it with its first issue
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city without its public token keeps the last good manifest
scenarios.asserts: no viewer token on the city -> status failed with apiError.mapbox.notConfigured; the last good url, sha256, counts and builtVersion stay; nothing uploaded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A change during a build queues the next build
scenarios.asserts: requestedVersion moves on while a build runs -> the build records the version it started from and queues another build task
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/build-manifest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A change the manifest does not carry requests no build
scenarios.asserts: a write to an unpublished document, or of the stamp and suggestions only -> no manifests/{city} change and no task
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md CR-M2-33). Covered by functions/test/publish/fields.test.ts and functions/test/publish/on-write.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Photos that cannot be published are skipped with the reason
scenarios.asserts: a selection with a photo still processing, one failed and one with the licence unknown -> those three are listed with their reasons and stay unpublished; the rest are published; an English title is not required
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos). Replaces S-A10-BAD-MISSING-EN-TITLE, which contradicted CR-1 of M1-interfaces.md (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34f). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-photos.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Saving a new processed photo publishes it
scenarios.asserts: the editor of a processed photo with a known licence -> the Published switch starts on -> Save -> published in the same write; the viewer shows the photo
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Confirming the rights of legacy photos clears the viewer's note
scenarios.asserts: the Rights review filter lists the photos with rightsReview -> Confirm rights on a selection -> rightsReview false -> the viewer's rights note is gone for them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.5; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Ranked scenes with footprints and browse previews
scenarios.asserts: Search -> ranked scenes (free first, then by score) with the city's boundary on the admin map and the open scene's footprint alone and browse previews (copies in our bucket read with the Storage SDK, never a USGS address from the browser); for Bucharest the 1966, 1976, 1977, 1978 and 1980 frames rank on top
