scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Zero results show guidance
scenarios.asserts: zero results -> guidance (widen the years, all three datasets, the city's area in Settings)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The guidance answers CR-M3-35 (a): every year, all three collections, the scenes to order too, and the city's area in Settings.

scenarios.title: An M2M error shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: M2M error -> actionable message (apiError.usgs.maintenance retried later, apiError.usgs.unavailable with Try again, apiError.usgs.credentials with the link to Setup)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. Maintenance says it retries, unavailable offers Try again, and the refused token links Setup's USGS step (CR-M3-35 b).

scenarios.title: Without USGS setup a link to setup is shown
scenarios.asserts: USGS not set up -> link to setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Every result says why it ranks where it does, in plain words
scenarios.asserts: each result lists its reasons (free, covers 92 % of the city, a target year, no layer within 8 years, no clouds recorded, about 2.75 m detail) in RO and EN; a scene of a year a layer already has ranks below one of a new year
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Filters narrow the results
scenarios.asserts: free only, a year range and a dataset narrow the list, the map drawing no result's footprint meanwhile (finding 51 of 2026-11-01); clearing them restores the list
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A browse image that cannot be fetched shows a placeholder with Try again
scenarios.asserts: the USGS browse host answers 503 -> 'Preview unavailable' with Try again on the card; the rest of the results work; the browser never requests a USGS address (firewall)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Every admin test ends once its page's imagery.search and imagery.browse calls have answered (e2e/admin/support/server-calls.ts): a copy of the test before once recorded the scene as copied in this one (docs/LESSONS.md 341).

scenarios.title: Every listed row shows its browse image
scenarios.asserts: a recent harvest that copied no browse image -> the first rows ask the server for their copies, four at a time, and each of the six listed rows shows its image (120 px wide), read from our bucket, never from USGS
scenarios.notes: Finding 52 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82b). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A row whose browse image USGS does not serve says so
scenarios.asserts: the USGS browse host answers 503 -> every row shows a broken-image icon whose name says the preview cannot be fetched (the scene page keeps Try again); the rows and the map still work
scenarios.notes: Finding 52 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82b). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The open scene is the one footprint on the map
scenarios.asserts: a scene opened -> the map keeps the city's view and inside the city shows the blend of the scene's colour at 0.21 over the basemap (a pixel probe); the map's footprints are that scene's alone
scenarios.notes: Finding 51 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82a). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Overlapping results draw no footprint while none is open
scenarios.asserts: six listed frames all covering the city, none open -> the map shows the basemap's own colour at the city's centre (a pixel probe, within 6 per channel) and no footprint, the city's boundary only: never the stacked fills or the crossing outlines of every result
scenarios.notes: Finding 51 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82a). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames of the same camera and day say what tells them apart
scenarios.asserts: the 1968 frame and its paid twin of the same day -> each row names its USGS id, the forward camera and its frame (75, 76) in RO and EN
scenarios.notes: Finding 53 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82c). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame whose id names no camera says only what its id holds
scenarios.asserts: the 1966 frame -> its id, aft camera and frame 23; a KH-9 mapping frame -> its id and frame 7, no camera
scenarios.notes: Finding 53 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82c). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Before USGS approves downloads, results show but Import waits
scenarios.asserts: an account with the search role only -> the ranked results show, Import is off with apiError.usgs.accessPending and the link to Setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts. Import off with apiError.usgs.accessPending and the link to Setup (CR-M3-35 c); the cards offer no Import.

scenarios.title: The harvest stores and ranks every scene over the city
scenarios.asserts: imagery.search over corona2, declassii and declassiii -> usgsScenes documents with sensor, footprint, coverage, rank and reasons, the top 20 browse images copied; a second search updates and never duplicates; logout always runs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: One dataset in maintenance does not stop the others
scenarios.asserts: declassiii answers the HTML 503 -> the other datasets are harvested and failedDatasets names declassiii
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A slow USGS search answers in time, and one the server cut off says so and what to do next
scenarios.asserts: every USGS page slower than the search budget -> imagery.search stops asking, stores what it found and answers; a search that failed with no reason after 5 minutes or more -> the admin reads adminContent.imagery.searchTimedOut with the minutes and the next step; one that failed at once -> adminContent.imagery.searchFailed
scenarios.notes: Lesson 646 (live 2026-11-13: the harvest ran over 7 minutes, past the 300 s timeout, and the admin read 'Something went wrong on the server'). Tests: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts, packages/admin/test/imagery/search.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A USGS request that takes too long is recorded, and what its dataset found is stored
scenarios.asserts: corona2's page from record 101 is aborted at its own timeout -> corona2 is recorded partial (found 100, next 101, reason requestTimedOut), its first 100 scenes are stored, the run is recorded partial and due again in 15 minutes; the admin's line says what it kept and that the rest comes by itself
scenarios.notes: Lesson 676 (2026-11-13: no Landsat over Bucharest; the harvest was all or nothing and a run past the callable's 540 s stored and recorded nothing). Tests: functions/test/imagery/harvest-partial.test.ts, functions/test/adapters/upstream-http.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/search-parts.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A harvest out of time stores every dataset it finished and records the rest partial
scenarios.asserts: corona2's first page uses up the search's time -> declassii is stored and done, corona2 partial with next 101 and reason outOfTime, ops/harvest-{city} partial; the admin's Search shows each dataset's part live, then the answer's
scenarios.notes: Lesson 676 (2026-11-13: no Landsat over Bucharest; the harvest was all or nothing and a run past the callable's 540 s stored and recorded nothing). Tests: functions/test/imagery/harvest-partial.test.ts, packages/admin/test/imagery/search.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The next harvest resumes only the unfinished dataset, where it stopped
scenarios.asserts: after a partial run (corona2 stopped at 101) -> the next run asks corona2 from 101 and 201 only, stores the rest and records ok
scenarios.notes: Lesson 676 (2026-11-13: no Landsat over Bucharest; the harvest was all or nothing and a run past the callable's 540 s stored and recorded nothing). Test: functions/test/imagery/harvest-partial.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A harvest the server stopped is found, logged and resumed
scenarios.asserts: ops/harvest-{city} still running 10 minutes after it started -> the next run logs harvest.killed as an error, searches only the dataset that was not done, keeps the done one's part and records ok
scenarios.notes: Lesson 676 (2026-11-13: no Landsat over Bucharest; the harvest was all or nothing and a run past the callable's 540 s stored and recorded nothing). Test: functions/test/imagery/harvest-partial.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A browse address outside USGS is never fetched
scenarios.asserts: a scene whose browse address is not on ims.cr.usgs.gov -> no request is made (RemoteFiles allowedHosts) and browse.state stays failed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A harvest USGS does not answer backs off instead of repeating every tick
scenarios.asserts: every dataset failing records a failed attempt (ops/harvest-{city}) and the tick waits an hour, then two; a harvest that found nothing waits a month; refused credentials mark the USGS card invalid and stop the tick's harvests
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: USGS not answering is said, never an empty area, and a check that found USGS down leaves search and import on
scenarios.asserts: every dataset failing answers apiError.usgs.unavailable (or maintenance when every one was), no scene written; a USGS record unavailable with its role kept still searches and imports
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A scene named by the address whose read failed says so, never that it does not exist
scenarios.asserts: a scene document that cannot be read, opened by its address -> the failure with Try again, not 'No scene has this address'
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/imagery/orders.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Try again opens the scene whose read failed
scenarios.asserts: the document readable again -> Try again -> the scene's page, the alert gone
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Try again on the browse image reaches a scene only the address names
scenarios.asserts: a scene Free only hides, its browse image failed, the host back -> Try again -> the image shows
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/search.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/imagery/imagery.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A KH-9 panoramic frame's coverage is what its film covers, not its corners' box
scenarios.asserts: the frame D3C1202-200149F039 over Bucharest: USGS's corners alone say 97 %; the search stores about 53 % (a bow tie, cos(60.5) wide at the frame's waist; measured truth about 51 %, the estimate misses it by the corners' 7 km shift) and ranks by it, a scene harvested earlier is read again by the next search, and the stored footprint stays USGS's
scenarios.notes: Round of 2026-11-06. In functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts; the model in packages/shared/test/imagery/coverage.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame of any other camera keeps its footprint's coverage
scenarios.asserts: a KH-4B frame of the same outline over the same city -> still 97 %: only the KH-9 panoramic camera's coverage narrows
scenarios.notes: Round of 2026-11-06. In functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts; every other sensor in packages/shared/test/imagery/coverage.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame's id names its camera when the metadata does not
scenarios.asserts: DS09065A089MC039 -> KH-5 Argon at 140 m, not KH-4A; DS11xx KH-4B, DS10xx KH-4A, DS9xxx KH-4, DZB...H KH-7, DZB...L KH-9 mapping; metadata saying ARGON too
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14. In functions/test/imagery/scene-record.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The metadata outranks the id, and an unknown id keeps the dataset's camera
scenarios.asserts: Camera Type KH-4A on a DS11xx id -> KH-4A; an id of no known form -> the dataset's fallback, as before: KH-6 Lanyard ids are not told apart yet
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14. In functions/test/imagery/scene-record.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A scene harvested before the id rules is imported as the camera its id names
scenarios.asserts: DS09065A073MC043 stored as KH-4A (the corona2 fallback) imports as KH-5: the job's params, the version's sensor and label, the reserved layer id and the scene say KH-5 Argon; DS1103 reads KH-4B
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS §209, LESSONS 667. In functions/test/imagery/{scene-record,import}.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A stored camera other than the fallback, or an id of no known form, is kept
scenarios.asserts: a stored KH-4B stays KH-4B whatever the id; an unknown id keeps the stored KH-4A
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS §209. In functions/test/imagery/scene-record.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame of a date in progress is not demoted as a repeated year
scenarios.asserts: a frame in progress on 1972-08-08 -> another frame of that date scores as new, with the reason Same date as a frame in progress, listed first
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: functions/test/imagery/search.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A huge browse image is a small picture in its row and a bounded one on its page
scenarios.asserts: a copy 20,000 x 1,000 px long: the row's image is 128 x 128 px, decoded small by createImageBitmap's resize and never held at full size; the scene's page shows the whole frame at most 2,048 px long; the pictures are made one at a time, the map's full-size decode among them and once however many list writes come while it waits, and every address is released
scenarios.notes: The owner's live use, 2026-11-07. Tab frozen by 64 px thumbnails of 37,440 x 1,920 px copies. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/imagery/pictures.test.ts (what the decoder is asked for), browse.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A browse copy that is no image says its preview is unavailable
scenarios.asserts: a copy that cannot be decoded: its row shows the unavailable placeholder, not a broken image, the other rows stand
scenarios.notes: The owner's live use, 2026-11-07. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/imagery/browse.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A preview that could not be made says so with Try again, and Try again makes it
scenarios.asserts: the thumbnail made and the bucket then failing: the scene's page shows the unavailable alert with Try again instead of the row's 128 px crop as the browse image, the row keeps its thumbnail; Try again shows the whole frame
scenarios.notes: Code review of 2026-11-07. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/rows.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/imagery/browse.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/imagery-detail.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A malformed USGS record reads as USGS not connected, the same in Setup and in Find

scenarios.notes: Finding of 2026-11-12 (live: setup/status written with Firestore timestamps in install.*.checkedAt by an out-of-band write, updatedBy u-overnight). Tests: functions/test/setup/record-install.test.ts; packages/admin/test/imagery/feeds.test.ts; packages/shared/test/schemas/firestore-ops.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A free scene imports to a draft, is approved and appears in the viewer

scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/published.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: A georeferencing failure offers the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: the automatic georeferencing finds too few pairs -> the job waits for points (awaiting_gcps) with apiError.imagery.noMatch and 'Open georeferencer'; saving points continues the same job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). scenarios.title: An import can be cancelled

scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An import that ended leaves Work and its count

scenarios.notes: Finding 54 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82d). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A long download shows its bytes of the total

scenarios.title: A download whose size USGS did not say shows its bytes alone

scenarios.notes: Finding 55 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82e). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Under the threshold, Import is the only click

scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/published.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance makes the import wait, not fail
scenarios.asserts: the HTML 503 while the download is prepared -> 'USGS is under maintenance; it is retried automatically' (waiting_usgs) -> the next tick resumes it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: A scene that is not scanned cannot be imported
scenarios.asserts: imagery.import of a scene whose download is not available -> apiError.imagery.notScanned; no job, version or layer id written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A scene is imported once
scenarios.asserts: a second imagery.import of the same scene -> apiError.imagery.alreadyImported naming the layer
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: An imported free scene can be imported again into a new version of its layer
scenarios.asserts: imagery.import with again: true on an imported scene -> a second usgs-import job and version in the same layer, the scene still imported there; the scene page offers Import again (free) and opens the new version

scenarios.title: Import again is refused when the scene moved meanwhile, and not offered for a scene to order or without downloads
scenarios.asserts: the scene's layer changes between the check and the transaction -> apiError.conflict and no second job; a scene that must be ordered, or USGS downloads not approved -> no Import again button
scenarios.notes: Lesson 645. Tests: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/imagery-detail.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The budget guard pauses imports, never the site
scenarios.asserts: ops/guard red -> imagery.import answers apiError.guardPaused and queued jobs wait (waitReason guard); the manifest and the viewer are untouched
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: At most ten raster jobs a day
scenarios.asserts: the 11th raster job of a day -> apiError.imagery.dailyLimit with the limit
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A city that runs its jobs on the owner's computer imports and joins past the daily cap
scenarios.asserts: with ten cloud imports today and the city's choice local, an import and a join of two missing frames start, every new job recorded runOn local; ten jobs on the computer today do not fill a cloud city's cap
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-12 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §4.5). Test: functions/test/imagery/local-daily-cap.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A job on the computer moved to the cloud past the daily cap is refused
scenarios.asserts: imagery.runOn cloud of a local import with ten cloud imports today -> apiError.imagery.dailyLimit {limit: 10}, the job unchanged; under the cap the move stamps countedAt today and the next import is refused
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-12 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §4.5). Test: functions/test/imagery/local-daily-cap.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A queued job starts exactly one execution
scenarios.asserts: a queued job -> one Cloud Run execution (raster-fetch for an import still to download; raster-pipeline, raster-pipeline-xl for a KH-9 panoramic frame, once downloaded) with JOB_ID, CITY_ID and the args run; a redelivered trigger starts nothing more; a third running job waits (capacity)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A run that ends starts the job waiting for its place at once
scenarios.asserts: two runs hold both places, a third job waits (capacity); one run succeeds -> imagery.onJobWrite dispatches every city's queued jobs at once: the third starts (one execution), without waiting for imagery.tick, which runs every 15 minutes
scenarios.notes: Resource audit item 9 (reports/resource-audit.md, docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §4.6; track/optcloud, 2026-11-12). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A write that frees no place starts nothing; a dispatch that fails leaves the others
scenarios.asserts: a heartbeat, a start or a new job that ended frees no place -> no execution, the waiting job stays queued; a queued job whose dispatch throws is logged (queued job not dispatched) and the next queued job still starts
scenarios.notes: Resource audit item 9 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §4.6; track/optcloud, 2026-11-12). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An import downloads on the small job, then is processed on the standard one
scenarios.asserts: a queued import -> one execution of raster-fetch (machine fetch); once its download is done and it is queued again -> one execution of raster-pipeline in the same attempt
scenarios.notes: Finding 56 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82f). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An out-of-memory exit moves a phase to the next larger job, never downloading again
scenarios.asserts: an out-of-memory exit of the download on raster-fetch -> run again on raster-pipeline; of the processing on raster-pipeline -> run again on raster-pipeline-xl with the download steps kept done
scenarios.notes: Finding 56 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82f). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An execution killed for its memory is noticed before its lease lapses
scenarios.asserts: a running job on raster-pipeline-xl, its lease still held but no write for three heartbeats, its execution failed out of memory -> the tick fails the job and its version with apiError.imagery.outOfMemory at once
scenarios.notes: Finding 58 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82i). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A late heartbeat of a run Cloud Run still runs, or a heartbeat on time, is left alone
scenarios.asserts: a heartbeat three beats late whose execution is still running, and one on time whose execution reads failed -> both jobs stay running and nothing is dispatched
scenarios.notes: Finding 58 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82i). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A lost or out-of-memory execution runs again, then gives up
scenarios.asserts: a running job whose lease lapsed and whose execution failed out of memory -> dispatched again on raster-pipeline-xl (attempt 2); past JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS -> failed with apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A publish not yet at Mapbox can be cancelled; one at Mapbox is never ended by a stale reject
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on a publish before its publish call ends the job and its version and frees the reservation, and a start after it sends Mapbox nothing; a job Mapbox works on stays; a rejection that read a waiting job refuses once the guard sent it to Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Dispatchers racing for the last place start one run
scenarios.asserts: two dispatches that both counted one run before either transaction start exactly one execution (ops/dispatch slots); a slot whose run ended or whose city is gone is freed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A failure no retry cures offers no Try again
scenarios.asserts: an import whose Mapbox token was refused shows its error without Try again; imagery.retry refuses a token or scope failure, a job past its attempts and an upload refused before any version (out of memory is retried since finding 58)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A job an outdated computer could not run offers Run it again past its attempts
scenarios.asserts: an archive series failed three times by a worker image that did not run its type (apiError.imagery.pipelineOutdated, or the legacy apiError.invalidRequest naming the type) -> the Jobs page titles it Archive import, shows its error without a literal placeholder and offers Run it again; the retry queues it with its attempts back to 0; the pipeline fails an unknown type as pipelineOutdated and a worker claims only the types its image runs
scenarios.notes: Live report of 2026-11-09 (four archive-series jobs failed on an old worker image). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/jobs.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An ordinary job past its attempts still offers no Run it again
scenarios.asserts: an import that failed on its own three times shows no Run it again on the Jobs page; imagery.retry refuses any other exhausted failure, an invalid request included, with apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted
scenarios.notes: Live report of 2026-11-09. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/jobs.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A run on the owner's computer offers Try again past its attempts
scenarios.asserts: an archive series (runOn local, localOnly) failed three times in place on a server bug, or ended by the dispatcher with apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted -> its version page and the Jobs page offer Try again; imagery.retry queues it again on the computer with its attempts back to 0 (a local run costs no cloud compute)
scenarios.notes: Live report of 2026-11-12 (archive series ar-mw993zri-s-4054e55659a3 left with only Delete this version). One shared rule: retryPastCap and retryCures of @hcm/shared, used by jobRetryable and imagery.retry.

scenarios.title: A cloud run or a publish at its cap still offers no Try again
scenarios.asserts: a failed job run in Google Cloud (or never placed) at JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS, a local run whose publish used its starts, a local run whose Mapbox token was refused and a dismissed local run offer no Try again; imagery.retry refuses the cloud run and the publish with apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted and the token failure with apiError.imagery.versionState
scenarios.notes: Live report of 2026-11-12: the cap that stops paid work looping stays for the cloud and for Mapbox.

scenarios.title: A frame that ran out of memory says so and offers Try again
scenarios.asserts: an import killed for its memory at stitch -> the version page says the frame did not fit in the processing memory, with Try again; Try again runs it once more to the approval card
scenarios.notes: Finding 58 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §82i). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A failed version is deleted, asked first
scenarios.asserts: the page offers Delete this version (no Dismiss beside it, since 2026-11-12) and asks first; confirmed, the version and its job go and the page shows the list; imagery.reject still dismisses a failed version (rejected, its job stays failed) and a version that left failed meanwhile is not dismissed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A version its schema refuses is still listed and can be rejected or cancelled
scenarios.asserts: a waiting version stored with a scan wider than today's limit -> it shows in Waiting for you and its page with Reject and Cancel; Reject or Cancel ends it and its job, writes it back valid without the refused fields, and its layer is no longer busy
scenarios.notes: Finding of 2026-11-12 (live: cities/bucharest/layerVersions/im-mvya873z-D3C1202-200149F039 stored by the pipeline, unvalidated, with scan.width 258271 over MAX_SCAN_PIXELS 200000 (finding 62, lesson 332); its layer answered joinLayerBusy for ever). Tests: functions/test/imagery/legacy-version.test.ts; the admin list in packages/admin/test/imagery/feeds.test.ts; the read in packages/shared/test/schemas/legacy-reads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A version whose required fields fail is still refused and nothing changes
scenarios.asserts: a stored version whose layer id fails -> Reject answers an internal error, its job keeps waiting, the version is not listed
scenarios.notes: Finding of 2026-11-12 (live: cities/bucharest/layerVersions/im-mvya873z-D3C1202-200149F039 stored by the pipeline, unvalidated, with scan.width 258271 over MAX_SCAN_PIXELS 200000 (finding 62, lesson 332); its layer answered joinLayerBusy for ever). Tests: functions/test/imagery/legacy-version.test.ts; packages/shared/test/schemas/legacy-reads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A run lost in a step shows that step failed and only the sentence
scenarios.asserts: a job the tick failed out of memory while stitch was running, its message the bare code -> the version page lists stitch as Failed (not Running) and shows the translated sentence without apiError.imagery.outOfMemory beneath it
scenarios.notes: Findings 60 and 61 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/imagery/version.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A retry redoes what a newer pipeline may do differently and keeps the download
scenarios.asserts: a job failed in locate with fetch, extract and stitch done -> after imagery.retry stitch and locate are pending, fetch and extract keep their records
scenarios.notes: Finding 78 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-03: the 1972 retry kept the frame joined by the pipeline before the fix). In functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A retry after the city crop keeps the crop, whose delivery is gone
scenarios.asserts: a job failed in georef with locate done -> after imagery.retry reference and georef are pending, locate and everything before it keep their records
scenarios.notes: Finding 78 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. In functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A deleted or dismissed failed import can be imported again
scenarios.asserts: a version that failed in the pipeline, deleted (or dismissed) -> its scene is a candidate again, its reserved layer id freed, and its page offers Import; a scene an earlier release left reserved is freed by the next tick
scenarios.notes: Finding 85 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-05). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/import.spec.ts and functions/test/imagery/approve.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Dismissing a version leaves a scene another version holds
scenarios.asserts: another version of the same layer still failed (a retry may yet make it) -> the scene stays imported with its layer id
scenarios.notes: Finding 85 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. In functions/test/imagery/approve.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A dismissed version is not brought back by Retry
scenarios.asserts: its scene was freed: imagery.retry refuses a version that is rejected, cancelled or otherwise ended (also one dismissed during the retry) with apiError.imagery.versionState, job and version unchanged; the dismissal marks its failed job cancelRequested, so jobRetryable offers Retry on no page; a publish retry of a version still approved or publishing goes on
scenarios.notes: Round of 2026-11-06. In functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts and approve.test.ts; jobRetryable in packages/shared/test/imagery/job-retryable.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Run it again on an import set aside after the frame was imported again names the newer import
scenarios.asserts: a failed job whose version was rejected, with a later import of the same frame in the same layer -> imagery.retry refuses apiError.imagery.importedAgain with the newer version's id (logged with both ids); the Jobs page says the frame was imported again later and offers Open the newer import; without a newer import, apiError.imagery.versionRejected says to import the frame again
scenarios.notes: The owner's report of 2026-11-13 (the 1972 frame im-mw11bz00-D3C1202-200149F039, a bare HTTP 400). Covered by functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts and packages/admin/test/jobs/raster.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A failed job whose version stayed processing can still be retried
scenarios.asserts: the runner's second write never arrived, or the job was invalid: the job is failed, its version processing -> imagery.retry queues the job and leaves the version processing instead of refusing it with no other way out; an invalid job's version now fails with it when it can be read
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Tests: functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts; pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner.py.

scenarios.title: A stopped archive series tried again places itself from the owner's saved pairs
scenarios.asserts: pairs saved on a parked series, then Stop (cancelRequested) ended it -> imagery.retry queues it without cancelRequested, attempt 0, every step pending; its version is processing with georef method gcps and the pairs kept; the tick's pass over cancellations leaves it queued; place warps it through the pairs and never runs the class placer; the georeferencer opens the parked series editable with the pairs
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-12 live bug, the 1914 SOCEC series (docs/LESSONS.md 565). Tests: functions/test/imagery/retry-stopped.test.ts; pipeline/tests/unit/test_placing_owner.py; packages/admin/test/georef/georef.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A stopped series whose version was dismissed is not brought back, its Stop kept
scenarios.asserts: a stopped archive series whose version became rejected -> imagery.retry refuses with apiError.imagery.versionState; the job stays cancelled with cancelRequested, the version rejected
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-12 (docs/LESSONS.md 565). In functions/test/imagery/retry-stopped.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A retried series still placing itself is read-only in the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: an archive series' version processing (the retry runs, the pairs kept) -> the georeferencer opens it with editable false; only a version waiting for points (needs_gcps) takes new pairs
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-12 (docs/LESSONS.md 565). In packages/admin/test/georef/georef.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A failed version holds its layer id until it is dismissed
scenarios.asserts: a version of the same label failed -> a new import reserves the next id, so two scenes never share one (a shared id held each other's release for ever); rejected or cancelled -> the id is free again
scenarios.notes: Round of 2026-11-06. In functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Buying a scan is prepared, tracked and imported on its own when delivered
scenarios.asserts: a scene USGS has not scanned (Free only off): its order card says 35 USD (30 USD a frame and 5 USD an order, paid to USGS) with the guide's four steps as the owner's first order did them on the scene's EarthExplorer page (Login, Order at the page's bottom, On-Demand with 7 Micron and Submit Product Selections, USGS's form with 35 USD on pay.gov), and links to the scene's EarthExplorer page (its dataset id and entity id, a new tab); EarthExplorer and I ordered it are the flow's two inputs -> the chip Ordered with the next check; the fake USGS delivers; Check now -> Importing with a link to the import: a usgs-import job created by the admin exists without another click, and the event order.delivered is written for the admins' inbox (the inbox itself: S-A46-HAPPY)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (states orders.order-card, orders.ordered).

scenarios.title: An order not delivered after a week reminds the admin to pay, and one never delivered is ordered again
scenarios.asserts: orders seeded as the watch leaves them: a week old with a reminder sent and its last check failed for maintenance -> its card says Ordered: have you paid?, the 14-day warning, that an admin who paid has nothing to do, and the failed check in words; a delivered one says its import is starting; one never delivered comes first in Work, says so and offers I ordered it again and Take the mark back - Work's tab counts the three open orders it lists (finding 54) (the watch's reminders on days 7 and 12 and its day-90 give-up are the functions rows S-A13-HAPPY-WATCH, S-A13-BAD-USGS-DOWN and S-A13-BAD-EXPIRED)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.5, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (states orders.reminder, orders.delivered, orders.expired).

scenarios.title: An available scene cannot be marked as ordered
scenarios.asserts: a scene USGS lists as downloadable shows Import (free) and no order card, no EarthExplorer link and no I ordered it; the same scene in the list carries the chip Free
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An order marked by mistake is taken back
scenarios.asserts: I ordered it, then the snackbar's Undo -> the chip Must be ordered from USGS again and the order card offers EarthExplorer and I ordered it again, no order stored; marked again, then Take the mark back on the card -> the same, and a tick asks USGS nothing about it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts; the callable in functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The daily watch asks USGS once a day per order and imports a delivered scan
scenarios.asserts: imagery.tick's orders step: one login per run, download-options batched per dataset for the orders due (at most 50 a run), nextCheckAt one day later; a delivery -> the order delivered and the scene free, then the import job and its version created in one transaction (createdBy the admin who ordered), the order importing with importJobId and the event order.delivered; the version out of processing -> imported and the event order.imported linking to it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Marking a scene USGS already offers is refused
scenarios.asserts: usgs.markOrdered on a scene whose download-options says available -> apiError.usgs.alreadyAvailable, the scene's downloadAvailable set true and ranked again, no order written; on an order already watched -> apiError.usgs.orderState
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame USGS scanned while it was being marked still says why I ordered it was refused
scenarios.asserts: the fake USGS offers the paid frame, then I ordered it -> usgs.markOrdered records it free and answers apiError.usgs.alreadyAvailable; the order card goes (Import is free now), the snackbar says why in words and the keyboard is on the scene's heading; Import enabled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (state orders.scanned-while-marking). Added by the 2026-10-24 review fixes (DECISIONS-for-review.md §57).

scenarios.title: Before USGS approves downloads, the order cards say the daily check waits for it
scenarios.asserts: setup/status usgs pending (search role only) -> the card of a scene to buy and the card of an order each say USGS has not approved the account's downloads and the daily check starts once it does, with the link to Setup's USGS step; the order's next check reads after USGS approves downloads
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5, §1.7; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts (state orders.waits-for-approval). Added by the 2026-10-24 review fixes (DECISIONS-for-review.md §57).

scenarios.title: An order never delivered within 90 days expires
scenarios.asserts: day 90 without delivery -> expired with expiredAt, the event order.expired once, no more checks; a later Check now that finds the download -> delivered and imported as usual
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.2, §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts and orders.test.ts (Check now after expiry).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance during the watch retries sooner and loses no reminder
scenarios.asserts: download-options answers the maintenance HTML 503 -> nextCheckAt six hours later, lastError apiError.usgs.maintenance on the card; the day-7 reminder is still sent that day (reminders do not ask USGS)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A delivery while the budget guard is red waits, then imports once it is green
scenarios.asserts: a red ops/guard (or today's JOBS_PER_DAY reached) -> the order stays delivered and no job is created; the first tick after the guard turns green (or the next day) creates the import once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts and orders.test.ts (Check now).

scenarios.title: Check now twice within a minute asks USGS once
scenarios.asserts: the second usgs.checkOrder within ORDER_CHECK_NOW_MIN_SECONDS -> apiError.rateLimited, the fake USGS counts one download-options call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: orders). In functions/test/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An admin can no longer mark a scene ordered with the Firestore SDK
scenarios.asserts: an admin's update of usgsScenes status to ordered or available is denied (the order is usgs.markOrdered's), and so is any write of order (set or removed) or eeDatasetId; candidate and rejected with a note stay allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: orders). In firebase/rules-tests/test/jobs.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A scene to buy opens from its address while Free only hides it
scenarios.asserts: the address #/imagery/scene/<entityId> of a frame no one ordered yet, opened with Free only on (the list does not show it) -> its page with the order card (EarthExplorer and I ordered it), read by its id
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 follow-up (docs/research/M4-status.md; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts; the area's read in packages/admin/test/imagery/orders.test.ts, the page in packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An address of no scene says so once its read answers
scenarios.asserts: the address of an entity id the city has no scene for -> loading while its read runs, then the heading No scene has this address and no order card
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 follow-up (docs/research/M4-status.md; owner: orders). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/orders.spec.ts; the loading state in packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/orders.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An order's import that ended for good offers Import again
scenarios.asserts: a delivered order's import cancelled or dismissed -> the order goes with it and the scene is a candidate, acquisition state available (Import, one click); the watch starts no new import and announces no imported; a version rejected while another keeps the scene is not announced imported; a failure the server recorded keeps the scene and the order until it is dismissed
scenarios.notes: Round of 2026-11-06. Not back to delivered: the watch imports a delivered order by itself. In functions/test/imagery/orders-watch.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A georeferenced GeoTIFF goes straight to the publish path
scenarios.asserts: a georeferenced GeoTIFF uploaded -> inspect finds its georeference -> warp, export -> the approval card (never automatic: no measured error)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts. Needs CR-M3-32 (imagery.onRasterUpload reads only the dialog's metadata keys).

scenarios.title: A GeoTIFF without georeference opens the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: a TIFF without georeference -> the job waits for points (awaiting_gcps) -> the georeferencer opens on its scan
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A non-TIFF upload shows an error
scenarios.asserts: a non-TIFF file -> refused in the page before upload (magic bytes) with apiError.imagery.notTiff; nothing uploaded
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A large upload resumes after an interruption
scenarios.asserts: a large file -> the resumable upload continues after the network drops and completes; one job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/upload.spec.ts. The second chunk the SDK sends is answered 503 once, and the upload goes on.

scenarios.title: Replacing a layer's source image re-runs the pipeline and keeps the old tiles until approval
scenarios.asserts: Replace image on a layer -> a geotiff-import job for that layer -> the published tiles stay until the new tileset is approved, then the layer points to it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/layer-geometry.spec.ts (with S-A14-BAD-REPLACE-OVER-GUARD: Pay publishes the replacement). Was owned by M3 in docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.2. A replacement asks no year (the layer keeps its own). Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: A replacement over the compute-unit guard waits with the guard's choices
scenarios.asserts: the estimate exceeds the month's guard -> the job waits with the three choices (the free Studio upload, next month, pay); the layer keeps its tiles
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/layer-geometry.spec.ts. The approved version the guard stopped shows the three choices (CR-M3-33). Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: The server sniffs an upload's bytes, not its name
scenarios.asserts: an upload named .tif whose bytes are not TIFF -> imagery.onRasterUpload fails its job with apiError.imagery.notTiff and deletes the upload
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/upload.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: Two Replace uploads racing past the busy check are told apart
scenarios.asserts: the second upload's transaction finds the layer's pending version and fails its job with apiError.layers.busy; no version is made and the first keeps the layer
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A valid tileset or XYZ URL previews and saves
scenarios.asserts: valid -> preview on the admin map -> save (layers.link creates the layer: S-A15-HAPPY-LINKED; the server-side probe before Save is M3's S-A15-HAPPY-PROBED)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, refined in M2c (CR-M2c-27): e2e/admin/specs/layers/adjustments.spec.ts previews a linked XYZ layer and saves it; the callable part is S-A15-HAPPY-LINKED on the functions tier.

scenarios.title: A source is probed server-side before it is linked
scenarios.asserts: Check in the Link a layer dialog -> imagery.probeTiles asks one tile -> 'The tiles answer' (no MIME type); Link links it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/link-probe.spec.ts. Check in the dialog (CR-M3-35 g), against the e2e tile host through the Functions emulator (CR-M3-14). The preview of a Mapbox tileset in the dialog is not built: the layer's editor previews it once linked (S-A15-HAPPY).

scenarios.title: Linking the city's own tileset creates a ready, unpublished layer on top
scenarios.asserts: layers.link of a mapbox:// tileset of the city's own Mapbox account (or an https XYZ template) -> a ready layer on top of the others, unpublished, hidden at start, opacity 1, its id clear of the layers', the categories' and the photos overlay's
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-27; owner: layers-settings). functions/test/layers/link.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A 404 or invalid URL shows an error
scenarios.asserts: a tile answering 404 -> apiError.imagery.tilesNotFound, not an image -> apiError.imagery.tilesNotImage, no answer -> apiError.imagery.tilesUnreachable; Save stays off (an http template or crossed zooms: layers.link refuses them, functions/test/layers/link.test.ts)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/link-probe.spec.ts. Refined in M2c (CR-M2c-27); Check is CR-M3-35 (g).

scenarios.title: Another account's tileset is refused
scenarios.asserts: Link a layer with a mapbox:// tileset of another Mapbox account (Mapbox's own and the old site's account included) -> refused in the dialog before any call (apiError.layers.foreignTileset), which keeps the address; layers.link refuses it on the server too
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-27; owner: layers-settings). e2e/tour/admin-layers.tour.ts (the dialog); functions/test/layers/link.test.ts (the callable).

scenarios.title: Another city's pipeline tileset is refused
scenarios.asserts: layers.link of a tileset of the project's own Mapbox account named hcm-<other city>-<layer> (the pipeline's naming, guessable from public USGS metadata) -> apiError.layers.otherCityTileset; no layer document written; the city's own pipeline tileset is its layer's already (apiError.layers.alreadyLinked)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 2 (docs/LESSONS.md 244). Test: functions/test/layers/link.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A tile address carrying a key or token is never published
scenarios.asserts: layers.link of an XYZ template with access_token (or another key) in its address -> apiError.layers.secretInAddress; no layer document written (the dialog refuses it first with the same rule, layerSourceRefusal)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-27; owner: layers-settings). functions/test/layers/link.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A probe never reaches a private address
scenarios.asserts: imagery.probeTiles of a loopback, private, link-local or metadata address, a port other than 443, or a redirect to another host -> apiError.imagery.addressRefused; nothing fetched there
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/probe.test.ts and functions/test/adapters/remote-files.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: GCP editing updates residuals, transform and preview, and saving queues a job
scenarios.asserts: the scan and the reference map side by side; pair and suggestion badges on the map match the scan (number in the disc at every zoom, hollow checkpoints, selected ring, dashed suggestions, half-pair +); pairs added, moved, disabled and deleted update the residual table, the RMSE and the live warped preview; the transform switches; Save -> a regeoref job (or the waiting job continues)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts. Leaving the georeferencer no longer throws (CR-M3-34). Marker parity: DECISIONS §143 (2026-11-11).

scenarios.title: Too few GCPs disable the transform
scenarios.asserts: fewer enabled pairs than the transform needs (affine 3, polynomial 6, thin-plate spline 10) -> that transform disabled with how many are missing; Save off
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: An RMSE over the threshold shows a warning
scenarios.asserts: checkpoint RMSE over the city's threshold -> a warning naming both numbers; Save still allowed (the version then waits for Approve)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: A crop polygon drawn on a layer queues its reprocessing
scenarios.asserts: Crop draws a polygon with the map's drawing tools over the layer -> a regeoref job with the cutline -> after approval the layer's tiles end at the polygon
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/layer-geometry.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Drawn through MapDrawPort (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §4.4). Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: A crop polygon outside the layer is refused before any job
scenarios.asserts: a polygon that does not intersect the layer's bounds -> refused in the page with apiError.imagery.cropOutsideLayer; no job (imagery.crop refuses it too)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/layer-geometry.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: Pairs can be placed without a pointer, one after another
scenarios.asserts: a pair placed, moved and deleted with the keyboard only: the crosshairs of both panes, Add at the centres, the arrow keys move the selected point, Delete removes it; a keyboard pair is not chosen, so the arrows pan to the next place; a pair chosen in the table moves with the arrows, Esc lets it go and Delete removes a chosen one (CR-M3-47)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Points in a line are refused
scenarios.asserts: pairs almost on a line -> the transform refused with 'spread them across the image' (apiError.imagery.degenerateGcps); Save off
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts. The state check passes at every admin project since the CR-M3-35 fixes.

scenarios.title: Second-order polynomial fits when places lie on two streets
scenarios.asserts: six well-spread scan pixels whose places lie on two latitudes -> poly2 fits (fit RMSE under 0.01 m, kind poly2) instead of refusing as degenerate; affine still fits; the inverse is the forward map sampled on a 15 x 15 grid, as the pipeline does
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS §144 / lesson 553. Tests: packages/shared/test/georef/fit.test.ts (happyPath_placesOnTwoStreetsStillFitWhenTheInverseIsSampledOnTheForwardGrid).

scenarios.title: Second-order polynomial refuses pairs on only two scan rows
scenarios.asserts: six pairs on only two horizontal scan rows -> poly2 refused as degenerate; affine still fits
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS §144 / lesson 553. Tests: packages/shared/test/georef/fit.test.ts (badPath_pixelsOnOnlyTwoRowsLeaveTheSecondOrderFitSingular).

scenarios.title: A published layer is re-georeferenced without losing its tiles
scenarios.asserts: Re-georeference on a published layer -> new points -> a regeoref job; the layer keeps its tiles and shows 'New version awaiting approval' until the new one is published
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/layer-geometry.spec.ts. The new points' run is held before warping while the layer is looked at. Per push at admin-c360-ro and admin-l1440-ro, at the other three admin projects in tour-matrix (DECISIONS-for-review.md §49k).

scenarios.title: Points outside the scan or the city are refused
scenarios.asserts: imagery.saveGcps with a pixel outside the scan or a place outside the city's bounds plus 0.5 degree -> apiError.imagery.gcpOutside; no job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/save-gcps.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: Re-georeferencing a first import keeps its scene; a base sent to Mapbox meanwhile is not replaced
scenarios.asserts: after the trigger releases the replaced base the scene stays imported with its layer id (the new version holds it); a base the guard moved to mts_processing refuses the save with apiError.imagery.versionState and nothing is written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: The admin's points replace a camera map they cannot rebuild
scenarios.asserts: saving points over a version whose georef carries a panoramic lattice -> the new version's georef is the points' fit (method gcps) with no lattice, so the warp renders what the georeferencer showed
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md §1. Test: functions/test/imagery/save-gcps.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The georeferencer opens a fitted version on its own figures and the map it publishes
scenarios.asserts: a version whose georef stores its figures, residuals and a panoramic lattice (the stand-in's camera) -> unedited, the errors line shows the stored fit and checkpoint errors the version page shows, not a refit of its pairs, and no refit note; the preview is the lattice's map (a thin-plate spline through its nodes, as the warp renders it)
scenarios.notes: M15 review (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, As built). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts; the preview drawn through the lattice, not the pairs' polynomial, and the stored residuals: packages/admin/test/georef/georef-published.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The georeferencer previews a frame fitted over terrain as its layer shows it
scenarios.asserts: a version whose georef carries terrain (its RPC and the heights under its scan) and the lattice of the map its layer shows -> unedited, the errors line shows the stored figures, the preview is drawn in the box of that map (the stand-in's frame over ground 100 m up, shown 50 pixels east) and each of its quads reads the scan through the RPC over those heights, as the warp's RPC_DEM does, not through the lattice; the map gives GDAL's pixel of each place within 0.01 m (the contract pipeline/tests/contracts/terrain-map.json)
scenarios.notes: M15 terrain review (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Terrain). Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts; the map against GDAL's: pipeline/tests/unit/test_terrain_map_contract.py, packages/shared/test/georef/terrain.test.ts; the page previews it: packages/admin/test/georef/georef-published.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame over terrain whose lazy chunk cannot be fetched says so and keeps the page working
scenarios.asserts: the georeferencer's chunk (georef-extras: the map a lattice or terrain publishes, and Snap my points) fails to load -> the snackbar says adminContent.georef.mapUnavailable in plain words (ro and en); the stored figures still show, the preview is the pairs' fit, the page stays ready
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §110 (the chunk split for the georef budget). Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts; the units: packages/admin/test/georef/georef-published.test.ts, packages/admin/test/georef/extras.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Edited pairs of a fitted version are said to be a refit that saving makes the version's map
scenarios.asserts: a pair of that version left out of the fit -> every figure and the preview are a refit through the pairs and a note says saving replaces the version's map with it; Discard brings back the version's own figures and takes the note away; a version without figures of its own (corner guesses) shows the refit with no note
scenarios.notes: M15 review. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georeferencer.spec.ts (state georef.refitted), packages/admin/test/georef/georef-published.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The admin's points get a run of their own after the attempts were used up
scenarios.asserts: a job parked at JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS (Locate again spent them): saveGcps queues it one short of the limit and the dispatcher starts it at the limit, instead of accepting the points and failing the job for good; earlier counts stay as they are
scenarios.notes: Code review of 2026-11-07. Tests: functions/test/imagery/save-gcps.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The georeferencer's context menu adds, moves, deletes and undoes points on the scan and the map
scenarios.asserts: a right-click, a touch held still for 500 ms, or the ContextMenu key / Shift+F10 (at the focused pane's centre) on the scan or the map opens a role=menu with its first item focused: Add a point here starts or completes a pair exactly there (Add pairs turned on), Move this point and Delete this point only on a pair within the hit radius (Move: the next click on that pane drops it, one Undo step; Esc or a click on the other pane puts it back), Undo with a step to take back; the arrow keys, Home and End walk it; Esc, Tab, a press outside or an action closes it and the focus goes back; a long press is no click, a right-click picks nothing
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §152: the menu and its gestures are the lazy georef-menu chunk). scenarios.title: A version that takes no points shows a context menu with nothing that edits

scenarios.title: Once the pairs give a fit, moving the scan or the map moves the other to the same place
scenarios.asserts: a version whose pairs give a fit: Link the views is on (pressed); zooming or panning the scan (wheel, drag, pinch, + and -, the arrows) jumps the map, once a frame and without an animation, to the place the fit puts at the scan's centre at the zoom of the fit's local scale there; the map's own pan or zoom centres the scan on the pixel its inverse gives at the matching scale; the move one pane makes is not sent back (no loop); turned off, each pane moves alone, and the choice holds for the next version opened in the same session; a read-only version links too
scenarios.notes: The owner's request of 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §156; the mapping is in the lazy georef-extras chunk). scenarios.title: Without a fit the views are not linked and the page says when they will be
scenarios.asserts: too few pairs (or pairs that span no area): Link the views is disabled and not pressed, a note says the views link once the pairs give a fit; zooming the scan leaves the map where it is and the chunk is not fetched; while a point is dragged on the map, or a pointer is down on the scan, nothing follows; a map move that leaves its camera where it was (a resize) moves nothing; a place the fit cannot map moves nothing; a chunk that fails to load leaves the views unlinked and is asked for once
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-12. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georef-linked.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/georef/linked-views.test.ts, packages/admin/test/georef/georef-linked.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/georef/scan-viewer-linked.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/georef/georef-linked-page.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The scan keeps the owner's zoom and centre when a pair is added and when its pane changes size

scenarios.title: A scan never zoomed, or never shown, fits the whole frame again when its pane changes size
scenarios.asserts: the scan showing the whole frame: a narrower window shows the whole frame at the new pane's scale with its middle at the centre; a pane that had no size (hidden on a compact window) fits the frame when it first shows
scenarios.notes: The owner's 1966 Corona frames, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the section on the georeferencer's ghost and sharper scan). Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georef-ghost.spec.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/georef/scan-viewer-keep.test.ts.

scenarios.title: While a pair waits for its second click the panes stand still and a dashed ring shows where the pairs expect it
scenarios.asserts: Add pairs, a click on the scan: the hint says to click the same place on the map and that the dashed ring is where it is expected (where the pairs so far put it); zooming the scan meanwhile leaves the map where it is even with the views linked; the ring is where the fit puts the clicked scan pixel (within 60 m of the landmark) and takes no click: a click on its centre makes the pair there; map first, the ring is on the scan at the pixel showing the clicked place (within 3 px), as the scan pane draws it, and the scan stays still while the map zooms; with a fit the ring is the fit's place, with exactly two pairs it comes from the shift, turn and scale that carry the one onto the other; Esc or Add pairs off takes it away
scenarios.notes: The owner's 1966 Corona frames, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the section on the georeferencer's ghost and sharper scan). A fast second click had landed 1 km off when the linked map moved to the fit's place. The arithmetic is in the lazy georef-extras chunk. scenarios.title: With fewer than two pairs and no fit there is no ghost, and only the plain hint
scenarios.asserts: one pair (or none) and no fit: a click on the scan shows the plain hint to click the same place on the map and no dashed ring, and the lazy chunk is not fetched for it; two pairs at one pixel or at one place, or a place the mapping cannot give, show no ring either
scenarios.notes: The owner's 1966 Corona frames, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the section on the georeferencer's ghost and sharper scan). scenarios.title: Zoomed past the preview's own pixels, the scan pane draws the sharper scan
scenarios.asserts: a scan longer than its 4096 px preview gets a sharper copy as JPEG tiles of 1024 px in one file (scan-tiles.bin, at most 16384 px long and 64 million pixels, so a near-square upload gets 8000 x 8000) when the pipeline parks it; zoomed past the preview's own device pixels (CSS px x devicePixelRatio: a phone sooner), by the owner or by the linked map, the page fetches the file once and the pane decodes only the tiles it shows, none larger than a tile, draws them over the preview at the same place and scale and keeps at most 32 decoded (about 128 MiB), closing the rest; leaving the page closes them; the warped map preview is drawn 4096 px across (3072 before)
scenarios.notes: The owner's 1966 Corona frames, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the section on the georeferencer's ghost and sharper scan). scenarios.title: Without a sharper scan, or while it loads, the pane keeps the preview and says nothing
scenarios.asserts: a scan no longer than its preview gets no sharper copy and the version records none; a version parked before has none either; a scan shown whole (never zoomed past the preview's device pixels) fetches none and the pane gets none; a sharper scan missing from the bucket, still loading or arriving after the page closed leaves the preview drawn, with no error
scenarios.notes: The owner's 1966 Corona frames, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the section on the georeferencer's ghost and sharper scan). scenarios.title: A chosen pair is removed from beside the panes or with Delete on either pane, and the notice's Undo puts it back
scenarios.asserts: a pair chosen in the table shows Delete pair N beside the panes; pressing it, or Delete or Backspace on the map pane (as on the scan), removes the pair in one Undo step and a notice says Pair N was removed with Undo for ten seconds; Undo puts that very pair back at its place in the list, whatever was edited since, and nothing is left to save

scenarios.title: With no pair chosen, or on a version that takes no points, nothing is removed
scenarios.asserts: no pair chosen: no Delete button beside the panes, Delete and Backspace on the map remove nothing and no notice shows; a pair that is no longer there, a version that takes no points and an admin whose access was removed remove nothing

scenarios.title: The map pane shows OpenStreetMap, Sentinel-2 or one of the city's published layers under the pairs
scenarios.asserts: The map shows, a labelled native list above the map, offers the version's references and the city's published layers by name and year, oldest first; choosing a layer draws it opaque under the pairs and the warped preview on the page's one map and credits it below; choosing a reference takes it off; the choice is kept for the next version opened while the admin is open; Mapbox Satellite is never offered

scenarios.title: A layer that is no longer published leaves the map pane, and one thing to show offers no list
scenarios.asserts: a draft layer is not offered; a layer shown that stops being published goes off the map and the pane is back on the reference; a layer id that does not exist draws nothing; with one reference and no published layer there is no list

scenarios.title: Edit points on a version the map shows opens its pairs and says that saving makes a new version
scenarios.asserts: a published version's page and its layer's editor offer Edit points; the georeferencer opens on that version's pairs, editable, and says the version is on the map, that saving makes a new version and that this one stays until the new one is approved; saving starts a regeoref version of the same layer, which keeps its tiles until that one is published

scenarios.asserts: a superseded, approved or publishing version takes no points: its page has no link to the georeferencer, the georeferencer opened on it says it takes no points and says nothing about a new version; a version still waiting for its first points offers Open the georeferencer, not Edit points

scenarios.asserts: under each pane a group of buttons turns it: Turn left, Turn right and Upright (the scan) or North up (the map), 15 degrees a press; on the scan r and R turn it, n sets it upright and Ctrl with a drag turns it about the pane's centre, what is at the centre staying there; pairs, the ghost, clicks and the sharper tiles follow the turn; with a fit and Turn the panes together on (the default, kept while the admin is open) the map takes the bearing that shows the ground as the turned scan does and the scan the angle that suits the map's bearing

scenarios.title: Turned apart, or without a fit, a pane's turn leaves the other as it is
scenarios.asserts: Turn the panes together off: the scan turns and the map keeps its bearing, the map turns and the scan keeps its angle, while their places still follow each other; without a fit the toggle is off and disabled and each pane still turns alone; a fit with no place at the pane's centre turns nothing
scenarios.notes: The owner's requests for beta.1, 2026-11-12 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §173). Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/georef-linked.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/georef/rotation.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/georef/scan-rotate.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Jobs show live progress and logs, and a running job can be cancelled
scenarios.asserts: the jobs list and a job's detail update from Firestore without a reload: seeded jobs arrive, the running job's progress and a new log line (as text) show; Cancel (asked first, Keep running focused) sets cancelRequested and the button says Stopping

scenarios.asserts: a raster job lists the pipeline's and the publisher's steps by name in RO and EN, why it waits (USGS, points, approval, compute units, next month), and Retry on a failed one

scenarios.title: With no job yet, Jobs says where jobs come from

scenarios.title: Settings with a live M3 preview publish to the viewer
