scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §2.2; owner: ops-screens). Applied 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §35e): e2e/admin/specs/flows/revoke.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Every admin screen works in RO and EN and switching keeps form state
scenarios.asserts: every screen, dialog and message of the Setup Assistant and of the M2c editors in RO and EN; switching language in an open editor keeps the draft, the map preview and the selection
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §2.4, §10.1; owner: each area for its screens; ops-screens for the shell).

scenarios.title: No English-only string or raw message id leaks into Romanian screens
scenarios.asserts: the tour's leak check over every admin state, M2b and M2c -> no English-only string or raw key on a Romanian screen and no Romanian on an English one; every POI icon has its label in both
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §10.1, §12.2; owner: each area for its states).

scenarios.title: Dates read in the admin's language whatever the browser's
scenarios.asserts: an American browser (en-US) -> a layer's exact date shows as 24.08.1968 (Romanian, hint zz.ll.aaaa) or 24/08/1968 (English, dd/mm/yyyy) in a text field, never the browser's mm/dd/yyyy; a date typed that way is saved as the ISO date 1968-08-25
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (the review of the M2c screenshots, 2026-10-18; owner: layers-settings). e2e/admin/specs/layers/dates.spec.ts; the USGS card's expiry the same way (packages/ui/test/admin/setup/hcm-setup-usgs.test.ts).

scenarios.title: A date that cannot be read is marked at its field
scenarios.asserts: 31.02.1968 typed -> the field is marked invalid, Save stays off and Firestore keeps the stored date; the USGS card's expiry says it cannot be read and keeps nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (owner: layers-settings). e2e/admin/specs/layers/dates.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/setup/hcm-setup-usgs.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The tab's title and the page's language follow the admin's language
scenarios.asserts: an English browser, no language chosen -> the tab is titled 'Map administration' and <html lang> is en; Română from the account menu -> 'Administrarea hărții' and ro at once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (the integrator, 2026-10-24: the live polish of the deployed admin, 2026-10-23, where the title stayed Romanian under an English UI). Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/title.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/shell/shell.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The admin wears the device's accent by default and the account menu's Map colours brings the city's back
scenarios.asserts: light and dark systems with an emulated accent: the shell's primary is the accent's; Colours -> Map colours: the city's primary, kept after a reload; Device accent: the accent again; with the accent shown, the account menu shows no note under Colours
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-13: "the feature to follow the OS accent colours (and others available) is the new default" (track/osaccent; DECISIONS-for-review.md §215). packages/ui/src/theme/device-accent.ts: the city's schemes turned to the accent's OKLCH hue with their WCAG luminance kept; Chrome exposes the device's AccentColor only to an installed app (a tab gets a constant), Safari a constant, Firefox the real one; a page names it with --hcm-device-accent. Settings' live seed preview always shows the seed's own colours. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/shell/accent.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/shell/shell.test.ts, nav-and-menu.test.ts; packages/admin/test/app/mount.test.ts, boot.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Without the device's accent the admin wears the city's own colours and the account menu says why
scenarios.asserts: no accent the browser exposes -> the account menu says under Colours that this browser does not share the device's colour and the city's colours show; Device accent and Map colours show the same primary
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-13: "the feature to follow the OS accent colours (and others available) is the new default" (track/osaccent; DECISIONS-for-review.md §215). packages/ui/src/theme/device-accent.ts: the city's schemes turned to the accent's OKLCH hue with their WCAG luminance kept; Chrome exposes the device's AccentColor only to an installed app (a tab gets a constant), Safari a constant, Firefox the real one; a page names it with --hcm-device-accent. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/shell/accent.spec.ts. The owner, 2026-11-14: no silent fallback (docs/LESSONS.md 711).

scenarios.title: A browser language the admin does not have keeps the Romanian title and language
scenarios.asserts: a Swedish browser (sv-SE; sv is not in UI_LOCALES) -> the Romanian screens, the tab titled 'Administrarea hărții' and <html lang> ro (never sv, never the English title); de-DE would open Deutsch because de is one of the 25
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (the integrator, 2026-10-24). After the 25 languages (2026-11-12) the unsupported tag is sv-SE, not de-DE. Test: e2e/admin/specs/shell/title.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The measurement id is detected and crash reports are listed
scenarios.asserts: setup.analyticsConfig reads the mock Firebase Management web app config -> measurementId and the public app ids written to the city and the next manifest; telemetry.listGroups fills the Crash reports panel from the mock Error Reporting groups
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Analytics not enabled shows the deep link
scenarios.asserts: a web app config without measurementId -> apiError.analytics.notEnabled with the deep link and explanation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: An unavailable Error Reporting API shows an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: Error Reporting answers 5xx -> apiError.errorReporting.unavailable with Retry; the rest of the card works
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: A server account without the Firebase viewer role gets an actionable message
scenarios.asserts: Firebase Management answers 403 -> apiError.cloud.permission naming roles/firebase.viewer; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6).

scenarios.title: History page views are turned off in the GA4 stream
scenarios.asserts: Turn off history page views (one click, one analytics.edit consent) -> the mock Analytics Admin stream reads pageChangesEnabled false and the card shows it checked
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Create the measurement reports registers the field measurements on the GA4 property
scenarios.asserts: Create the measurement reports (one click, one analytics.edit consent) -> the fake Analytics Admin API's property whose web stream sends the project's measurement id holds the 11 custom dimensions and 3 custom metrics of the field measurements (duration_ms and metric_value in milliseconds) -> the card says 14 created, 0 already there
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §76f (the user's decision of 2026-11-01). Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts (state setup.analytics-reports); units: packages/admin/test/google/analytics-reports.test.ts, packages/admin/test/setup/analytics.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Creating the measurement reports again creates nothing
scenarios.asserts: a second click (the tab's Analytics token still live: no consent) -> nothing is posted and the card says 0 created, 14 already there
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §76f. Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: No property the account can edit sends the measurement id
scenarios.asserts: the GA4 property belongs to an account the signed-in owner cannot see -> the card's alert says this account cannot edit a Google Analytics property that sends G-E2E0000000; nothing is created
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §76f. Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The Analytics Admin API refusing the account names the role
scenarios.asserts: the fake Analytics Admin API answers 403 -> the card's alert names roles/analytics.editor; nothing is created
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS-for-review.md §76f. Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Without a GA4 stream the setting explains what to enable first
scenarios.asserts: Firebase Management lists no analytics stream -> the card asks to enable Google Analytics first (deep link); nothing patched
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: The crash e-mail switch turns the alert policy on and off
scenarios.asserts: switching crash e-mails off (one click, one consent) -> the mock alert policy reads enabled false; on again -> true
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Crash groups are browsed by period with their details
scenarios.asserts: the crash reports page: 30 days -> telemetry.listGroups lists the groups; a group's detail shows how often, first and last seen, the application and the state, the message as text and the Error Reporting link
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.4; owner: ops-screens). More (the next page) is unit-tested: packages/admin/test/crashes/.

scenarios.title: A disabled Error Reporting API is explained on the page
scenarios.asserts: telemetry.listGroups answers apiError.cloud.apiDisabled -> the page says Error Reporting is not enabled, links to the analytics card of Setup and offers Try again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.4; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A request this browser cannot send names its host
scenarios.asserts: the network refuses analyticsadmin.googleapis.com with no HTTP answer (a DNS blocklist, a VPN, a firewall, a failed CORS preflight) -> after the transport's retries the card's alert says the request to analyticsadmin.googleapis.com never left this browser, to allow it in the blocker or change network; never the server's unavailable message; nothing is sent
scenarios.notes: Finding 48 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §81b). Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A new click shows only its own failure
scenarios.asserts: a failed Create the measurement reports, then a click Google refuses -> the card's alert names the role; the earlier failure is gone
scenarios.notes: Finding 49 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §81c). Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A click that works after a failure clears it
scenarios.asserts: Create the measurement reports failed, then the host is allowed -> the next click creates the 14 definitions and the card shows no alert
scenarios.notes: Finding 49 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01; DECISIONS-for-review.md §81c). Finding 48 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/analytics.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Every edit is recorded and one click restores the previous version
scenarios.asserts: History lists the city's changes, each naming the place as it was before; a place's versions show each changed field before and after as text; Revert (asked first) -> history.revert restores the old title
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2; owner: ops-screens). The revert entry and the manifest rebuild: functions/test/history/.

scenarios.title: A version that no longer validates is not restored
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a snapshot that fails today's schema -> apiError.history.invalidSnapshot with the number of problems; the document is unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/history/revert.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The creation entry has nothing to restore
scenarios.asserts: the entry of a create offers no Revert; history.revert of it answers apiError.history.nothingToRestore
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/history/revert.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No client can write or forge history
scenarios.asserts: an admin creating, changing or deleting any history entry with the Firestore SDK is denied; reading it is allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by firebase/rules-tests/test/history.test.ts, for each of the five audited entities.

scenarios.title: A deleted place is restored from History
scenarios.asserts: the Deleted filter lists the deleted place -> Restore (asked first) -> the place is back with its fields
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A refused revert explains why and changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: a version that today's schema refuses -> Revert answers apiError.history.invalidSnapshot with the count, as an alert; the document is unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Another city's changes never reach this city's History
scenarios.asserts: a newer deletion in another city of the same project -> History's recent changes and its Deleted filter do not list it, and the city's few entries offer no Show more; the query asks one city's entries by the cityId each entry carries, and only that city's entries answer it (rules test)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.2, CR-M2c-14; docs/LESSONS.md 149). Also firebase/rules-tests/test/history.test.ts and packages/admin/test/history/history.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer whose tileset was deleted is not restored
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a layer's delete entry after its layer-delete job succeeded -> apiError.history.layerGone; nothing written; while the job still waits, the restore cancels it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.4, CR-M2c-5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A photo restored after the sweep is processed again
scenarios.asserts: history.revert of a photo's delete entry whose public files were swept -> the photo comes back with processing pending, off the public map, and is processed again from its kept original, then shows as before
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.6, CR-M2c-5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A creation is listed by its document's title like the changes beside it
scenarios.asserts: History's recent changes name a created place by the title its creation made (the next entry's version, or the place now), never by its id
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 38).

scenarios.title: A creation of a deleted place, listed alone, keeps its kind and id
scenarios.asserts: with only creations listed, a place created then deleted has no version left to name it and reads as Place and its id
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 38).

scenarios.title: A crash report from the site reaches Cloud Error Reporting, redacted
scenarios.asserts: POST text/plain from an allowed origin -> 204; one ERROR log entry of type ReportedErrorEvent with service viewer (admin for the admin origin), the release and a report location; no query, token or e-mail address in it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A report from an unknown site is refused
scenarios.asserts: Origin not among the viewer and admin origins -> 403 apiError.telemetry.origin; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An error storm is capped
scenarios.asserts: the 11th report of one client within a minute -> 429 apiError.rateLimited with Retry-After; at most the per-minute limits are logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A crash report names the browser and device class, never the User-Agent, and the route
scenarios.asserts: a report from Firefox for iOS with route photo -> the logged event's httpRequest.userAgent is 'Firefox 145 mobile' and hcm.route is photo; the full User-Agent string is nowhere in it
scenarios.notes: The owner's request of 2026-11-12 (crash reports and analytics). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts; packages/shared/src/telemetry/crash-noise.ts.

scenarios.title: A script the browser injected or an aborted fetch is no crash: dropped with its reason
scenarios.asserts: a report of Firefox for iOS's __firefox__ reader script (stack at the page's line 1) and an AbortError -> 204, nothing reaches Error Reporting, the log names the reason (injected, aborted)
scenarios.notes: The Crashes groups of 2026-11-11. The viewer and the admin drop them at the source too (crashNoiseOf). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An oversized report is refused before it is parsed
scenarios.asserts: a body over 16 KiB -> 413 apiError.telemetry.tooLarge; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A malformed report is refused
scenarios.asserts: invalid JSON, an unknown field or a page address with its hash -> 400 apiError.invalidRequest; nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2 (docs/research/M2-interfaces.md §6). Covered by functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: On one origin the page's path tells the admin's crash from the viewer's
scenarios.asserts: a report from a page under /admin/ -> logged as the admin's; from / or a city path -> the viewer's
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A report whose page is not on its own origin is refused
scenarios.asserts: a report whose page names another origin than its Origin header -> refused, nothing logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: hosting). Finding 14 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/telemetry/report-error.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Before Blaze the owner signs in and sets up without any server
scenarios.asserts: a start-up deploy (runtime.json says startUp: the Hosting-only deploy of a new map) calls nothing of the server, the probe included, and the browser logs no console error -> Sign in asks Google for read-only Cloud access with the consent note -> testIamPermissions on the mock proves ownership -> Setup in start-up mode with only the Setup destination; no Firestore, Storage or callable request until the server's installation
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration). Since 2026-10-18 (the live polish of the deployed admin): the start-up deploy, without the probe's CORS error.

scenarios.title: A Hosting-only deploy that does not say start-up still starts the setup
scenarios.asserts: runtime.json without startUp and no server -> the anonymous probe of admin-session gets no answer (the browser logs its error) -> the same start-up sign-in with the read-only consent note
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-ups (2026-10-18). e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A Google account that does not own the project cannot start the setup
scenarios.asserts: testIamPermissions grants nothing and Cloud Functions was never enabled -> adminShell.auth.notOwner naming the project id and Use another Google account (the sign-out); nothing else called
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A set-up map whose server does not answer shows a retry, not the setup
scenarios.asserts: a non-owner, Cloud Functions enabled, the server not answering -> adminShell.backend.down with Try again; once the server answers Try again opens the normal sign-in flow
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A reload in start-up mode keeps the detected steps but no token
scenarios.asserts: reload after billing -> the steps show their state from the app's sessionStorage record, which holds no access token, e-mail address or secret (beside it only Firebase Auth's own session of the tab, never a Google token); the next step asks Google again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A page that needs the server opens Setup in start-up mode
scenarios.asserts: the address #/photos in start-up mode -> Setup with adminShell.route.needsBackend
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: When the server appears the owner claims the map without a click
scenarios.asserts: the mock Cloud Functions list goes from none to every registry function ACTIVE and the server answers -> admin.claim with the in-memory token, no click -> ID token refreshed -> setup.createCity and setup.recordCloud with the start-up results -> normal mode with the full navigation, Setup opens at Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: A partial or failed deployment is shown and nothing is claimed
scenarios.asserts: some functions missing -> the ready and total counts, no claim; one FAILED function -> adminSetup.deploy.failed naming it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Without a live Google token the claim costs one click
scenarios.asserts: the page was reloaded before the server appeared -> Confirm with Google (one click, one read-only consent) -> claimed; nothing claimed before the click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A refused claim is explained and leaves the account without admin rights
scenarios.asserts: admin.claim answers apiError.claim.tokenMismatch or apiError.claim.alreadyClaimed -> its message; no admins document, no claim, Retry or sign-out
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Each step asks Google for its own scope only
scenarios.asserts: the recorded consent requests: read-only Cloud at sign-in in start-up mode, cloud-billing at billing, cloud-platform at provisioning, analytics.edit at the GA4 setting, each with the signed-in account as login hint; daily use after the setup asks for none
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Every consent explains why, for how long, and Google's unverified-app screen
scenarios.asserts: before the sign-in, billing and GA4-stream popups the panel or card shows why, that the permission stays in the tab for at most an hour, and how to continue past the unverified-app screen to the auth domain, in Romanian and English (the admin-l1440-en project)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: An unticked scope stops the step before any Google call
scenarios.asserts: the scope unticked on the consent page -> adminShell.oauth.scopeDenied naming the permission; no Google API called with the token; Retry asks again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A cancelled consent changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel on the consent page of a setup step -> adminShell.oauth.popupClosed; the step is as before
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: Choosing another Google account on the consent page is refused
scenarios.asserts: another account chosen -> adminShell.oauth.wrongAccount; the token is dropped and nothing called with it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A Google access token is never stored or sent elsewhere
scenarios.asserts: after every step no Google access token is found in localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or the address, nor in any request other than to Google and admin.claim
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: One click imports the 57 legacy photos through the photo pipeline
scenarios.asserts: Import the photos (57) (one click) -> 57 photo documents (the 45 of the legacy seed and the old site's 12 additions of 2023) with their legacyId, each original uploaded and processed by photos.onUpload, published once processed with rightsReview kept -> the manifest lists them; input budget 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5); the owner's whole journey (e2e/admin/specs/journey.spec.ts, M2b integration).

scenarios.title: Importing again creates nothing new
scenarios.asserts: a second import -> no new document, no new upload; the city still has 57 legacy photos
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: An interrupted import finishes the missing photos only
scenarios.asserts: the page closed after some uploads -> the next import uploads only the photos without an image and finishes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A photo that fails processing is listed and the rest are imported
scenarios.asserts: one original fails processing -> listed with its apiError.photo reason; the other 56 are imported and published
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2b (docs/research/M2b-interfaces.md §5).

scenarios.title: A photo whose upload event was lost is processed again after two minutes
scenarios.asserts: an upload whose event never arrives -> after two minutes (clock) the import asks photos.reprocess once -> the photo is processed and published; the import does not wait ten minutes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (the first upload sent to a name photos.onUpload ignores; photos.reprocess runs for real).

scenarios.title: A photo still stuck after the second try is listed with the server check
scenarios.asserts: the second event lost too -> listed as not processed because the server did not receive the upload, with a link to the server checks; the other photos imported
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.2; owner: server-bugs). Finding 17 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Covered by e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (the second event lost too: the page's photos.reprocess call is answered without a copy, as the emulators always deliver a server-side copy's event); the failure links the step that grants roles/run.invoker.

scenarios.title: The end of the import is said in a snackbar
scenarios.asserts: the last photo published -> a snackbar All 57 photos are on the map, announced, while Setup moves to the next step
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 19 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: An import that ends with failures says how many and where
scenarios.asserts: a photo failed processing -> a snackbar 56 of 57 photos are on the map with Open, which opens the import card with its list
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §3.1; owner: setup-ux). Finding 19 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy.spec.ts (setup-ux).

scenarios.title: A map that has the first legacy photos is offered the old site's later additions in one click
scenarios.asserts: the bundle grew after an import -> the card says how many photos the map does not have yet and that the ones on it stay as they are, with Import the missing photos (n) -> one click uploads only the new originals and publishes them; the photos already imported are not written; a second run adds nothing
scenarios.notes: The old site's 2023 additions (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md, The 2023 additions; seed/bucharest-2023/). Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-additions.spec.ts (the bundle served as it was before and after the additions).

scenarios.title: Importing again never undoes what the owner did to an imported photo
scenarios.asserts: the owner retitled one imported photo and unpublished another, and the server removed a third -> a later import (from a tab opened before) uploads only the photo the server removed: the title stays, the unpublished photo stays unpublished; a photo a person deleted is never created again (unit tests: the emulator stamps every delete with one fake account)
scenarios.notes: The old site's 2023 additions (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md, The 2023 additions): the import reads each photo's history (kept after a delete) to tell an owner's delete or unpublish from an import that stopped. Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-additions.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A map whose photo has no direction gets the old site's in one click, and the credits name the new author
scenarios.asserts: Parc Ferdinand imported as first migrated (no direction) -> the card says how many directions the old site adds and that the credits lack an author, with Add the old site's directions (1) -> one click, no upload: the photo has the old site's point, bearing 219.1 and field of view 50, another photo's direction is unchanged, the city's credits name Studiourile Buftea; the step is done
scenarios.notes: Directions from the old site (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md; seed/bucharest-2023/corrections.json, legacy/bucharest/corrections.json in the admin bundle). Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-additions.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The owner's own direction and place are never overwritten by the old site's
scenarios.asserts: a tab offers the direction, then the owner aims and moves the photo (a person's change in its history) -> the click leaves the owner's point, bearing and field of view as they are and the step is done; a tab opened afterwards offers no direction
scenarios.notes: Directions from the old site (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md): a correction applies only to a photo whose direction is still the migration's and that no person aimed; its point moves only while no person moved it (unit tests: packages/admin/test/import/legacy-fixes.test.ts). Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-additions.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A tab opened after a release counts the new bundle's photos
scenarios.asserts: the bundle had 3 photos and a tab of the browser read it -> the release grows it to 5 -> a new tab of the same browser offers Import the photos (5); Hosting answers photos.json with Cache-Control no-cache
scenarios.notes: Live finding of 2026-11-08 after deploying 1.0.0+567a5d6: Hosting gave the bundle a day's max-age, so the owner's browser kept the 45-record photos.json after the release grew it to 57 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the 2026-11-08 entry; docs/LESSONS.md). Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-fresh.spec.ts (the e2e Hosting tree's photos.json rewritten between two reads, no route); units: packages/admin/test/import/bundle-fresh.test.ts, scripts/site/test/admin-hosting.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The bundle the browser cached under the old day-long header is never counted
scenarios.asserts: a browser with its HTTP cache on (no route) reads the 3-photo bundle while the e2e Hosting serves it with the old Cache-Control public, max-age=86400 (its test-only cookie) -> Hosting turns to no-cache and the release grows the bundle to 5 -> Setup opens again in the same tab and offers Import the photos (5), never the cached 3; the page asked nothing beyond the loopback
scenarios.notes: Live finding of 2026-11-08 after deploying 1.0.0+567a5d6: Hosting gave the bundle a day's max-age, so the owner's browser kept the 45-record photos.json after the release grew it to 57 (DECISIONS-for-review.md, the 2026-11-08 entry; docs/LESSONS.md). Test: e2e/admin/steps/legacy-fresh.spec.ts (the e2e Hosting tree's photos.json rewritten between two reads; the bad row in a browser of its own, since any route, the firewall's included, turns Chromium's cache off; the old header from e2e/mock-apis/admin-server.ts's hcm-e2e-cache cookie). The review of 6858f8a (2026-11-08): the first version passed without the admin's no-cache read; units: packages/admin/test/import/bundle-fresh.test.ts, scripts/site/test/admin-hosting.test.ts.

scenarios.notes: Since 2026-10-17. scenarios.title: A category in use is deleted only after its places move
scenarios.asserts: Delete on a category used by three places -> the dialog asks where to move them (one choice) -> the places get that category and the category is deleted; without a choice nothing changes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §9.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A category whose places cannot be read is not deleted
scenarios.asserts: a category in use confirmed with a target while the places cannot be read (offline, 30 s without an answer, refused) -> the dialog stays on confirm with the reason, the category survives and its places still name it, no batch is written
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/settings/unread.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/settings/settings.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No client deletes a layer or queues its tileset deletion
scenarios.asserts: an admin deleting a layer document, or creating a layer-delete job, with the Firestore SDK -> denied; layers.delete is the only way
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.4, CR-M2c-3, CR-M2c-6; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A deleted layer's tileset goes after the grace
scenarios.asserts: a layer-delete job past its seven days -> the tileset and its source deleted at Mapbox (fake) with retries, the layer's objects in our bucket deleted, the job succeeded; a layer restored meanwhile -> the job cancelled
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/layer-delete.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23). CR-M2c-13 of docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md.

scenarios.title: A deleted layer's id stays taken until its deletion runs, which spares any newer version
scenarios.asserts: an import of the same label during the grace gets another id; a due deletion waits while an unfinished version holds the id and deletes only the files of the deleted layer's own versions
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Deleting a layer asks Firestore only what its indexes answer
scenarios.asserts: layers.delete checks the layer's unfinished jobs by the indexed status and matches params.layerId or layerId in code -> the layer goes, its tileset deletion waits seven days
scenarios.notes: Lesson 557 (Bucuresti actual could not be deleted, 2026-11-12). Tests: functions/test/layers/delete.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A query on a field exempt from indexing fails in tests as it fails in Firestore
scenarios.asserts: the fake document store refuses a query or count filtering on jobs.params.* (exempt in firebase/firestore.indexes.json) with FAILED_PRECONDITION; a query on status passes
scenarios.notes: Lesson 557: the emulator does not enforce indexes. Tests: functions/test/support/port-fakes.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer deletion that failed for good keeps its scene and its id
scenarios.asserts: a layer-delete job failed after its attempts, its tileset still at Mapbox -> the scene stays imported on every tick and no new layer takes the id, a revert still restores the layer; once another deletion of that id succeeded, both go free
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Test: functions/test/imagery/layer-delete.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A GeoJSON file is previewed and imported as places
scenarios.asserts: a FeatureCollection chosen -> the preview counts new, updated and refused features and shows them on the map -> one category chosen for the uncategorised -> Import -> batched writes; the list and the map show them; one manifest build; inputBudget 3
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Exporting and importing the same file changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Export -> a GeoJSON file of every place (ids, categories, texts, years, links, photos) -> importing it -> 0 new, 0 changed, nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A file that is not GeoJSON is refused before any write
scenarios.asserts: a JPEG, malformed JSON, or a file over 5 MB -> one message, no preview, nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts (a text file); the JPEG, malformed JSON and over-5-MB cases by packages/admin/test/pois/importer.test.ts and geojson.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Invalid features are listed and left out
scenarios.asserts: a MultiPolygon, a position with altitude, an open ring, a position outside the city and an unknown category -> each refused with its reason; the valid features import
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-places.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Markup in imported properties stays text
scenarios.asserts: a title and a description holding HTML -> shown as characters in the preview, stored as text, and the viewer shows the characters, never markup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4, §10.3; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: An import past the 5000-place limit is refused whole
scenarios.asserts: existing plus new places above MAX_POIS -> refused before any write with the numbers
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §7.4; owner: pois).

scenarios.title: Export all writes every place of the city, past the loaded page
scenarios.asserts: 51 places, the list holding 50 -> Export all -> a file of 51, the oldest included
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/pois/import-delete.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/pois.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Importing a city's own file again adds no place past the loaded page
scenarios.asserts: the file of 51 places chosen with the list holding 50 -> 51 unchanged, 0 new, no Import, nothing written
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/pois/import-delete.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/pois.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A place that cannot be read is left out aloud, and a file naming it does not make it twice
scenarios.asserts: a place whose document fails its schema -> Export all goes on and the snackbar says how many it left out; a file feature with that id is refused with its reason and no new place is planned
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/pois/import-reading.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/.

scenarios.title: A file chosen while another one's read waits keeps its own plan
scenarios.asserts: file A's read of the city still waits, the dialog closed or file B chosen -> A's answer, or its giving up after 30 s, changes nothing: the preview holds B's plan under B's name, and a closed dialog stays closed
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/pois/import-reading.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/importer.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Export all that cannot read the places says so and saves nothing
scenarios.asserts: offline, only the cache answers -> after the read's wait the snackbar says nothing was exported; no file, never the cache's part of the city
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/pois/import-delete.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/pois/pois.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Image adjustments preview live and reach the viewer on save
scenarios.asserts: the brightness, contrast and saturation sliders moved -> the admin map's pixel probe changes at once with nothing written -> Save -> adjustments without neutral values; the manifest carries them and the viewer shows the same probe as the admin did
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.2, §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Reset returns every adjustment to neutral
scenarios.asserts: Reset -> all four sliders neutral and the map shows the raw tile live -> Save removes adjustments from the document
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Brightness minimum never passes the maximum
scenarios.asserts: the minimum dragged past the maximum -> it stops at the maximum live, the image is never inverted, and the saved document keeps the minimum at or below the maximum
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Leaving without saving restores the stored look
scenarios.asserts: adjustments moved, then Discard or another page -> the map shows the stored adjustments; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.2; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Keyboard input keeps every adjustment in range
scenarios.asserts: arrows, PageUp, PageDown, Home and End on each slider -> values within LAYER_ADJUSTMENT_RANGES, announced as signed percentages
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.3; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-layers.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: Default opacities preview live and the viewer opens with them
scenarios.asserts: Overlay defaults: a layer to 40 %, the photos to 60 %, a category to 30 % -> each fades live on the settings map (its paint) -> Save -> the layer's opacity, photosOverlay.defaultOpacity and the category's defaultOpacity written; the manifest carries them; the viewer opens with those slider values and the layer's pixel probe
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Since 2026-10-18 (§42a): e2e/admin/specs/settings/map.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer's shown-at-start switch reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Shown at start on -> defaultVisible true -> the viewer starts with the layer shown
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.2; owner: layers-settings). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts (the viewer served the built manifest).

scenarios.title: Unsaved defaults are discarded
scenarios.asserts: sliders moved, then Discard -> the map returns to the stored opacities; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Since 2026-10-18 (§42a): e2e/admin/specs/settings/map.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A visitor's own opacity in the link still wins
scenarios.asserts: a viewer address whose op= gives the layer 90 after its default became 40 % -> the layer shows at 90 % (V23)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Replacing a published photo swaps the image at once and keeps it published
scenarios.asserts: Replace image -> upload with progress -> while it is processed the viewer still shows the old image -> photos.onUpload -> image.sha256 changes in one write, the manifest names the new files and the viewer shows the new thumbnail; the old files are swept later
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: A refused replacement keeps the current image
scenarios.asserts: an HEIC file, or a duplicate of another photo, as the replacement -> the reason is shown and the photo stays published with its image
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: The server keeps a photo's image when its replacement is refused
scenarios.asserts: photos.onUpload refuses an upload for a photo that has an image -> processing stays done, the image is unchanged, replacement records the refusal
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4, CR-M2c-4; owner: photos). Covered by functions/test/photos/replacement.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Cancelling a replacement mid-upload changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: Cancel during the upload -> no new object; the photo and the viewer unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: Replacing with the same file changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: the photo's own file again -> the same derivatives, no new public file, and a note says it is the same image
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §6.4; owner: photos).

scenarios.title: An edit previews live and one Save writes it with its history
scenarios.asserts: a field changed -> the map and the list preview it with nothing written -> Save -> one stamped update (updatedBy, updatedAt) and a history entry with the previous version; the publish status shows updating, then up to date after the manifest build
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: Leaving with unsaved changes asks first
scenarios.asserts: another page, Back, closing the editor or signing out with changes -> Keep editing or Discard; Keep editing keeps the draft and the address; a reload gets the browser's leave prompt
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §2.4; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A change saved by another admin is never overwritten silently
scenarios.asserts: another admin saves the same document -> a banner names them and the time; fields only they changed merge in; for a field both changed, Keep mine or Take theirs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.3; owner: ops-screens). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42c) the banner names the other admin (from admins.list) and when they saved, with the fields in words: e2e/admin/specs/pois/conflict.spec.ts saves as a second admin.

scenarios.title: Invalid fields are shown at the field and nothing is written
scenarios.asserts: a blank Romanian title, an end year before the start, an http link -> each field marked invalid with its message; Save off, its description naming the first problem; nothing written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §1.6, §5.3; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A save while offline keeps the draft
scenarios.asserts: the network gone -> Save says it could not reach the server and keeps every change; Save again once online writes it once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A document deleted elsewhere is not recreated by Save
scenarios.asserts: another admin deletes the open document -> the editor says so and offers Restore (History) or Close; Save is off
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.1; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A document the public map skipped is shown with its issue
scenarios.asserts: the manifest build skips a published document -> Not on the public map lists it with its first issue and a link to its editor
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §5.4; owner: ops-screens). Since 2026-10-18 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §42b) Home lists each skipped document: e2e/admin/specs/ops/skipped.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An empty required field says what to do, at the field and in Save's note
scenarios.asserts: an empty Romanian title reads Add a title in Romanian under the field and Cannot save: add a title in Romanian. beside Save, never the schema's generic words; Save is off
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 37).

scenarios.title: Filling the required field clears its message and Save writes
scenarios.asserts: typing a title removes the field's message and Save's note, and Save writes the title
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 37).

scenarios.title: A new place nobody touched leaves without asking
scenarios.asserts: Add place, a shape chosen, nothing typed or drawn, the category select filled in by default -> another page opens at once, no Discard your changes question
scenarios.notes: Finding 42 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-01): the default category and the first value are no edit. Test: e2e/admin/specs/editing/drafts.spec.ts; also e2e/admin/specs/pois/in-view.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A new place with a typed title asks before leaving
scenarios.asserts: Add place, a title typed -> another page asks Discard your changes first, and nothing is written
scenarios.notes: Finding 42 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/specs/editing/drafts.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A new category with its icon, colour and default opacity reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Add category: label RO and EN (the icon follows the label: Fântâni gives water, no click in the picker; POI_ICONS, labelled in both languages), a colour, 80 % -> Save -> the place editor offers it, the manifest lists it and the viewer's Layers panel shows its swatch and slider at 80 %
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: Reordering categories reorders the viewer's list
scenarios.asserts: a drag, or Move up and Move down -> the order written for each -> the viewer's Places group follows
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: A colour the icon cannot be read on is adjusted
scenarios.asserts: a colour under 3:1 against the white glyph -> a warning and the nearest passing tone proposed; Save keeps a passing colour
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A category named like an overlay gets an id of its own
scenarios.asserts: a label that slugifies to photos or to a layer's id -> a suffixed id; the manifest never reports validation.duplicateId
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings).

scenarios.title: An icon outside the bundled set is kept and explained
scenarios.asserts: a category whose icon is not bundled -> the picker says it is drawn as the pin and keeps it until another is chosen
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A label the icons do not know keeps the pin, and a picked icon stays
scenarios.asserts: a new category labelled with no word the icons know (Corona 1968) -> the pin (DEFAULT_POI_ICON); an icon picked by hand is kept when the label changes to one that would suggest another (Fântâni) and saved
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5, Addendum 2026-10-18 minimum input; owner: layers-settings). The guess itself: packages/admin/test/settings/icon-guess.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The 51st category is refused
scenarios.asserts: at 50 categories Add category is off with the limit named (MAX_POI_CATEGORIES)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §8.5; owner: layers-settings). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts.

scenarios.title: A new city starts with the five starter categories
scenarios.asserts: cities.create and setup.createCity write Building, Street, Square, Church and Monument with both labels, the guessed icons, colours the white glyph reads on and the city's stamp, in the city's transaction
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 35).

scenarios.title: An existing city gets no second set of starter categories
scenarios.asserts: setup.createCity on an existing city and a retried cities.create write no category (a deleted starter category stays deleted)
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 35).

scenarios.title: The place editor adds the starter categories in one click and the new place saves in the first
scenarios.asserts: Add the starter categories writes the five; the Category select lists them with Building chosen, and Save writes the place in it
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 35).

scenarios.title: A city without categories shows how to add one instead of an empty select
scenarios.asserts: no empty Category select and no format text: the field says the city has no categories, offers the starter categories and Add a category, and reads Choose a category; Save's note names the category
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 35).

scenarios.title: Settings adds in one click only the starter categories the city lacks
scenarios.asserts: a city with Biserică and Porturi/Harbours and a layer cladire -> Settings, Place categories, Add the starter categories -> one batch writes Building, Street, Square and Monument after the city's own orders (cladire-2, strada, piata, monument: no id clash with the layer), the snackbar says 4, the list shows them and the action is off with Every starter category is already here
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 41; DECISIONS-for-review.md §78c). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts; units: packages/admin/test/settings/starters.test.ts.

scenarios.title: With every starter category already named, Add the starter categories is off with the reason
scenarios.asserts: categories BISERICA, Străzi/Street, clădire, Piata and Monumente/MONUMENT (case, diacritics and spacing aside; Clădiri would not count as Clădire) -> the action is disabled, Every starter category is already here is shown, Add a category stays on, and no category is written
scenarios.notes: Live manual test of 2026-11-01 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md, finding 41; DECISIONS-for-review.md §78c). Covered by e2e/tour/admin-settings.tour.ts; the matching rule: packages/shared/test/overlays/starter-categories.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The dashboard counts the city and says what waits for an admin
scenarios.asserts: #/home -> the photos, places, categories and layers counts, the photos in rights review, the unpublished photos, the running and failed jobs, each a link to its page; the public map's state; a running job's tile leads to the jobs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-24; owner: ops-screens).

scenarios.title: A service that needs attention is named with its reason
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with Mapbox invalid (a refused token) -> the Mapbox chip says it needs attention, as text, and Open Setup leads to #/setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (CR-M2c-24; owner: ops-screens). A count that cannot be read shows a dash, never a wrong number: packages/ui/test/admin/ops/crashes-home.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Once Setup is complete an empty address opens the dashboard
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with billing, provisioning, Mapbox and USGS ok -> the admin's address without a route opens Home, marked in the navigation; on a phone the bar holds Home, Photos, Places and Layers (Setup under More); after a reload the browser remembers it and Home opens at once
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34i; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/app/navigation.test.ts, setup-readiness.test.ts.

scenarios.title: While Setup is not complete an empty address still opens Setup
scenarios.asserts: setup/status with USGS pending -> the address without a route opens Setup, marked in the navigation; on a phone Setup keeps its place on the bar and Home stays under More; finishing Setup's last required step later leaves the admin on Setup
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c follow-up (DECISIONS-for-review.md §34i; owner: ops-screens). e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; the last step's case: packages/admin/test/app/navigation.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A photo published and renamed in the admin shows in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: the photo editor: Published on, Save -> the build publishes the photo; a new Romanian title, Save -> the manifest in the public bucket carries it -> the viewer served that manifest opens the photo's link with the new title
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A revert from History reaches the viewer
scenarios.asserts: History of the photo: the rename's version -> Revert, asked first -> history.revert brings the old title back -> the next manifest carries it -> the viewer shows the old title
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A place added from its list of positions shows in the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Add place, Point, Add at centre, the latitude and longitude typed, the Romanian title, Save -> published on save -> the manifest lists the point -> the viewer draws it in its category and opens its details on a click
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A layer's defaults and image adjustments reach the viewer
scenarios.asserts: the layer editor: Shown at start on, Default opacity 60 % and saturation -100 % from the keyboard, Save -> the document and the manifest carry opacity 0.6, defaultVisible and adjustments {saturation: -1} -> the viewer starts with the layer shown, its slider at 60 %, and a pixel probe reads the tile's colour desaturated at 60 % over the basemap
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: An unpublished photo leaves the viewer
scenarios.asserts: Published off, Save -> the next manifest no longer lists the photo -> the viewer's link to it says the photo does not exist and opens nothing
scenarios.notes: Milestone M2c (docs/research/M2c-interfaces.md §12.3 "Admin to viewer"; owner: integrator). e2e/admin/specs/flows/publish.spec.ts

scenarios.title: A publish within the month's compute units is counted
scenarios.asserts: a publish that fits -> its estimate reserved in usage/mapbox-YYYY-MM, counted when the MTS job succeeds (the reservation released), publishes + 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A publish over the month's compute units waits with three choices
scenarios.asserts: the estimate exceeds what is left -> the approval card shows the estimate, what is left and three choices (free Studio upload, next month, pay about $X); nothing reaches Mapbox
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/publish.spec.ts. A version the policy approved and the guard stopped shows the choices (CR-M3-33).

scenarios.title: The free Studio upload replaces the MTS publish
scenarios.asserts: Free: Studio -> download the Studio file, open Mapbox Studio, 'I uploaded it' -> the tileset found by its name becomes the layer's source; studioUploads + 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: e2e-fakes; the integrator, 2026-10-24). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/publish.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A deferred publish runs next month

scenarios.title: The 25th tileset needs the owner

scenarios.title: Two publishes never share the same remaining units
scenarios.asserts: two approvals at once whose estimates fit only one -> the second waits with the choices (the reservations are one transaction)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: fn-imagery). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish.test.ts (fn-imagery, 2026-10-23).

scenarios.title: A redelivered or recovered start never publishes twice
scenarios.asserts: a second start of a publish with its MTS job polls it; one whose answer was lost follows the job Mapbox lists instead of publishing again; the tick queues a stale job once (stale-<ms>), not every five minutes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A publish that keeps failing stops at its attempts
scenarios.asserts: after PUBLISH_MAX_ATTEMPTS starts the job fails apiError.imagery.attemptsExhausted and frees its reservation, and imagery.retry refuses it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Two first publishes never both take the last tileset place
scenarios.asserts: the reservation of a first publish, read in the guard's transaction, and a deleted layer's tileset waiting for its deletion count against the cap
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A file too large for Mapbox goes back to the admin with the free Studio way
scenarios.asserts: a 413 on the source upload sets the version approved with the guard's verdict too-large, frees the reservation and uploads nothing more; only Studio may be chosen; without a Studio copy the job fails
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: The layer's own tileset, or one older than the choice, is not a Studio upload
scenarios.asserts: I uploaded it answers apiError.imagery.studioNotFound for the layer's MTS tileset and for a tileset created before the choice; a newer one is linked
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A budget pause shows the spend and Resume processing turns the guard green
scenarios.asserts: the Imagery and Jobs pages show the paused guard with the cost and the budget; Resume processing asks first, then the banner goes, ops/guard is green with who resumed it, and an Import starts
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: While the guard is paused an import is refused with why
scenarios.asserts: Import on a free scene shows apiError.guardPaused and starts no run while the banner says processing is paused
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: The resume accepts the budget period's spend
scenarios.asserts: imagery.resumeGuard turns the guard green with resumedBy and resumedFor; the same period's alerts leave it green, the next period's turn it red with their spend; a paused publish is queued once the guard is green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A resume of a guard that is not paused changes nothing
scenarios.asserts: a green or missing guard is left as it is and the call answers green
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: A burst of budget notifications has room without a warm instance

scenarios.notes: Finding 45 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (Crashes group of ops-onbudget, 2026-10-26..29). Test: functions/test/ops/budget.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The same budget alert delivered again turns the guard red and notifies once

scenarios.notes: Finding 45 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: functions/test/ops/budget.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A rejected or unaccepted suggestion is never saved

scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.5; owner: autogcp). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/suggestions.spec.ts against the emulators and the stand-in runner's `suggestions` outcome (e2e-admin).

scenarios.title: Title suggestions go through the queue one a second and are cached
scenarios.asserts: two admins asking the same cell -> one task (the cell's id), one Nominatim call with the app's User-Agent at the cell's centre, the cell ready with at most three plain-text suggestions and the licence; a second ask answers from the cache; the queue's rate limits are one a second, one at a time

scenarios.title: A Nominatim refusal cools every request down for ten minutes
scenarios.asserts: a 429 -> the cell failed with apiError.assist.rateLimited and ops/assist.nominatimCoolUntil ten minutes later; another cell asked meanwhile answers failed without a task; after the cool-down it is queued again
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: assists-notify). In functions/test/assist/geocode.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Past the day's cap of title suggestions nothing more is queued

scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §4.2; owner: assists-notify). In functions/test/assist/geocode.test.ts; the editor's wait for a queued cell ends after GEOCODE_QUEUED_MINUTES (packages/admin/test/assist/assist.test.ts).
