scenarios.title: An admin of one city sees the shell as before
scenarios.asserts: an admin of Bucharest only: no switcher, addresses without #/c/, every M2 to M4 route unchanged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/switcher.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A link to a city the admin does not administer opens their own
scenarios.asserts: #/c/<other>/photos -> the admin's own city with adminShell.city.notMember; no listen or read on the other city's documents (the recorded Firestore requests)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/switcher.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Switching with an unsaved draft asks first
scenarios.asserts: an edited, unsaved photo -> the unsaved-changes dialog; Cancel keeps the draft, Discard switches
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/switcher.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An admin of two cities lands on their city's dashboard once Setup is complete
scenarios.asserts: an owner of two cities, setup/status complete, a browser that does not know it yet -> the empty address waits for Setup's answer, then opens Home at #/c/<city>/home (never #/setup first)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 review fix (docs/LESSONS.md 257; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/app/city-navigation.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An admin of two cities still opens Setup while it is not complete
scenarios.asserts: an owner of two cities, setup/status not complete -> the empty address opens Setup, marked in the navigation, and the address stays empty (Setup names no city)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 review fix (docs/LESSONS.md 257; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/ops/ops.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/app/city-navigation.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The project owner creates a city in two inputs
scenarios.asserts: New city opened on another city: the Romanian name (the id follows it; once typing rests, cities.locate finds the city on the mock Nominatim, its rectangle is drawn, named and the map flies to it), Create the city -> the city exists unpublished with the found rectangle's start view, the default seed's theme and the new-city limits, its creator as owner; the done screen's heading takes the focus and the page's live region says it was created; the city menu lists it at once; input budget newCity 2
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts, functions/test/cities/create.test.ts. The M5 UX review (docs/LESSONS.md 251, 252, 255): two inputs from any map view; Test also functions/test/cities/locate.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A name OpenStreetMap does not know: the owner drags the rectangle
scenarios.asserts: the map's Zoom out and Zoom in buttons move the New city map; a name the mock Nominatim does not know draws nothing; one rectangle dragged on the map, Create the city -> the city exists; input budget newCityDrawn 3
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's findings 2 and 3. Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The new city's first USGS harvest runs at the next tick
scenarios.asserts: a city without a harvest state is due: imagery.tick harvests its bounds once and writes its usgsScenes; the flow itself calls no harvest
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/harvest.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A retried create answers that the city exists
scenarios.asserts: cities.create of a city that exists and is owned by the caller -> {created: false}; nothing is written
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A taken id is refused with a suggestion
scenarios.asserts: an id another city uses -> apiError.city.idTaken naming <id>-2; the id field holds the suggestion; nothing is overwritten
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts, functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A rectangle too large or too small cannot be created
scenarios.asserts: wider than 2 degrees or narrower than 0.01 -> Create the city is off and the reason sits beside the map; cities.create refuses the same with validation.tooBig or validation.tooSmall
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Only the project owner creates cities
scenarios.asserts: an admin who is not the project owner sees no New city; cities.create -> apiError.city.notProjectOwner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.3, §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A project holds at most twenty cities
scenarios.asserts: the twenty-first cities.create -> apiError.city.tooMany {max: 20}
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A reserved id is refused
scenarios.asserts: cities.create with the id engine -> apiError.invalidRequest with validation.value at cityId
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.6; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A name nothing has finds no rectangle
scenarios.asserts: cities.locate of a name Nominatim does not know, or while its cool-down holds, or when it fails -> bounds null (the admin draws); a refusal (429) starts the shared cool-down; only the project's owner locates; the name is never logged
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 3. Test: functions/test/cities/locate.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An id no city may take is said at its field
scenarios.asserts: the id engine typed -> adminContent.cities.new.idInvalid at the field (aria-invalid, aria-describedby), Create off; the field emptied takes the name's suggestion again and Create is on
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 6. Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Edges typed in part wait for the others, and keep them
scenarios.asserts: two edges typed -> adminContent.cities.new.edgesIncomplete, no alert and no rectangle; four make it and Create is on; one cleared keeps the other three and Create is off; a west beyond east -> adminContent.cities.new.areaBounds
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The UX review's finding 12. Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/new-city.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A city owner invites an editor to one city
scenarios.asserts: Admins of the second city: Invite, the address, Invite -> the link is copied; the invited account joins and sees that city only (no switcher), and Bucharest's Admins does not list it
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/members.spec.ts, functions/test/admin/join.test.ts, functions/test/admin/list.test.ts, functions/test/admin/revoke.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An owner makes an editor an owner
scenarios.asserts: the editor's row, Owner, confirm -> admins.setRole; the new owner sees Invite
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/members.spec.ts, functions/test/admin/set-role.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Admins from before M5 keep every city
scenarios.asserts: an admins document without cities gets every existing city at its first admin.session (the project owner as owner, every other admin as editor); ops.tick fills in the others
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.2; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/admin/session.test.ts, functions/test/ops/memberships.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A pending invitation from before M5 gets the cities of now
scenarios.asserts: ops.tick's memberships step, and cities.create before it makes a city, give a pending invitation without cities every existing city as an editor (stamped system:cities), never a city made after it; one converted or accepted meanwhile is left as it is
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 4 (docs/LESSONS.md 245). Test: functions/test/ops/memberships.test.ts, functions/test/cities/create.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city's events reach only its admins
scenarios.asserts: notify.onEvent of an event about the second city writes inbox items for its members only; a project event (budget.paused) reaches every admin
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.9; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/notify/fan-out.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An editor of one city reads and writes nothing of another
scenarios.asserts: an editor of the second city is denied get, list and write on cities/bucharest and every subcollection, Bucharest's history, manifests/bucharest, its harvest state, and Storage reads and uploads under bucharest/; the same requests on the second city are allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: multi-city). Test: firebase/rules-tests/test/cities.test.ts, firebase/rules-tests/test/storage.test.ts.

scenarios.title: History's collection-group query is kept to the admin's cities
scenarios.asserts: where cityId == bucharest by an editor of the second city -> denied; where cityId == the second city -> allowed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: multi-city). Test: firebase/rules-tests/test/cities.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Every city callable refuses a non-member
scenarios.asserts: each callable of the registry that takes a cityId, called for a city the caller is not in -> apiError.city.notMember before any read or write
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.3; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/admin/list.test.ts, functions/test/api/callable.test.ts, functions/test/cities/access.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An editor cannot invite or remove
scenarios.asserts: an editor's Admins page has no Invite and no Remove; admins.invite by an editor -> apiError.city.notOwner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/members.spec.ts, functions/test/admin/invite.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city keeps at least one owner
scenarios.asserts: removing or demoting the city's last owner -> apiError.city.lastOwner; nothing changes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/admin/set-role.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Two owners changing each other at once leave the city an owner
scenarios.asserts: two owners demoting (or removing) each other at the same time on the Firestore emulator -> one succeeds, the other is refused, and the city keeps exactly one owner; a change from a stale read never brings back a membership just taken away; an owner demoted after the access check changes nothing (apiError.city.notOwner)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 3 (docs/LESSONS.md 243). Test: functions/test/admin/set-role.test.ts, functions/test/admin/revoke.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The project's owner stays an owner of their cities
scenarios.asserts: admins.setRole or admins.revoke of the project's owner in a city they own -> apiError.city.projectOwnerStays, nothing changes; their row on the Admins page has no Remove and a disabled role field
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 3. Test: functions/test/admin/set-role.test.ts, functions/test/admin/revoke.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No client writes a membership
scenarios.asserts: a client write of admins/{uid}.cities, its own included -> denied
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.4; owner: multi-city). Test: firebase/rules-tests/test/identity.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The project owner sets a city's share of the budgets
scenarios.asserts: Settings, the city's budget of a city held by the project's caps alone (it says so; its fields empty): compute units a month and jobs a day typed, Save -> cities.setLimits; the snackbar says it was saved, the city's document holds those two and the maxima for the three left empty, and they are read back after a reload without the caps' note; input budget setCityLimits 1 + 1 per field moved
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: multi-city). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/budgets.spec.ts, functions/test/cities/set-limits.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A publish over the city's share waits; the other cities' do not
scenarios.asserts: an estimate over the city's share but within the project's -> the version waits with apiError.city.budgetReached and the over-budget offers; a Bucharest publish of the same size goes through
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/limits.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city's daily raster jobs are capped by its share
scenarios.asserts: the fourth import of the day in a city whose share is 3 -> apiError.imagery.dailyLimit {limit: 3}
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/imagery/import.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Only the project owner sets budgets
scenarios.asserts: cities.setLimits by a city owner -> apiError.city.notProjectOwner; that owner's Settings shows the budget read-only with adminContent.budgets.ownerOnly
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.8; owner: multi-city). Test: functions/test/cities/set-limits.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No client writes a city's limits or usage
scenarios.asserts: a client update of cities/{city}.limits or a write to cities/{city}/usage/* -> denied
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §1.4, §1.8; owner: multi-city). Test: firebase/rules-tests/test/cities.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city owner exports the city in two inputs
scenarios.asserts: Settings, Export the city: Export -> queued, building, then ready with its size, counts and SHA-256; Download -> <city>-<date>.zip holding index.html, city.json, README.md, RIGHTS.md, engine/ and photos/; input budget exportCity 2; as Export starts its button goes and the focus stays on the card's heading, and the card's one live region says how the export goes
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.6; owner: export). Test: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: With the scans, the USGS layers' COGs travel and an upload's does not
scenarios.asserts: rasters true -> rasters/<layer>.tif for each USGS layer; an uploaded layer travels only as its tile reference, and README.md says why
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.2; owner: export). Test: functions/test/export/build.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The photos licensed for this map only are named
scenarios.asserts: the permission and permission-legacy photos are in the zip and listed in RIGHTS.md; counts.restrictedPhotos matches and the card says so
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.1, §5.2; owner: export). Test: functions/test/export/build.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A second export while one runs is refused
scenarios.asserts: while an export builds, Export is off with adminContent.export.building; export.start -> apiError.export.busy
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: export). Test: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An export over 2 GB fails cleanly
scenarios.asserts: files over EXPORT_LIMITS.maxBytes -> failed with apiError.export.tooLarge {size, max}; the partial object is deleted
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3, §5.4; owner: export). Test: functions/test/export/build.test.ts; the card’s reason: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An expired export offers Export again
scenarios.asserts: an export past its seven days -> Expired with Export again; export.download -> apiError.export.expired
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.5, §5.6; owner: export). Test: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A city never published cannot be exported
scenarios.asserts: no manifest in the public bucket -> the card says to publish first; export.start -> apiError.export.noManifest
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: export). Test: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: An editor cannot export
scenarios.asserts: export.start or export.download by an editor -> apiError.city.notOwner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: export). Test: functions/test/export/start.test.ts, download.test.ts; the editor’s read-only card: e2e/admin/specs/export/export.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A city's daily exports are capped
scenarios.asserts: the fourth export of the day (the default share is 3) -> apiError.export.dailyLimit {limit: 3}
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3; owner: export). Test: functions/test/export/start.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An export is signed at most ten times a day, never while the guard is red
scenarios.asserts: the eleventh export.download of an export in a UTC day -> apiError.export.downloadLimit {limit: 10}, nothing signed; the day's count is logged, never the address; a red budget guard -> apiError.guardPaused
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 6 (docs/LESSONS.md 246). Test: functions/test/export/download.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A style address whose host would end a policy directive adds none
scenarios.asserts: a basemap style `https://a.example.org;connect-src/...` -> left out of the export page's policy, whose base-uri stays 'none' and which names no telemetry host; the manifest schema and the Firestore rules refuse such a host
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5, the reviews' fixes (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §65; owner: the fixer). The security review's finding 7 (docs/LESSONS.md 241). Test: functions/test/export/documents.test.ts, firebase/rules-tests/test/cities.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The export's README and RIGHTS are written in English only
scenarios.asserts: an export's README.md opens with '# <the city's English name>: static export (<day>)', its preface in English and no Romanian section, then the kit's README; RIGHTS.md is titled 'Rights' with the header row '| Photo | Title | Rights holder | Licence |' and lists a photo under its English title (the Romanian one when it has none)
scenarios.notes: The owner's rule of 2026-11-10: all project Markdown in English only (docs/research/DECISIONS-for-review.md §157). Test: functions/test/export/documents.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city name with Markdown characters stays plain text in the README's title
scenarios.asserts: a city whose English name holds '#', '|' and '*' -> the README's first line is one heading with each character escaped, never a table, a second heading or emphasis
scenarios.notes: DECISIONS §157 moved the title to the English name. Test: functions/test/export/documents.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Exports are the server's
scenarios.asserts: a client write to cities/{city}/exports/*, or a read by another city's admin -> denied; the city's members read them
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.3, CR-M5-11; owner: export, the rules multi-city's; landed by the integrator). Test: firebase/rules-tests/test/cities.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A photo the city may not redistribute never travels
scenarios.asserts: a photo without a licence (unknown) or not published is not in the published manifest, so its files are never read and the zip carries only the manifest's photos; the ones licensed for this map only are named in RIGHTS.md
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (docs/research/M5-interfaces.md §5.2; owner: export; added by the export workstream). Test: functions/test/export/build.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A city made in the admin gets its own public site, and its export runs with no Firebase
scenarios.asserts: the project's owner makes a city with New city (the name, its id, the area typed, Create) -> cities.create; Settings -> Publishing: the switch and Save (the publishCity budget, 2), the state checked; the server builds its manifest with its published photo; site:add's writer and build:site's builder with the public bucket named make its public site, which boots that city (hcm-ready with its id and one photo, one map, its name as the title) from the manifest the server built; Settings -> Export the city: Export, Download; the zip unpacked on a plain static server boots the same city with the engine of the zip and no Firebase, Google or jsDelivr request
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (the integrator's cross-app check; DECISIONS-for-review.md §63). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/city-journey.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Switched off in Settings, a city's public map goes: its site says it is not published
scenarios.asserts: a published city with its manifest built: Settings -> Publishing, the switch off and Save -> the server removes cities/<city>/manifest.json from the public bucket; the city's public site then says error.manifest.notFound with Try again, no map created
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (the integrator's cross-app check; DECISIONS-for-review.md §63). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/city-journey.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Another city's admin reaches nothing of a new city: its documents, its files and its callables refuse them
scenarios.asserts: the owner of another city, with their own ID token outside the app: reading the city, its photo and its export record, unpublishing it (Firestore), downloading its export zip and uploading into its folder (Storage) -> 403; export.start, export.download and admins.invite for it -> 403 apiError.city.notMember; their own city reads 200; nothing of the city changed
scenarios.notes: Milestone M5 (the integrator's cross-app check; DECISIONS-for-review.md §63). Test: e2e/admin/specs/cities/city-journey.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: One click installs the map's server through Cloud Build
scenarios.asserts: Install the server (one click, no consent within the hour of Prepare the project) -> the mock Cloud Build gets one build as hcm-installer@ tagged hcm-install and the release, with the steps fetch (the manifest's SHA-256 the page computed), tools, packages (npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts in server/functions/dist, the functions' source firebase-tools loads), rules, functions (--force) and verify -> the card shows queued, the step under way, the functions' count once, then installed with the release -> the claim follows with no click; input budget 1
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.4.1, §1.7, §1.8; owner: installer). Finding 9, 10 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/install/server.spec.ts (installer).

scenarios.title: A first-deploy race is retried inside the build without a click
scenarios.asserts: the fake build logs an HCM_INSTALL retry line for Eventarc's service agent -> the card says Google is still preparing it and when it tries again -> installed; nothing asked of the owner
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.5; owner: installer). Finding 12 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/install/server.spec.ts (installer).

scenarios.title: A server older than the admin's bundle offers Update
scenarios.asserts: functions whose HCM_RELEASE is older than the admin's release -> Setup's card and Home's tile say an update is ready -> Update the map (one click and one consent in daily use) -> a server build of the admin's release -> installed and the tile gone
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: installer). Finding 10 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/install/update.spec.ts (installer).

scenarios.title: A failed install names its step and shows the end of its log
scenarios.asserts: the build fails at the functions step -> the card names the step, shows the step's last log lines as text with a planted ya29 token and sk token redacted, links the build in the Google Cloud console -> Try again (one input) submits one new build of the same release
scenarios.notes: Milestone M6 (docs/research/M6-interfaces.md §1.7; owner: installer). Finding 10 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. Test: e2e/admin/steps/install/server.spec.ts (installer).

scenarios.title: A project prepared before the actAs grant stops at firebase-tools' check, and step c fixes it
scenarios.asserts: the installer lacks Service Account User on the App Engine default account -> the server build stops at its functions step with firebase-tools' 'Missing permissions required for functions deploy ... iam.serviceAccounts.ActAs' -> the card says to choose Retry what failed in step c, then Try again, and offers that button (step c's iam item names the reason; c's chip stays, so the card stays open) -> Retry what failed in step c (one click, no consent within the hour) reruns the iam item and grants it on that account only -> Try again installs the server

scenarios.title: A frame is stitched without ever being held whole in memory
scenarios.asserts: six overlapping 8-bit segments of a 5000 by 4000 frame -> each placed exactly (offsets 800 px apart) in frame.json with a shrunk frame-preview.tif, the joined size exact, and the step allocating under half the frame (two segments staged at a time, windows and strips only)

scenarios.asserts: the right segment's left strip copied exactly at a fifth of the left segment (an 80 % overlap) and the true overlap grainy -> the pair's offset is the true one (800, 0): the coarse search looks only in the left segment's last 35 % (USGS overlaps are 4 to 20 %)
scenarios.notes: Finding 76 of 2026-11-03 (docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md): the 1972 KH-9 frame, snow-covered, had segment d joined 46 % inside c. In pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py.

scenarios.title: A copy of the next segment's edge far above its place does not shift the frame

scenarios.notes: Finding 83 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the 1972 frame's false 2,774 px step). In pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py.

scenarios.title: A strip scanned right to left is joined whole, both halves

In pipeline/tests/unit/test_stitch_order.py; the generator is pipeline/tests/synthetic/scenes.py (`kh7_segments`, `scanner_edges`, `SceneSpec.right_to_left`).

scenarios.title: A wide Corona segment's overlap is found however far it reaches

scenarios.notes: Lesson 645. In pipeline/tests/unit/test_stitch_order.py.

scenarios.title: A panoramic frame is found through its camera's forward model
scenarios.asserts: a synthetic KH-9 film made through the panoramic model (theta linear over the exposure, along (tan(theta) - tan(a)) / (tan(b) - tan(a)), across over the bilinear width), its corners 3.3 km off -> the model round-trips within 0.001 px and takes the film's corners to the ground's, the local homography holds it within 100 m at the window's corners, the chain proves the right orientation of four; a film half as long swept half the angle, off the nadir as its ends' widths say (the 1982 frame: -8 to 53 degrees); only a sensor with a half angle gets the model
scenarios.notes: Lesson 361 of docs/LESSONS.md (the rehearsal on the 1972 frame D3C1202-200149F039), docs/research/M9-calibration.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_panoramic.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py.

scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §6 replaces the review of 2026-11-06. Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py.

scenarios.title: On a worker, a frame nothing proved keeps its delivery
scenarios.asserts: a worker's run whose frame nothing proves -> the bounded crop is recorded and the USGS delivery stays; no line says it is deleted
scenarios.notes: Live 2026-11-14 (DS1111-1020AF035); docs/LESSONS.md, docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §5. Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py.

scenarios.title: A window off the frame is the one failure left
scenarios.asserts: corners that put the frame 100 km from the window, or 1 degree off in a whole import, or a window past the exposure's end over its dark gap and the next exposure's fragment -> no orientation reaches it, searched around too: CityNotFoundError, the job and the version failed with apiError.imagery.cityNotFound, whose message no longer blames the corners, and nothing is cropped; a crop beside the end stops at the exposure
scenarios.notes: Lesson 361 of docs/LESSONS.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_panoramic.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_written_documents.py (city-off-frame).

scenarios.title: The frame's preview averages what it shrinks, and records where the exposure ends
scenarios.asserts: film grain of alternating columns -> the preview's shrink is their mean while the coarse matching's read stays a pick of pixels; a dark run of 2 % of the width after the first half -> frame.json's image_end, the layout's width unchanged; no such run, a short one or one in the first half, or a frame.json from before the field -> the whole width; the scoring frame is blurred and never enlarged past its preview
scenarios.notes: Lesson 361 of docs/LESSONS.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py.

scenarios.title: The exposure is found whichever way the film was scanned
scenarios.asserts: a frame's dark gap and the next exposure's fragment on either side, or both -> frame.json records image_start and image_end, the panoramic model counts from the exposure's first column, and a frame flipped left to right is found on its own exposure; an old frame.json reads start 0 and end the width
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Lesson 361; the real frame flipped four ways keeps ratio 2.09 to 2.10 and z 8.7. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_panoramic.py.

scenarios.title: A dark band inside the film does not end the exposure
scenarios.asserts: a dark run with more than a fragment (10 % of the width) of film beyond it (a sea, a cloud's shadow), or one taking the film's middle -> no exposure end there, and it does not hide a real gap after it
scenarios.notes: Review of 2026-11-06, integrated. Calibrated on the 1972 frame alone. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_frames.py.

scenarios.title: Every document the pipeline writes has a shape the shared schemas accept
scenarios.asserts: the real runner along ten paths (whole import, two phases, USGS preparing, not scanned, a size mismatch, a corrupt archive, cancelled, no pairs, corners far off, the city not found) -> every job, version and log document after every write has a shape of pipeline/tests/contracts/written-documents.json, which holds exactly those shapes; the shared contract test parses each of its documents with jobDocSchema, layerVersionDocSchema and jobLogDocSchema, and every pipeline error code is one the admin reads
scenarios.notes: Finding 62 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-02; DECISIONS-for-review.md §84a). Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_written_documents.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/pipeline-contract.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A step failure's numeric parameters are written as text
scenarios.asserts: a step fails with {min: 6} -> the job's and the version's error params read {min: '6'} (apiErrorParamsSchema takes texts only; a number made both unreadable in the admin); a truncated delivery -> the version's {bytes} is text
scenarios.notes: Finding 62 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (live test 2026-11-02; DECISIONS-for-review.md §84a). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_written_documents.py (size-mismatch).

scenarios.title: USGS maintenance makes the pipeline wait and exit
scenarios.asserts: the HTML 503 from M2M -> waiting_usgs with retryAt 30 minutes later (then doubling, at most 12 hours), exit 0, no failure
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: An expired download address is retrieved again, never logged
scenarios.asserts: the download address answers 403 -> download-retrieve again and the stream resumes; the signed address appears in no log line and no Firestore field
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A short delivery is discarded
scenarios.asserts: the body is shorter than the transfer size (the larger of download-options and Content-Length) -> apiError.imagery.downloadIncomplete, the object discarded, fetched again on the next attempt; a Landsat bundle larger than the announced filesize is kept (S-P30-HAPPY-BUNDLE-SIZE)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_resume.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_steps_fetch.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A dropped download resumes from the bytes already held
scenarios.asserts: the delivery host closes the connection after two chunks with Content-Length announcing the whole file (RemoteProtocolError) -> fetch asks again with Range from the bytes the session holds and the object equals the delivery
scenarios.notes: Lesson 705 (2026-11-14, live: a Landsat fetch failed at 1.20 of 1.23 GB with RemoteProtocolError). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_steps_fetch.py (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A download that keeps dropping fails and keeps its bytes for a retry
scenarios.asserts: the connection drops DROP_ATTEMPTS times in a row -> apiError.imagery.downloadIncomplete naming the dropped connection; the checkpoint keeps its upload session so a retry continues from the bytes held
scenarios.notes: Lesson 705 (2026-11-14, live: a Landsat fetch failed at 1.20 of 1.23 GB with RemoteProtocolError). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_steps_fetch.py (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A second execution of a leased job does nothing
scenarios.asserts: a second execution while the lease is held -> exit 0 without touching the job
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A georeferenced upload is warped with its own georeference
scenarios.asserts: geotiff-import of a georeferenced GeoTIFF -> inspect finds its georeference (embedded) -> warp, export, register; the version awaits approval
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_upload_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A plain TIFF waits for points
scenarios.asserts: geotiff-import of a TIFF without georeference -> the scan, its preview and the reference written; the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_upload_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A GDAL failure on the pipeline's own files is a processing failure; only an unreadable upload asks for the file again
scenarios.asserts: a corrupt USGS segment fails apiError.imagery.processingFailed; an upload GDAL cannot read fails apiError.imagery.unreadableRaster
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3, CR-M3-47 (the M3 security and minimum-input reviews).

scenarios.title: Re-georeferencing with manual GCPs produces a new version
scenarios.asserts: regeoref with the admin's points -> a new version whose residuals and checkpoint RMSE are those of the exact golden cases (0 within 0.01 m, pipeline/tests/contracts/georef-cases.json), awaiting approval; the base version's scan reused unchanged, no USGS call
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A degenerate GCP set fails with an error
scenarios.asserts: collinear or coincident pairs -> the job failed at georef with apiError.imagery.degenerateGcps (imagery.saveGcps refuses them first)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A crop ring cuts the layer
scenarios.asserts: regeoref with a crop ring -> gdalwarp -cutline; the COG is transparent (nodata) outside the ring
scenarios.notes: Milestone M3 (docs/research/M3-interfaces.md §11; owner: pipeline). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_regeoref_job.py against the loopback fakes (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A synthetic Corona frame: confident pairs fit, the rest are suggestions
scenarios.asserts: georef.gcps all at or above AUTO_GCP_MIN_CONFIDENCE with score and residualM; a fifth held out as checkpoints gives checkpointRmseM within the truth's tolerance; suggestions between AUTO_GCP_SUGGEST_MIN and the confidence, at most MAX_SUGGESTIONS, best first, shaped as version.needs-gcps.suggestions.json; the same seed gives the same pairs
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1–§2.4; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Too few SIFT keypoints: ORB matches instead
scenarios.asserts: a faded synthetic scan (contrast 5 %) where SIFT finds fewer than the minimum keypoints -> suggestions.method orb and the frame still placed within the truth's tolerance (checkpoint RMSE and the fit against the exact map)
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A cloudy Sentinel-2 window: OpenStreetMap's lines still place the frame
scenarios.asserts: the Sentinel-2 reference under cloud from edge to edge -> channels include osm, tiles matched on the distance field, the frame placed within the truth's tolerance by OpenStreetMap's lines
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.1; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Fewer than six confident pairs: the version waits with every candidate suggested
scenarios.asserts: the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noMatch {pairs} and suggestions holding every candidate at or above AUTO_GCP_SUGGEST_MIN, confident ones included; nothing warped
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: Enough confident pairs in a line wait with their own reason
scenarios.asserts: eight confident pairs along one road give no fit -> the job awaiting_gcps, the version needs_gcps with apiError.imagery.noSpread {pairs: 8} (not noMatch's too few) and every candidate suggested; the georeferencer's panel says the pairs lie almost in a line
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py (pipeline-pytest); the panel in packages/ui/test/admin/georef/suggestions-panel.test.ts. Added by the 2026-10-24 review fixes (DECISIONS-for-review.md §57).

scenarios.title: A blank scan gives no pairs and no suggestions
scenarios.asserts: a uniform synthetic scan -> tiles matched 0, no suggestion pairs, the version waits for points with noMatch {pairs: 0}; no exception
scenarios.notes: Milestone M4 (docs/research/M4-interfaces.md §2.3; owner: autogcp). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py against the loopback fakes and the synthetic world through an exact affine map (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: The Jobs page shows the connected computer and the command to start a worker
scenarios.asserts: a worker seen a minute ago -> Your computer is connected with its last job; Use this computer first, with Get Docker; behind Advanced, one command line that needs no preparation (docker rm -f hcm-worker, then docker run -d --name hcm-worker --restart unless-stopped with the named volume hcm-worker:/work) names the pipeline image by digest, the city, the project and a one-time pairing code minted when Advanced opens, written for the chosen system; Copy puts it on the clipboard; the city's choice reads Run on my computer when it is connected
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts; findings 66-67 of 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS-for-review.md §85). Finding 72: the command behind Advanced.

scenarios.title: The worker's panel on the Jobs page is a full-width card above the list
scenarios.asserts: batch 4: the panel sits in a collapsible card (Your computer, where new jobs run and Cloud Run this month) above the list and the job, its heading 16 px inside the card's title; the list starts below it
scenarios.notes: Finding 81 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the owner, 2026-11-05). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The Jobs page: the computer above, the list and the job side by side from 1200 px
scenarios.asserts: 1300 px: a full-width open card (details) holds the worker, where new jobs run and the Cloud Run meter above the list-detail, which splits with a list column of at least 360 px; its summary collapses it; the three choices read When it is on / Always on my computer / Always in the cloud and wrap between words
scenarios.notes: Batch 4 (the owner, 2026-11-09: the worker card squeezed the list, 'compute r'). Tests: packages/ui/test/admin/ops/jobs-page.test.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Under 1200 px the Jobs list and the open job are stacked
scenarios.asserts: 1000 px with a job open: no split, the list pane hidden, the job with its Back button
scenarios.notes: Batch 4. Tests: packages/ui/test/admin/ops/jobs-page.test.ts.

scenarios.title: No computer connected: a job chosen for it waits and says so
scenarios.asserts: no worker seen for ten minutes -> No computer connected; a version whose job waits for a worker says Waiting for your computer; Run in Google Cloud moves it to the cloud
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Run on my computer on a version sets the job's place and the city's choice
scenarios.asserts: a queued cloud version -> Run on my computer -> the job's runOn is local, it waits for the worker, and the city's choice is local
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A pipeline installed before the image was recorded shows no command
scenarios.asserts: setup/status without the pipeline image -> the panel asks to update the imagery pipeline and shows no docker command
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: The real worker claims a local job and finishes it against the emulators
scenarios.asserts: the city's choice is the computer -> Import waits for a worker (Waiting for your computer); the pipeline's worker process started with the Jobs page's command and its pairing code (no browser sign-in) -> claims the queued local import, runs every step through worker.step and signed URLs to the Storage emulator -> the version awaits approval, no Cloud Run execution or machine named, the panel shows the computer connected with its last job done; the raw delivery stays in the work folder (its synthetic city is too small to prove, and a frame nothing proved keeps it: M9 §6), and no usgs-raw/ or work/ object is ever in the bucket; one Ctrl-C then stops the worker with exit 0
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker-run.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Where a job runs cannot change while it runs
scenarios.asserts: imagery.runOn on a running job -> apiError.imagery.versionState, nothing changed; runOn auto with a job id -> invalid request
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/run-on.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker claims the oldest due local job
scenarios.asserts: two queued local jobs and one cloud job -> worker.claim leases the older local one (starting, worker, lease owner worker:<id>, attempt + 1, no machine) and refreshes the worker's lastSeenAt; a second claim of another worker gets the other one; none left -> job null
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker writes only its own job's documents and fields
scenarios.asserts: worker.step from a worker that does not hold the job -> apiError.worker.notHolder; a path off the allow-list, a field the pipeline does not write, a status the pipeline does not set, another owner's lease -> apiError.worker.refused; an invalid merged document -> apiError.invalidRequest; nothing written
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/step.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker gets signed URLs for its version's files and inputs only
scenarios.asserts: worker.urls -> PUT URLs bound to their content type for the version's files, GET URLs for its inputs, each valid 15 minutes with the object's metadata; usgs download-options of the job's scene answered with the server's key
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/urls.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A delivery, another version or another scene is never signed
scenarios.asserts: worker.urls for a usgs-raw or work object, another version's file, more than 20 objects, a USGS endpoint or label not of the job -> refused, nothing signed or called
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/urls.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A Landsat scene's warp on a computer writes its report
scenarios.asserts: worker.step update of the version's landsat report (checked, offset, city cloud, resolution) -> ok, stored as written
scenarios.notes: Lesson 703 (2026-11-14, live: every Landsat run on a computer failed at warp with apiError.worker.refused). Test: functions/test/worker/step.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A malformed Landsat report or a field no run writes is refused
scenarios.asserts: a report with cityCloudPct 300 -> apiError.invalidRequest; layerId from a worker -> apiError.worker.refused; nothing stored
scenarios.notes: Lesson 703 (2026-11-14, live: every Landsat run on a computer failed at warp with apiError.worker.refused). Test: functions/test/worker/step.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A computer reports the release its processing image was built from
scenarios.asserts: the installer builds the pipeline image with --build-arg HCM_RELEASE=${_RELEASE} -> hcm_pipeline.__version__ is that release (1.0.0-beta.1+a62d85e), which worker.hello records and the computer card shows
scenarios.notes: Lesson 704 (2026-11-14, live: every computer card said processing 0.0.0). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_release.py (pipeline-pytest), packages/admin/test/install/build-spec.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An image built without a release or with a malformed one says 0.0.0
scenarios.asserts: HCM_RELEASE missing, empty, over 40 characters or with a character worker.hello refuses -> 0.0.0, never a value hello would refuse
scenarios.notes: Lesson 704 (2026-11-14, live: every computer card said processing 0.0.0). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_release.py (pipeline-pytest).

scenarios.title: A computer the image check lets through is no longer said to be outdated
scenarios.asserts: the worker's document says outdated (a hello against a function instance's older installed image) while it runs the installed image -> worker.claim takes the job and the document says outdated false, so the admin's alert matches the claim
scenarios.notes: Lesson 708 (2026-11-14, live: the admin said no jobs until it updates itself while the computers took jobs). Test: functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A computer on another image stays outdated and takes nothing
scenarios.asserts: the worker's image differs from the installed one -> worker.claim answers outdated, the job stays queued and the document says outdated true
scenarios.notes: Lesson 708. Test: functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A new job goes to the computer while a worker is connected
scenarios.asserts: choice auto and a worker seen within three minutes -> the queued import gets runOn local and waits for the worker; no Cloud Run execution is asked for and no slot is taken
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/dispatch-place.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker that stops is noticed and its job waits again
scenarios.asserts: a running or starting local job whose lease lapsed, or whose heartbeat is three beats late (the worker's heartbeat rewrites the job every minute) -> imagery.tick puts it back to queued waiting for a worker with a log line saying the computer stopped; a run whose lease is live and whose heartbeat is on time is left alone however old its start; Cloud Run is never asked about it
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick-local.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A run lost because the computer stopped does not use up a try
scenarios.asserts: a local run whose lease lapsed or whose heartbeat stopped (a power cut or a crash, no end from the worker) -> queued again waiting for a worker, the attempt its claim counted given back and the loss counted (lostRuns), with the log line that the computer stopped and this try does not count
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit P0-1 and P1-3 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §3). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick-local.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A job that keeps stopping its computer counts its tries again
scenarios.asserts: a lost local run of a job whose earlier lost runs already got LOST_RUN_REFUNDS (5) tries back -> queued again with its attempt kept (it fails at JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS like any other run), with the log line that the computer stopped again and this try counts
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit P0-1 and P1-3 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §3). Test: functions/test/imagery/tick-local.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A computer back from a power cut releases the job it was running at its first claim
scenarios.asserts: the worker's document says busy with a job still starting or running and claimed by that same worker -> its next worker.claim (a worker claims only when it runs nothing) queues the job again at once with its attempt given back and the log line, then claims as usual (it may take the same job back), without waiting for the lease or imagery.tick
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit P0-1 and P1-3 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §3). Test: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A claim never releases another worker's job or one that moved on
scenarios.asserts: the worker's document names a job another worker claimed, one that ended, one waiting for points, or one that no longer exists -> the job is left as it was, no log line, and the claim goes on
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit P0-1 and P1-3 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §3). Test: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker learns what became of each job whose work folder it keeps
scenarios.asserts: worker.claim with held (the jobs whose scratch folder is on the computer, at most 200, at most once an hour) -> jobStates names each job's status now, gone for one that no longer exists, so the worker deletes only folders no job needs
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A claim without held jobs reads no job and says no states
scenarios.asserts: worker.claim without held -> no jobStates and no job read; held empty -> an empty jobStates; more than 200 held jobs -> the request is refused as invalid
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker's disk is recorded with each claim and work goes on while there is room
scenarios.asserts: worker.claim with disk (the worker's use, the free bytes of its disk, its floor) above the floor -> a job is claimed and the worker's document records the disk with when
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A computer whose disk is almost full takes no new work and the list says why and the fix
scenarios.asserts: worker.claim with free bytes below the floor -> no job, lowDisk, the worker still seen and its disk recorded (a paused computer is still answered paused); the computers' list shows the disk line and a warning that the disk is almost full, that it takes no new map work until it has the floor free, and to press Free space now or make room on that computer
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Tests: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/household.spec.ts (tour state worker.household-low-disk), packages/ui/test/admin/worker/household-disk.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Free space now asks the computer to delete what no map needs, then says what it freed
scenarios.asserts: Free space now on a computer of the list -> worker.manage freeSpace records when it was asked; the card says it frees space at its next check and the button waits; the worker's next claim is answered freeSpace until a claim says what it freed since (freed), which clears the request and the card says how many GB it freed and when (or that nothing was left to delete)
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Tests: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/household.spec.ts, packages/admin/test/worker/household.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/worker/household-disk.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Free space now is not asked of a computer that cannot answer
scenarios.asserts: worker.manage freeSpace for an unknown or disconnected computer -> changed false, nothing recorded; an older freed than the request does not answer it; the list shows no disk line nor Free space now for a worker that never said its disk, one being removed or one disconnected
scenarios.notes: Worker cleanup brief items 1 and 6 (2026-11-14; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Tests: functions/test/worker/cleanup.test.ts, packages/admin/test/worker/household.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/worker/household-disk.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The command's one-time code signs the worker in, no browser
scenarios.asserts: the Jobs page's command carries --pair <26 base32 characters> (worker.pairCode, renewed before its 10 minutes end) -> the worker started with it calls worker.pair (no sign-in), gets a custom token of the owner (claims worker, city, pair), signs in at Identity Toolkit and works as before; its session is kept in the work folder (mode 600) and a restart with the same command resumes it
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker-run.spec.ts, functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A pairing code works once
scenarios.asserts: the same code on a second computer (an empty work folder) after it was exchanged -> worker.pair answers apiError.worker.pairCode and the worker's page says so; no token minted
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6, §10. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker-run.spec.ts, functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An expired, revoked or unknown code, or too many attempts, is refused
scenarios.asserts: worker.pair with a code past its 10 minutes, revoked, unknown, of an owner no longer in the city -> apiError.worker.pairCode, no token; past 20 attempts in 10 minutes for the city -> apiError.rateLimited; a paired token for another city, without the worker claim or calling an admin callable -> refused
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6, §10. Test: functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Disconnect this computer revokes its worker and pairing
scenarios.asserts: Disconnect this computer on the panel -> worker.revoke sets revokedAt on the worker and its pairing -> every later call of that worker or of a restart with the kept session -> apiError.worker.revoked; the panel says the computer was disconnected
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6, §10. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts, functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker on an older pipeline image takes no job and is told to update
scenarios.asserts: the installed pipeline image differs from the one the worker's pairing named -> worker.hello says outdated, worker.claim gives no job (outdated: true); the panel says to run the command again (no new sign-in)
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§1.4. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts, functions/test/worker/pairing.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The panel follows the connected worker's job live
scenarios.asserts: a worker busy with a running local job -> the panel shows the job, its step and its progress, and the next write of the job moves them
scenarios.notes: Finding 68 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§7. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A job no computer came for offers the cloud in one click
scenarios.asserts: a local job queued 15 minutes with no worker seen -> imagery.tick marks it workerOverdueAt and leaves one inbox item job.noWorker linking its version; the version says no computer came and offers Run in Google Cloud instead, which moves it to the cloud
scenarios.notes: Finding 68 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§3.1. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/tick-worker.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A job that may still be claimed is left alone
scenarios.asserts: a local job waiting less than 15 minutes, already marked, in the cloud, running, or a worker seen within three minutes -> nothing marked, no inbox item
scenarios.notes: Finding 68 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§3.1. Test: functions/test/imagery/tick-worker.test.ts.

scenarios.notes: Finding 72 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the user, 2026-11-02: "I should not have to copy and paste"; the decision "Starter file + auto-pair"); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-02 (the starter file and auto-pair). scenarios.notes: Finding 74 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of 2026-11-03: worker.image answered the release before's digest beside the new release, and the supervisor looped on 'unrecognized arguments'); DECISIONS-for-review.md §87; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-03. scenarios.notes: Finding 74 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of 2026-11-03: worker.image answered the release before's digest beside the new release, and the supervisor looped on 'unrecognized arguments'); DECISIONS-for-review.md §87; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-03. scenarios.asserts: a browser with no mark, a worker of this city answering on the loopback: nothing is asked of it until Already set up? Look for it -> the mark set, no download, Looking..., then Connecting and a code posted to the worker

scenarios.notes: Finding 75 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-03). In e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts and packages/admin/test/worker/local.test.ts.

scenarios.asserts: Look for it, then a reload -> Looking..., with what to do if nothing answers; never that a file was just saved, nor how to open one

scenarios.title: A reload of a browser that set nothing up looks for nothing

scenarios.notes: 2026-11-06 review of 66b1271; workstream admin. Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts; packages/admin/test/worker/local.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A local run being joined reads its city's versions and their 5 m images
scenarios.asserts: worker.step list of cities/{city}/layerVersions -> their ids; get of any version of the city -> its document (target held); worker.urls signs GET of rasters/{city}/{layer}/{version}/align.tif
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Test: functions/test/worker/step.test.ts, functions/test/worker/allow-list.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A local run never writes another frame, nor reads another city's
scenarios.asserts: update of another version of the city -> apiError.worker.refused; align.tif of another version is never signed for PUT; another city's versions, another file of a frame, a way out of the city or a deeper path -> off the list
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Test: functions/test/worker/allow-list.test.ts, functions/test/worker/step.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A version of the city that fails its schema is no partner, and the run goes on
scenarios.asserts: worker.step list of cities/{city}/layerVersions -> only the ids that pass layerVersionDocSchema, with skipped = how many it left out; get of a failing one -> {data: null, updateTime: null}, never apiError.internal; a warning names its path and fields, '(document)' for an issue of the whole document; the job's own version that fails still fails
scenarios.notes: Live 2026-11-08: one older version made a same-date frame's georef fail with apiError.internal (docs/LESSONS.md). Test: functions/test/worker/step.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The Jobs page and the pipeline card show this month's Cloud Run use
scenarios.asserts: usage/cloudrun of the month -> both show the processor seconds and the memory GiB-seconds of the 180,000 and 360,000 free, labelled as an estimate
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A cloud run past the free tier waits for the admin's OK
scenarios.asserts: a version whose job waits for the OK -> the page shows the estimate and the month's use; Run in Google Cloud anyway -> imagery.runOn with the OK and the job is dispatched
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A cloud run is counted once when it ends
scenarios.asserts: a job leaves running on std after 1,000 s -> usage/cloudrun gains 4,000 vCPU-seconds and 16,000 GiB-seconds and one run; the redelivered event adds nothing; a local run adds nothing
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/cloud-usage.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An automated cloud run past the free tier waits with an inbox item
scenarios.asserts: the month's use plus the estimate passes the free tier -> the job stays queued with waitReason free-tier; made by the system it raises job.needsOk, made by a click it does not; with the OK it is dispatched; a hand-over from the fetch machine is never asked again
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/free-tier.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The month's cloud runs before the count began are added once
scenarios.asserts: usage/cloudrun-<month> without backfilledAt -> imagery.tick adds every city's cloud runs of the month that ended uncounted (dispatch to end x the machine's vCPUs and GiB; std when none is named), never a local, running, counted or last month's run, and marks the month; a later count keeps the mark
scenarios.notes: Finding 64 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86. Test: functions/test/imagery/cloud-usage-backfill.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A month already backfilled is never added again
scenarios.asserts: the month marked between the read and the transaction -> nothing added; times that say more than a run takes count at most three hours, none at all without an end; a backfill that fails is logged and the tick goes on
scenarios.notes: Finding 64 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86. Test: functions/test/imagery/cloud-usage-backfill.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A small file publishes through the Uploads API without compute units
scenarios.asserts: an approved version with a 120 MB studio file -> credentials, the S3 put, the upload and its polling, the TileJSON smoke test -> the layer's origin uploads, the version's mapbox.via uploads, uploadsApiMb counted and no compute units reserved or counted
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish-uploads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A file over 300 MB or past the month's allowance goes through MTS
scenarios.asserts: a 400 MB studio file, or the month's Uploads megabytes used -> the compute-unit guard and MTS as before, mapbox.via mts
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish-uploads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A layer whose tileset MTS made stays on MTS
scenarios.asserts: a new version of a layer with mapbox.origin mts -> MTS behind the guard, never the Uploads API
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish-uploads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A token without the uploads scope falls back to MTS
scenarios.asserts: the credentials call answers 403 -> one log line naming the missing scope, then MTS behind the guard
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: functions/test/imagery/publish-uploads.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The worker runs a claimed import through the API and signed URLs
scenarios.asserts: a claimed usgs-import -> every step runs unchanged; the documents go through worker.step, the version's files through signed PUTs; the delivery, the segments and the frame stay in the work folder; worker.end reports done
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py.

scenarios.title: A worker that lost its job stops writing
scenarios.asserts: the server answers notHolder in the middle of a run -> the run stops as a lost lease, writes nothing more and reports the end
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py.

scenarios.title: The local page's fallback sign-in signs the owner in and the worker starts claiming
scenarios.asserts: the page's POST /session with its CSRF token from the same origin -> worker.hello with the token, the state signed in; the ID token refreshed before it expires
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_session.py.

scenarios.title: Another site cannot plant or read a session
scenarios.asserts: a POST /session from another origin, without the CSRF token, as a form, or to another Host -> 403 or 421 and no token kept; GET /state carries no CORS header
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_session.py.

scenarios.title: A refused refresh ends the session
scenarios.asserts: securetoken refuses the refresh token -> the session ends, claiming stops, the page asks to sign in again
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_session.py.

scenarios.title: One SIGTERM or Ctrl-C stops the worker at any moment
scenarios.asserts: the worker process held while it claims a job, inside a step, right after its run's last checkpoint (five times) or between jobs -> one SIGTERM or SIGINT -> exit 0 within 10 s; a job claimed or mid-step goes back to queued with no step started or the step pending, a finished one stays awaiting approval

scenarios.title: The worker pairs with the command's code and keeps its session
scenarios.asserts: worker --pair <code> -> worker.pair without an Authorization header, the custom token signed in at Identity Toolkit with the Hosting origin as Referer, worker.hello, then claiming; the refresh token kept in .hcm-session-<city>.json (mode 600, no code in it); a restart resumes it; a new code pairs again naming the pairing it replaces
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.title: A refused or unreachable pairing leaves the worker waiting
scenarios.asserts: a used code -> no session, the page says apiError.worker.pairCode; a refused custom-token sign-in -> no session; the server out of reach -> tried again 30 seconds later; a refused new code falls back to the kept session
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.asserts: a call answered apiError.worker.revoked (at start or while working) -> the session ends, the kept session file is deleted, the page says so and nothing is tried again until a new command
scenarios.notes: Finding 67 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the live test of the local worker, 2026-11-02); DECISIONS-for-review.md §85; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md §§2.6. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.notes: Finding 72 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the user, 2026-11-02: "I should not have to copy and paste"; the decision "Starter file + auto-pair"); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-02 (the starter file and auto-pair).
