scenarios.title: Under the starter's supervisor an outdated image ends the worker with 75
scenarios.asserts: worker --supervised --image <digest>, a claim answered outdated -> the loop ends and the command exits 75 (ExitCode.OUTDATED), so the supervisor reads the installed image and pulls it; without --supervised the worker stays and takes no job
scenarios.notes: Finding 72 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (the user, 2026-11-02: "I should not have to copy and paste"; the decision "Starter file + auto-pair"); DECISIONS-for-review.md §86; docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, its addendum of 2026-11-02 (the starter file and auto-pair). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_app.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_loop.py.

scenarios.title: The worker keeps its id across restarts
scenarios.asserts: a second process on the same work folder uses the same worker id, so a restart leaves no second worker document
scenarios.notes: Finding 77 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md (2026-11-03). In pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.title: A forgotten session or a damaged id file starts a new worker
scenarios.asserts: after the session file is cleared (a disconnected computer) or with an id file that is not an id -> a new worker id, written back
scenarios.notes: Finding 77 of docs/research/manual-test-2026-10-25.md. In pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.title: The raw delivery is deleted once the city crop exists
scenarios.asserts: after locate -> the usgs-raw delivery is gone from the bucket, scan.tif and the version's scan are there, the log says so; a weak guess keeps it; a retry with the delivery gone and the segments there needs no download
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py.

scenarios.title: A retry after the delivery was deleted downloads it again
scenarios.asserts: a failed job retried from extract with its delivery deleted -> fetch runs again and the job finishes
scenarios.notes: M7 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py.

scenarios.title: A full disk during extract keeps the delivery
scenarios.asserts: the disk fills while the segments are written -> the job failed with apiError.imagery.processingFailed and the disk's reason in its message, not archiveCorrupt; the delivery stays, and a retry unpacks it with no new download
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_steps_edges.py.

scenarios.title: A job resumed after locate goes on when its work folder is gone
scenarios.asserts: locate is finished and every work/ object of the job is gone -> the resume does not run fetch, extract or stitch again, and the job reaches approval instead of crashing at every retry
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py.

scenarios.title: Sentinel-2 tiles are mosaicked only from a date that covers the window
scenarios.asserts: the least cloudy date leaves a hole in the window -> the next date whose tiles (up to four) cover it together is the reference
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_references.py.

scenarios.title: No date covers the window: no reference with a hole
scenarios.asserts: no date's tiles cover the window together -> the job fails at locate with apiError.imagery.referenceUnavailable, not with a misleading cityNotFound on a partial mosaic
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py and pipeline/tests/unit/test_references.py.

scenarios.title: A retry after an automatic fit keeps its suggestions
scenarios.asserts: georef runs again on a version it fitted automatically -> the same transform through its pairs, and the suggestions the georeferencer offers are still there
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_autogcp.py.

scenarios.title: The worker removes what no job needs any more from the owner's disk
scenarios.asserts: a pass with the server's job states -> folders of succeeded, failed, cancelled or gone jobs unwritten for 48 hours go, unknown ones after 14 days, scene deliveries and unfinished downloads after 7, and a deleted delivery takes its empty folders
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py and pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_objects.py. Also pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: The sweep never touches the job just claimed
scenarios.asserts: a pass that claims a job with old scratch -> its folder and every delivery stay while another job's old folder goes; a disk that refuses the sweep does not stop the loop; a job the server still lists as queued, awaiting points or approval is never deleted however old, nor a finished one within its 48 hours
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py and pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_objects.py. Also pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: A disk too small is refused before the download
scenarios.asserts: free space under about 2.6 times the announced size -> the job failed at fetch with apiError.imagery.processingFailed, its message says how much is free and how much is needed, and no byte was stored
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py and pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_objects.py.

scenarios.title: What the worker keeps is written to the disk before its name
scenarios.asserts: a durable write -> the bytes and the folder are fsynced, the mode is set before the first byte, and each chunk of a delivery session is fsynced before the next
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_durable.py.

scenarios.title: A power cut mid-write leaves the old file whole
scenarios.asserts: the power goes at the fsync of a write, a copy or an upload to the work folder -> the old file is unchanged and no leftover lies beside it
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_durable.py.

scenarios.title: A resume passes over a step whose local output is whole
scenarios.asserts: a worker resumes a job whose step is done and whose output has its recorded size and a TIFF header -> the step does not run again
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner_resilience.py.

scenarios.title: A resume runs again a step whose output a power cut tore
scenarios.asserts: the output is zeros of the right size, truncated or empty -> the job's log says it is damaged and the step runs again in the same run, without an attempt
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner_resilience.py.

scenarios.title: A full disk on the owner's computer hands the job back without using a try
scenarios.asserts: ENOSPC in a step on a worker -> the run ends disk-full, the step is pending, the log says to free space; worker.end released with diskFull queues the job with its attempt given back
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner_resilience.py and functions/test/worker/pause.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A full disk in Cloud Run still fails the job
scenarios.asserts: ENOSPC in a step of a Cloud Run execution -> the job fails with apiError.internal as any crash; a full disk passed on through GDAL or a step's error is still recognised
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_runner_resilience.py.

scenarios.title: An upload that arrived damaged is sent once more
scenarios.asserts: the signed PUT's x-goog-hash names another MD5 than the file's -> the file is sent again and recorded only when the MD5 matches
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_objects.py.

scenarios.title: An upload damaged twice fails its step
scenarios.asserts: both PUTs arrive different from the file -> an ObjectStoreError, so the step is never recorded done on a damaged object
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_objects.py.

scenarios.title: An interrupted write's leftovers go after an hour
scenarios.asserts: files ending .tmp or .part not written for an hour go on start and on each pass; a live write and a resumable session's partial file stay
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: Each claim says the worker's disk and once an hour the jobs it holds
scenarios.asserts: worker.claim carries disk (workBytes, freeBytes, floorBytes) every time and held at most once an hour
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: Free space now deletes finished jobs at once and says what it freed
scenarios.asserts: freeSpace in the claim's answer with fresh job states -> finished jobs' folders go without their grace, running ones stay, and the next claim says freed with its bytes and time
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: Free space now with old job states asks again before deleting
scenarios.asserts: states older than 10 minutes -> nothing is deleted, the next claim names the held jobs, and a job the owner retried since keeps its folder
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: A disk under its floor frees finished jobs without being asked
scenarios.asserts: free bytes under 15 GB and lowDisk in the answer -> the log says no new job until there is room and finished jobs go without their grace
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_cleanup.py.

scenarios.title: The supervisor keeps two pipeline images and restarts the worker after a reboot
scenarios.asserts: before each run older pipeline images go, the current and the previous stay, dangling labelled images are pruned; the worker runs with --restart unless-stopped and is removed after each run
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts and starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Another program's image is never removed
scenarios.asserts: only the current pipeline image and another app's image on the computer -> no image is removed
scenarios.notes: Resilience audit and cleanup brief of 2026-11-14 (docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, crashes and the worker's disk). Test: functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A worker id revoked or of another owner does not refuse every new code
scenarios.asserts: worker.hello refuses a new pairing for the id -> the id is forgotten, the new pairing kept, the process ends; the restart is a new worker on that pairing, with no new code. Any other refusal keeps the id
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.title: A work folder that cannot hold the id does not stop the worker
scenarios.asserts: a read-only folder or an undecodable id file -> the worker starts, logs it, and keeps a new id in memory; a kept id is still read from a read-only folder
scenarios.notes: Findings of the review of 2026-11-06 (workstream pipeline-robust). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pairing.py.

scenarios.title: A frame of part of the city joins its date's others and is approved and published as one layer
scenarios.asserts: a frame covering about 55 % of the city waiting for approval -> the offer (about 55 %, with F040 about 100 %) -> Join frames (one click) -> the join's page lists its frames with their states and says it waits -> the frame renders, the tick starts the join -> the report (coverage, seam before and after, worst frame's error, largest shift) -> Approve (one click) -> published, the viewer paints it
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A join that came out short takes the next frame; nothing is downloaded again
scenarios.asserts: a rendered join covering 62 %, a third frame of its date in the plan -> Add F041 and join again -> a new join of three frames, the old one rejected, the two rendered frames ran once
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A join within all limits publishes itself
scenarios.asserts: every condition met (auto-publish on, worst frame under the threshold with three checkpoints, shift under it, every seam measured and applied under 15 m, coverage at least 90 %) -> approved by the policy and published; Join frames was the only click
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A published join owns its frames
scenarios.asserts: published -> its frames are joined, their scenes point at the join's layer, the sweep skips joined frames, deleting the layer removes their files
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames of different dates or cameras cannot be joined
scenarios.asserts: imagery.join over two dates -> apiError.imagery.joinMixedFrames, nothing created
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A set past today's limit is refused up front
scenarios.asserts: two missing frames and the join count three jobs; the city's limit of 2 -> the message beside Join frames; no version created, the scenes still candidates
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame that needs points holds the join
scenarios.asserts: a frame in needs_gcps -> the join says it waits, the frame's row links the georeferencer, Work still asks for that frame; a tick starts nothing, no worker can claim it; it resumes once the points are saved
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame that ended fails the join with its name
scenarios.asserts: a frame failed, cancelled, rejected or superseded -> apiError.imagery.joinPartGone naming it, from the callable and from the hold (a frame joined by an earlier join is not gone: S-A65-HAPPY-JOINED-FRAME)
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames published as their own layers join, and the joined layer retires those layers
scenarios.asserts: two frames each published as a layer of the same date -> the join takes the first one's layer, a frame approved, publishing or published serves the dispatcher; when the join publishes, the other frame's layer leaves the manifest (published false, retired by the join) with its tiles and versions kept, a frame publishing alone after its join is born retired; the date row says so before Join frames, the layer's page links the join
scenarios.notes: Batch 4 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §5.1; live 2026-11-09: 2 Feb 1972 F039 and F040, 1980 A038 and A039). Tests: functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/join.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/layers/layer-geometry.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A join whose frame a newer join took fails with its own words and offers no retry
scenarios.asserts: a frame stamped by a newer join -> the older join fails, and its retry refuses, with apiError.imagery.joinPartTaken naming the frame; the code is not retryable
scenarios.notes: Batch 4 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §5.1): the live 1980 retry said the frame ended. Tests: functions/test/imagery/join-parts.test.ts, retry.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A held frame refuses changes of its own
scenarios.asserts: a frame a live join holds -> its page links the join and offers no join; Approve shows apiError.imagery.joinPartHeld and the frame stays waiting; Work no longer asks for it; reject, re-georeference and delete refuse as well
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A held frame never publishes itself
scenarios.asserts: a frame under the threshold held by a join -> no approval and no call to Mapbox; half a city never reaches the map
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A join over the threshold waits for Approve
scenarios.asserts: worst frame's error over the threshold -> the card says the figure and that joining does not improve it; nothing reaches Mapbox until Approve
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Rejecting a join gives its frames back
scenarios.asserts: Reject -> only the join ends: its frames wait for approval, their scenes stay imported, and Join frames is on again
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A seam that could not be measured is said
scenarios.asserts: too few samples at the seam -> the card says the seam could not be measured, and the join waits for Approve
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames that never meet are said
scenarios.asserts: frames that do not overlap render with no seam -> the card says so, shows no list, and the join waits for Approve
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A correction that did not help is said
scenarios.asserts: a seam the pixels refused -> the card gives its one figure and says nothing moved, and the join waits for Approve
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A join's retry finds its frames gone
scenarios.asserts: a failed join whose frame a newer join stamped, new points replaced or its own publish took -> the retry answers joinPartGone and nothing moves; else it goes back waiting for its frames, so no worker claims it unseen
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Test: functions/test/imagery/retry.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Cancel of a frame a live join holds is withdrawn
scenarios.asserts: the admin's request on a held frame's job -> the job and its scene stay, the request is taken back, the log says why; the page offers no Cancel
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Test: functions/test/imagery/join-parts.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame of a join that ended never publishes alone
scenarios.asserts: a frame named by a join that failed, was rejected or cancelled, or its new points -> it waits for Approve; a frame the policy approved meanwhile is refused by the join
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Tests: functions/test/imagery/join-parts.test.ts, join.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame with new points joins from where its scan lies
scenarios.asserts: a re-georeferenced frame's scan stays in its base's folder -> a worker may read it, the sweep keeps it while the frame reads it, the layer's deletion takes it
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Tests: functions/test/worker/urls.test.ts, functions/test/imagery/join-finalize.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames too far apart fail the join and lead to the georeferencer
scenarios.asserts: apiError.imagery.joinSeamTooFar -> the message names both frames, and each frame's row links the georeferencer
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Whole-city dates list the best date first
scenarios.asserts: the page's own search writes the plan -> rows sorted: reaches 95 %, target year, not winter, fewest downloads; a summer date above a winter one, which notes it may need points
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-dates.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Add {year} saves the year and re-ranks
scenarios.asserts: Add 1968 to target years -> the city's target years hold it, the button goes, and after the search the 1968 frame's row says it is a wanted year
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-dates.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A new setup holds the target years
scenarios.asserts: Setup creates Bucharest from the bundle -> imagery.targetYears holds 1966, 1972, 1976, 1977, 1978, 1979, 1980, 1982, 1983, 1984
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/steps/deploy.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A capped dataset still finds a target date
scenarios.asserts: a dataset at its 500-scene cap -> a warning and one windowed search per target year, which finds the target date
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame that must be ordered is named, never joined
scenarios.asserts: a date whose other frame is paid -> the row says 1 more would need ordering, links that frame's page with Buy this scan: F022 and has no Join frames
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-dates.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames that end together keep the whole-city dates up to date without running the function out of memory
scenarios.asserts: three rewrites of one city's plan asked at once -> the city is read twice, not three times, and the plan lists the frame written while the first ran; a rewrite that fails fails its waiters and the next call reads again; another city is not held behind it
scenarios.notes: Cloud Error Reporting, 2026-11-13: imagery-onJobWrite over its 256 MiB (docs/LESSONS.md 663). Test: functions/test/imagery/join-plan-flight.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame with no neighbour has no row and no offer
scenarios.asserts: one frame of its date -> the plan has no rows, Find shows no whole-city dates and the scene's page no offer
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-dates.spec.ts, functions/test/imagery/join*.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame's measured outline decides what the plan says it covers
scenarios.asserts: calibration.outline a tenth of the city where the estimate holds all of it -> the date's other frame joins the row
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §5). Test: functions/test/imagery/join-plan.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame found with no landmark says how, what agrees, its error and the city it covers
scenarios.asserts: a proved frame -> found automatically, 712 of 946 areas agree, measured error 16.3 m, covers 96 % of the city, on the version's page in the page's language
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame nothing found asks for a few rough points
scenarios.asserts: calibration.how none on a version waiting for points -> not found: place a few rough points, the rest is automatic, with the way to the georeferencer
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A proved frame leaves its model for the next frame of its pass
scenarios.asserts: locate ended proved -> cities/{city}/imageryPasses/{mission-camera-date} holds its model, which worker.step lets a run of the same mission and camera read and never write
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2). Test: functions/test/imagery/pass-calibration.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame nothing proved leaves the pass as it was
scenarios.asserts: a refusal, no model, no calibration or an upload -> no pass is written
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2). Test: functions/test/imagery/pass-calibration.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame lined up with earlier photos says which, and that they stayed where they are
scenarios.asserts: calibration.alignment with two used partners (1972, 1977; 1,420 and 810 ties) and one with too few -> on the version page: lined up with your photos of 1972, 1977 at 2230 shared points; they stay where they are, and lining them up with this one is your choice; the one with too few says nothing; in the page language
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A photo whose streets sat off is named and was not used
scenarios.asserts: a partner disagreeing at 9.24 m (1978) -> not lined up with 1978: its streets sat 9.2 m from the others
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Two frames join: the seam closes and nothing moves beyond the taper
scenarios.asserts: 2 frames, 60 m off each other, a 25 % tone step -> the seam under 15 m on held-out tiles, truth error beyond the taper unchanged within 1 m, no partial alpha inside the valid area, areaKm2 the union
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: Past the taper a part shows what its own warp shows
scenarios.asserts: a panoramic frame off nadir, poly2, affine or thin-plate, warped for real through its nodes against its own points -> within a few metres past the taper, and the largest move is what the warp really does, drift between nodes included
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §17). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_warp_parity.py.

scenarios.title: A join's part fitted over terrain shows what its layer shows
scenarios.asserts: a part whose georef carries terrain, seen off nadir over a 90 m hill, warped by the join with a real coded scan -> without nodes, the very pixels its layer's warp reads (within a metre: the same RPC over the same heights); with the nodes of a seam, read first through its RPC onto the level's grid and its nodes placed there, so past the taper it still shows its layer within a metre (P95), where a spline through scan pixels lay 43 m RMS from it
scenarios.notes: M15 terrain review (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Terrain), M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §3). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_terrain_readers.py.

scenarios.title: Three frames: two seams whose fields add
scenarios.asserts: 3 frames -> two seams, each closed; the middle frame carries both fields
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: A covered frame is left out
scenarios.asserts: a frame owning under 1 % of the window -> listed in omitted, not warped
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: The join runs under the worker allow-lists
scenarios.asserts: the local worker -> reads the part versions and each scan, writes only the join's own files
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: The real pipeline joins two frames from the admin
scenarios.asserts: Join frames over the two synthetic frames -> python -m hcm_pipeline run imports both and joins them against the emulators; one seam measured, closed and under 15 m, coverage at least 90 % -> the policy publishes it, the viewer paints it
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-pipeline.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Frames with no overlap render without a seam
scenarios.asserts: no overlap -> rendered, no seams, never auto-published
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: A flat overlap is not measured
scenarios.asserts: flat overlap -> measured false, no shift, the 12 m cut
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: A correction that did not help is refused
scenarios.asserts: an adversarial field -> applied false, the before figure reported, no frame shifted
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: Frames 500 m apart fail
scenarios.asserts: 500 m on the ground -> apiError.imagery.joinSeamTooFar naming both
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: A scan no longer stored fails
scenarios.asserts: a part's scan.tif gone -> apiError.imagery.joinPartMissing naming it
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: Too little disk fails before warping
scenarios.asserts: disk under the need -> apiError.imagery.joinNoRoom; a seam needs two scans at once, a run resumed at merge checks again, and a disk that fills during a download says the same
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: Fewer than two useful frames fail
scenarios.asserts: fewer than two frames owning at least 1 % -> apiError.imagery.joinNoFrames
scenarios.notes: M8 (docs/research/M8-join-interfaces.md §8). Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_join_job.py.

scenarios.title: A seam already closed counts as closed, though nothing moved
scenarios.asserts: a refused correction on a seam at 0.34 m -> applied, shift 0, so the join may publish on its own; on a seam at 12 m it stays refused
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §15). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_edges.py, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-pipeline.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame kilometres off is found and proved with no landmark, anywhere on Earth
scenarios.asserts: a synthetic film at latitudes 44, 0.3 and 59.9, its corners 5 km off, mirrored or turned -> one warp per orientation, the tiles agree on a similarity, the proof holds: the proved map within 25 m of the truth, the checks held out before RANSAC under 15 m, calibration.how votes, the delivery deleted; real frames: the table of docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2, §4. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_votes.py, test_calibrate_proof.py, test_calibrate_pairs.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A reference of another place makes no false positive
scenarios.asserts: a film over another place, a warp with no room for a tile, too few or too narrow votes, a map kilometres off -> no proposal or a named refusal, never an exception: the crop is bounded, the delivery stays, the job waits for the points
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2, §4, §6. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_votes.py, test_calibrate_proof.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A film with no texture has no votes and raises nothing
scenarios.asserts: a uniform film -> no tile votes, refusal no-votes, the job goes on to the points
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_votes.py.

scenarios.title: A neighbouring frame of the same pass is the first place to look
scenarios.asserts: cities/{city}/imageryPasses/{key} holds a proved model -> it warps first with a 12 km margin, a strong result ends the search after one warp, calibration.how pass
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_prior.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A wrong prior falls through to the full search
scenarios.asserts: a model 85 km off, of another orientation or camera, or a record this version cannot read -> not used or refused by the votes, the full search finds the frame
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_prior.py.

scenarios.title: A frame nothing proved always gets a crop that fits
scenarios.asserts: orientations whose union is over MAX_SCAN_PIXELS -> the crop is cut around the most likely one, calibration.cutOrientations counts the lost ones, no failure, the delivery stays (the 1982 frame failed with 225,264 px before)
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §6. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_raw_deleted.py.

scenarios.title: The admin's rough points seed the tiles and are replaced
scenarios.asserts: at least three enabled manual points on a frame nothing proved -> the tiles start from their fit, a proof replaces them with automatic pairs, calibration.how points and seedPoints, the log says so
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §7. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: Points the tiles refuse are fitted as saved; a set holding automatic or disabled pairs is never overwritten
scenarios.asserts: a reference that refuses the tiles, a disabled pair or an automatic pair in the set, or a retry whose stored tiles are gone and no longer prove -> method gcps as saved (checkpointKind leave-one-out), or the matcher goes on
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §7. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A USGS frame renders nothing beyond the city window
scenarios.asserts: a usgs version -> outputBounds on the aligned window, the output bounds inside it; a crop ring or an upload keeps its own extent
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §5. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A crop's coverage is measured against the whole city
scenarios.asserts: a raster over half of the city -> coveragePct about 50, not the 100 the share of its own grid gives; a raster off the city -> 0; no city document, no figure
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §0, §5. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: A frame over longitude 180 is one piece around a city on either side
scenarios.asserts: a KH-9 frame with corners at 174.5 and -174.5 and a window at Suva or at -179.5 -> it reaches the window as the same frame at longitude 0 does; a footprint across the line stays one piece; a window ends on the line, what it asks of Sentinel-2 and Overpass stays a plain box, no pair is written past 180, and the plan's and the harvest's coverage read the frame around the city
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §1. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py, packages/shared/test/imagery/coverage.test.ts, packages/shared/test/imagery/join.test.ts. Synthetic: how USGS spells a crossing frame is unverified.

scenarios.title: A town the model puts past the film's edge still gets its search
scenarios.asserts: a 10 km window 14 km beyond the model's edge (F006 lay 14 km off) -> it reaches, under the sensor's search range on the ground; under the window's own size alone it would fail with cityNotFound; 45 km beyond a 30 km range it still does (S-P01-BAD-CITY-NOT-FOUND)
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §1. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py.

scenarios.title: A window across two orbit tracks is mosaicked from two dates
scenarios.asserts: no single date covers the window, tracks on different days do together -> up to four items of any dates, each the one that adds most of it; a hole between them is still referenceUnavailable (S-P01-BAD-MOSAIC-NOT-COVERED)
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §13. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_references.py.

scenarios.title: A tile whose box holds the window but whose footprint does not is no reference
scenarios.asserts: an item with a whole bbox and a slanted footprint (Earth Search's S2A_34NFL_20240101 left 27 % of a window out) -> it does not cover the window: no reference with a hole, a mosaic or referenceUnavailable instead; an item with no geometry falls back on its box
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §13. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_references.py.

scenarios.title: A sensor with many warps still asks each enough tiles to agree
scenarios.asserts: 4 orientations x 3 scales, 8 orientations x 1 scale -> every warp asks at least VOTE_WARP_MIN_TILES (180), since 60 found no real frame at all; the model's own scale goes first, so a strong proposal ends the search before the wider scales cost anything
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2, §9. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_votes.py; real frames in §14.

scenarios.title: A strip lying as a parallelogram is found under its shear and proved
scenarios.asserts: a film whose short side lies 9 degrees off the rectangle of its corners, its corners kilometres off -> a warp at a searched shear agrees and the proof holds it within 25 m; the shear keeps the long side and the window's centre under every orientation; a 1:2.25 strip searches 4 orientations, not 8; the real KH-7 frame's place lies inside its search range
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_cameras.py. One real frame only: DZB00403000026H017001.

scenarios.title: More shears over another place prove nothing
scenarios.asserts: the same film over a reference of another place, searched at three shears -> no proof, how none: more warps are more chances, and the proof still decides
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_cameras.py.

scenarios.title: A frame with no corners stands on its footprint
scenarios.asserts: no corners, a footprint standing on one of its own corners (the real KH-5 frame) -> its extremes in north-west-first order, all 8 orientations searched, the frame's pixel from them (58.5 m); a film turned 40 degrees is found and proved through them
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_cameras.py.

scenarios.title: A film far coarser than its pixels is refused, never proved
scenarios.asserts: a film holding only what a 140 m camera holds -> how none, no proof, no exception, so the admin's points are next; KH-5 is a camera of its own at 140 m
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §14: the real DS09065A089MC039 refuses the same way. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_cameras.py.

scenarios.title: A strip scanned with its long side as the width keeps its true pixel
scenarios.asserts: a 22 by 200 km strip running north-south, 333,000 px wide -> the frame's pixel is its long side over the film's, about 0.83 Mercator metres, not the short edge's 0.09, so the votes' preview is not shrunk ten times too far; an east-west KH-9 strip reads what it always did
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §2. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_corners.py. The real KH-7 strip (§14) runs north-south and reads its pixel this way.

scenarios.title: A map whole periods of a field lattice off is refused
scenarios.asserts: a lattice of fields around a city that repeats nothing, the map three periods (800 m ground) off -> every narrowing gate holds, the tiles of the city have no peak in the last search, and the added score maps stand higher elsewhere than on the map: refusal `rival`; the same lattice under the true map proves
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §4. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_rival.py.

scenarios.title: A part of the film displaced as by a bad seam is refused
scenarios.asserts: the film's east 30 % or 20 % of the window lies 357 or 714 m (ground) from the rest -> 2 m of checkpoint error and every other gate holding, but the added score maps show a second place too clear for noise: refusal `rival`
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §4. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_rival.py.

scenarios.title: One clear tile cannot decide the proof's checks
scenarios.asserts: thousands of tiles under the checks' peak, one over it -> refusal `cross-validation`: fewer than PROOF_MIN_CHECKS, so the two gates that read the checks test nothing and the delivery stays
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §4. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_proof.py.

scenarios.title: A proved frame with few pairs has a figure a document can hold
scenarios.asserts: a frame clipping a corner of the window, 6 or 7 pairs -> affine and a finite crossValidatedM; with no fold to hold, no figure: never Infinity, which Firestore stores, every reader refuses and the worker's JSON cannot send
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §7. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_pairs.py.

scenarios.title: A render says where it shows the city, however it was fitted
scenarios.asserts: a USGS render over part of the city's window -> output.outline is the alpha's edge over the city's bounds, at most 32 vertices; a render off the city or no city document, none
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §5. Test: pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: The published layer shows the map the fit holds, not GDAL's own reverse polynomial
scenarios.asserts: an affine or poly2 georef -> the warp renders with -tps through 17 x 17 nodes sampled on the fit over the scan, within 1 px of the fit where -order 2 is 5 px and more off; a stored lattice is rendered as stored
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md §1. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_render_lattice.py.

scenarios.title: A thin-plate spline, a degenerate set or an upload renders through its own points; a malformed lattice is refused
scenarios.asserts: a tps georef or a collinear set -> its enabled points; an embedded georef -> no transform; a lattice of an unknown model, without nodes, with a node missing a coordinate, other than the 17 x 17 (289) nodes the pipeline samples -> DocumentError in the pipeline and a validation issue in georefSchema
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md §1. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_render_lattice.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A KH-9 panoramic frame is mapped by its camera, fitted on every tile, and rendered through a stored lattice
scenarios.asserts: tiles of a panoramic camera -> the camera within 4 m where poly2 is twice as far off; calibrated() with the film's radians a column -> held-out checks and the blocked figure from the camera and lower than poly2's, residuals on every pair, georef.lattice of 289 panoramic nodes over the scan; locate stores radPerPx for KH-9 pan only; the lattice round-trips the document
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md §2. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_camera.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_render_lattice.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A camera that cannot hold the frame is not used, and a retry keeps the camera's map
scenarios.asserts: under 60 tiles -> no camera; a wrong rate whose camera holds under 90 % of the tiles RANSAC kept -> poly2 with no lattice; KH-7, KH-9 mapping or a calibration.json without radPerPx -> poly2; a georef retry over a stored lattice -> the georef unchanged and 'kept: the panoramic map ...'
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md §2. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_camera.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_render_lattice.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_calibration_job.py.

scenarios.title: Of two mirrored KH-9 cameras that hold the same tiles, the one with the smaller second-order term maps the frame
scenarios.asserts: tiles of a camera at a scan angle of 0.45 rad on which the camera mirrored about the nadir holds one tile more (899 against 898) through a second-order term of about 5 km -> the camera kept has the true sign of the scan angle and a second-order term under 1 km, and beyond the tiles (film columns 41,000 to 47,000) it reads under 3 m RMS (1.8 m; the mirrored one 4.1 m); both signs of the scan angle are always followed
scenarios.notes: M15 review (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Review of 2026-11-08). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_camera.py. On real frames the mirrored camera had been published for A001, F022 and F049 (second-order terms of 8.7, 7.4 and 4.3 km against 0.3, 0.3 and 1.2 km).

scenarios.title: A camera that holds clearly more tiles is kept however much it bends
scenarios.asserts: two cameras, one holding 20 tiles more of about 900 through a second-order term forty times larger -> that one is kept; holding 5 more (within 1 %) -> the plainer one
scenarios.notes: M15 review. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_camera.py.

scenarios.title: The Sentinel-2 reference is the least cloudy clear date that agrees with the others
scenarios.asserts: five clear dates of one texture placed within 2 m of each other -> status agreed, the least cloudy kept as the reference, each date's offset from the median read within 0.5 m; candidates are covering sets at least 30 days apart, least cloudy first; the version's reference records s2Check (status, boundM, chosen, every set's items, date, cloud, eastM, northM, kept) and the shared schema accepts it
scenarios.notes: M15 reference guard (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, The reference guard). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_agreement.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts. On real scenes (2026-11-08) Bucharest keeps S2C_35TMK_20260817, the scene its frames were calibrated on.

scenarios.title: A Sentinel-2 date that sits 12 m off the others is rejected, even when it is the least cloudy
scenarios.asserts: the least cloudy date 12 m south of four others -> rejected (offset read within 0.9 m), the next date that agrees is the reference, a warning names both; two shifted dates of five (-12.7 and -9.9 m) -> both rejected once the consensus is centred again; a whole import whose least cloudy date is moved 12 m south -> the job succeeds on the world's own date, s2Check chosen 2 with kept [false, false, true, true], one warning (locate measured, reference read the verdict from the cached window); a record naming a scene it does not list, an unknown status or no scene is refused by the shared schema
scenarios.notes: M15 reference guard (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, The reference guard). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_agreement.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts. Real proof: 2024-10-26 rejected at 11.5 m over Bucharest and 11.2 m over Pitesti.

scenarios.title: The guard reads ground metres at any latitude, in any UTM zone, and on a set mosaicked across zones
scenarios.asserts: one texture written in EPSG:32633 at 78 N, EPSG:32719 at 55 S, and as two halves in EPSG:32717 and 32718 across the equator's zone seam, the first set moved 3 m east and 10 m south -> rejected, its offset read within 1 m; a window narrower than 10 km reads a smaller patch
scenarios.notes: M15 reference guard (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, The reference guard). Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_agreement.py. Real runs: Gothenburg across zones 32 and 33, Tromso, Longyearbyen, Quito, Ushuaia.

scenarios.title: Too few clear dates to outvote one another are taken unchecked; dates that all disagree are disputed
scenarios.asserts: one date -> unchecked, taken, nothing read; two read -> unchecked, the least cloudy readable one taken, offsets of plus and minus half their difference; three read 20 m from each other -> disputed, the least cloudy readable one taken, offsets against all of them; both warn in the job log; a window cached before the guard, or whose stored verdict is not JSON or names no set (true is no index), is measured again and replaced
scenarios.notes: M15 reference guard (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, The reference guard). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_agreement.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py; the import of S-P01-HAPPY records unchecked (its catalogue holds one date).

scenarios.title: A clear date that cannot be read does not vote and is never the reference
scenarios.asserts: a least cloudy item whose address the guard refuses (s3://) -> a warning, no offset, kept false, the job goes on; a set compared with no member has no place; tiles without data, texture or a clear peak measure nothing; a missing file raises for the caller to skip
scenarios.notes: M15 reference guard (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, The reference guard). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_agreement.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_import_job.py. Real case: Gothenburg's least cloudy item S2B_32VPK_20241204 has an s3:// asset; before the guard it would have failed the reference.

scenarios.title: A proved frame is fitted again with the accepted frames it overlaps held still
scenarios.asserts: a proved frame and accepted (approved, publishing, published) proved frames over it that kept align.tif -> its own first fit rendered at 5 m on the city's align grid, each held frame's tiles (900 m, every 450 m) found in it within 150 m, a tie per tile (the held frame's place, our film pixel through our warp's own transform), the frame fitted again on its own tiles and the ties (9 times the weight; its camera, else a polynomial); the held frames' layers are not rendered again; calibration.alignment records every partner (versionId, year, ties, tried, status, offsetM) and the log says how many were held and how many ties; every proved frame's export keeps align.tif (grey, 0 no data, deflated, 5 ground metres)
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_joint.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_ties.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_joint_job.py.

scenarios.title: A frame with Sentinel-2 tiles on part of its film is carried by its ties on the rest
scenarios.asserts: a frame whose own tiles cover half its film and whose ties cover the other half -> held out on that other half the joined map is within 5 m (synthetic), under half the error of the frame alone
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_joint.py.

scenarios.title: A joined polynomial holds to the film's measured box
scenarios.asserts: a frame without a camera joined through a cubic on every tile and tie -> inside the rows' film box the map is the cubic; beyond it, the cubic's value at the box's nearest point plus how the second-order fit of the same rows grows from there; the lattice's model is polynomial
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_joint.py.

scenarios.title: A frame published wrong is left out and named, and pulls nothing
scenarios.asserts: three partners, one 20 m off -> its ties sit about 20 m from the map of the frame and the other two (over 6 m), it is left out (status disagrees, offsetM), the furthest alone first and the rest measured again, so the two good ones stay used and the map holds within 3 m
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_joint.py.

scenarios.title: An overlap too small or too poor to count holds nothing still
scenarios.asserts: under 100 ties, or under a quarter of the tiles tried holding, or a frame of another place (one tile of 16 or none), or ties outside the scan or in a checkpoint cell -> status few, nothing joined, the frame keeps its own fit; a model that cannot fit joins nothing; on the 4 by 3 km test city the frame is fitted alone and the record and the log say few
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_joint.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_ties.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_joint_job.py.

scenarios.title: A frame the admin has not accepted is never held still
scenarios.asserts: an overlapping proved frame still awaiting approval -> no partner, no calibration.alignment, no log line
scenarios.notes: M15 joint solve (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Joint solve). Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_joint_job.py.

scenarios.title: A partner that cannot be read, found, staged or measured is left out: the frame is fitted with the others or alone

scenarios.title: A KH-9 panoramic frame over relief is fitted over the city's surface model and renders through an RPC
scenarios.asserts: a proved KH-9 pan frame whose camera holds, over the city's Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (fetched for the city window from the public tiles, warped to 30 m, averaged over 900 m, read on 300 m cells to the decimetre, cached as reference/{city}/dem/{key}.tif) showing 1 m or more of relief beyond a second-order fit once scaled by what its tiles show -> its tiles and ties fitted on the places its film shows them (height times the camera's view tan, from the nadir), its map back to the ground through the heights, alone or joined; georef.terrain {source glo30, reliefM, rpc, heights} with an RPC00B that holds the map within 0.5 px over the scan and every height, and the cells under its scan; the lattice samples that map on the ground (each node read back through the RPC within a metre); the warp renders through -rpc with RPC_DEM over the record's own heights, no surface fetched (100 m of ground shown 50 m east lands 50 m west of the flat render); the next frame is tied through the same map; the surface cached once; the log says so; the layer's attribution adds the DEM's notice
scenarios.notes: M15 terrain (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Terrain; its review of 2026-11-08). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_terrain.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_georef_rpc.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_terrain_job.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_terrain_readers.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts, functions/test/imagery/finalize.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A flat city, a frame seen near nadir, a frame whose tiles show no parallax, or a frame without a camera is fitted flat, exactly as before
scenarios.asserts: relief under 1 m beyond a second-order fit (a level surface, a gentle rise), or under 1 m once scaled by what the frame's own tiles show (tiles that show none of it), no panoramic camera, or a camera that does not hold -> no georef.terrain, no DEM credit, no RPC render, and the very georeference the frame gets with no surface model; a map no rational cubic holds gives no RPC; a malformed RPC record is refused; the log says the frame was fitted flat and why
scenarios.notes: M15 terrain (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Terrain; its review of 2026-11-08). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_terrain.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_georef_rpc.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_terrain_job.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts, functions/test/imagery/finalize.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Without the whole surface model a frame is fitted flat, with a warning; a malformed terrain record is refused
scenarios.asserts: a GLO-30 tile over the window that cannot be read (never ground at 0 m in its place), no tile at all, a window under 2 x 2 cells, an address the guard refuses (a real one under the emulators, a non-public one) -> no surface, nothing cached, a warning in the job log, the frame fitted flat; heights whose values do not fill their cells, that span more than a uint16 holds, or that are missing, a terrain record of another source or with too few coefficients -> refused by the pipeline and the schema
scenarios.notes: M15 terrain (docs/research/M15-calibration-accuracy.md, Terrain; its review of 2026-11-08). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_georef_rpc.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_terrain_job.py, packages/shared/test/schemas/imagery.test.ts, packages/shared/test/georef/terrain.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A Corona strip is searched where the city lies along it and proved there
scenarios.asserts: a 240 by 17.5 km strip wider at one end, the city 60 % along, its corners 3 km off -> two windows (60 % and, for the film stored reversed, 40 %) of the city plus 15 km either side, a local map linear along the footprint's long edges; the chain proves the frame within 25 m in the window around 60 % (stored reversed: around 40 %), the crop is that window's, and the log names each window and the one kept
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §16. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_strip.py.

scenarios.title: A strip whose footprint misses the city slides windows; no window that reaches it is no city
scenarios.asserts: a footprint 400 km off the city -> 40 km windows, half overlapping, over the whole strip, each moved onto the city, no local AI asked; no window reaches the city -> CityNotFoundError; a frame under 4:1 or a camera with no strip flag is searched whole; no window proved -> the best-voted is kept, the first of equals
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M9-calibration.md §16. Test: pipeline/tests/unit/test_calibrate_strip.py.

scenarios.title: A frame the proof does not hold never publishes itself, however low its figure
scenarios.asserts: calibration how none or matcher, a refusal on it, or no record at all, under any threshold -> the version waits for Approve; the card says nothing proved it. The matcher's checks come from pairs its RANSAC filtered: held-out says little off the proof's path
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §11). Tests: functions/test/imagery/approval-coverage.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/pipeline.spec.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: Hand points wait for a click, whichever of them are disabled
scenarios.asserts: method gcps, three of them disabled after the residuals were read: kind held-out, RMSE 5 m -> the version waits; an upload's points the same
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §11, §13.1). Test: functions/test/imagery/approval-coverage.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A check dropped as gross keeps a frame from publishing itself
scenarios.asserts: checksDropped 1 with a checkpoint figure under the threshold -> the version waits and the card says a check was left out: the figure cannot tell a false match from a wrong part of the map
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §7, §11). Tests: functions/test/imagery/approval-coverage.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts, e2e/admin/specs/imagery/calibration.spec.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame whose tiles span too little of it waits
scenarios.asserts: measuredPct under AUTO_MIN_MEASURED_PCT or missing -> the version waits and the card says the rest is not measured: beyond the tiles a polynomial extrapolates and no check looks
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §11). Tests: functions/test/imagery/approval-coverage.test.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A frame rendered on the whole window is planned by what it shows
scenarios.asserts: a frame fitted by points shows 40 % of the city on a grid the size of its window -> the row reads its output.outline and offers its neighbour; without an outline its box would let one frame stand for the whole city and the plan would stop
scenarios.notes: M9 (docs/research/M9-calibration.md §5). Tests: packages/shared/test/imagery/join.test.ts, functions/test/imagery/join-plan.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Every paid frame of a date has its own Buy this scan
scenarios.asserts: a date with one free and two paid frames -> the row says 2 more would need ordering and lists Buy this scan: F022 and Buy this scan: F023; the second opens its own scene page, where the order card's heading shows
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-12 (only the first paid frame was linked). Test: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/join-dates.spec.ts; packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/join-paid.test.ts.

scenarios.asserts: one of the row's paid frames has an open order -> its line reads Your order: F022 with the Ordered chip, while the other still reads Buy this scan: F023

scenarios.title: A frame the votes miss is proposed by the AI on the graphics card and proved by the same proof
scenarios.asserts: the votes find nothing, a matcher's map arrives -> `how: local-ai`, `calibration.proposer` names the graphics card, the matcher's count stays out of the votes and of every gate; the worker warps the film through each orientation's start at 15 m and asks one at a time through the box; the sidecar's search takes the consensus of tile pairs (fake network of real keypoints); the starter tries --gpus all first, with --network none, --cap-drop ALL and the limits, and never mounts the worker's volume or the Docker socket; files are fetched and hashed only when a frame needs them
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py, test_local_matcher.py, test_matcher_search.py, test_matcher_serve.py, test_matcher_torch.py, test_ai_files.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts. No gate needs a graphics card or weights.

scenarios.title: With no graphics card the processor runs, said in plain words; a silent processor run is impossible
scenarios.asserts: --gpus all and CDI both fail the probe -> the starter says no usable graphics card, using the processor, and runs HCM_AI_DEVICE=cpu with the reason; the proposer records `fallback: no-gpu`; the processor looks at the first two orientations, on the threads but one, niced; HCM_AI_DEVICE=gpu that finds no card exits 77 (76 under 2 GB) and is probed again, and HCM_AI_DEVICE=cpu with no reason is refused
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_serve.py, test_matcher_torch.py, test_local_matcher.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts. PowerShell: starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A computer with no NVIDIA card runs the local AI in the worker's own image, about 1 GB instead of 10, and searches lighter
scenarios.asserts: no nvidia-smi GPU -> the starter starts the worker with HCM_AI_VARIANT=cpu; the worker fetches pins-cpu.json (PyTorch for the processor) into lib-cpu and names the image `worker`; the starter pulls nothing, says so, and runs the sidecar from the worker's image on the processor with lib-cpu; on the processor the search runs at half resolution (553 s a request before, 64 s after, on the NUC)
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M26-governor.md §5 (items h2, i). Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_ai_files.py, test_matcher_search.py, test_matcher_torch.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: Only the worker's own image or PyTorch's by digest is ever run; anything but cpu keeps the card's image
scenarios.asserts: a variant other than exactly cpu keeps pins.json and lib; a /state naming another image is refused; a card that answers nvidia-smi keeps the variant gpu; a wheel keeps only the matcher's packages
scenarios.notes: Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_ai_files.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A small town is proved over a wider reference and cropped to the city
scenarios.asserts: a perfect proposal on a window too small for the proof's 60 tiles is refused there and proved over a Sentinel-2 box of at least the proving side, the gates unchanged; the crop stays the city's; with too few tiles in the crop `georef`'s matcher fits it (`how: matcher`, the proposer kept), and a wider reference that cannot be had costs the proposal, not the job
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_local_ai_job.py. Fitted by the matcher it does not publish itself (approval.ts).

scenarios.title: A wrong proposal is refused whatever the matcher says of it
scenarios.asserts: a map kilometres off with a huge support -> the proof refuses, `how: none`, no proposer recorded; more proposals than proofs stop at the proofs left, and none left means the matcher is not asked; a mirrored reference or an empty film proposes nothing; a film covering under 5 % of the wider box is refused `small`
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py, test_matcher_search.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_local_ai_job.py, packages/ui/test/admin/imagery/calibration-card.test.ts. Real wrong proposals: gate R1, M10.

scenarios.title: A file that does not match its pin never runs
scenarios.asserts: a fetched file with another hash is deleted, fetched once more, then the matcher stands aside with `tampered`; weights are hashed again at load and read with weights_only, and each run hashes the placed ones first, placing them again when altered; refused at load, the panel says `tampered`, not a bad answer, and no further request is asked; only allowed hosts are reached, every redirect hop through the address guard; an archive cannot name where its file lands; `superpoint.py` never leaves the LightGlue tarball; the starter refuses any image but pytorch/pytorch by digest (saying it refused an unexpected program image)
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_ai_files.py, test_matcher_torch.py, test_local_matcher.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A graphics card out of memory reruns that request once on the processor
scenarios.asserts: the child exits 75 -> the request reruns on the processor with a rerun mark, so the worker's wait gets the processor's time, and the proposer records `fallback: out-of-memory`; a second failure answers with a failure, never a failed job
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_serve.py, test_matcher_torch.py, test_local_matcher_waits.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_written_documents.py.

scenarios.title: A sidecar that cannot help ends at the admin's points with a line in the log
scenarios.asserts: an old starter, an arm computer, no sidecar in 30 minutes, a sidecar that stops beating or never answers, a garbage or a pickled answer, of any JSON shape, an unreachable upstream -> no proposal, `how: none`, the delivery kept, the job not failed, the reason on the panel; a cancelled job stops the wait and leaves a cancel file, which kills the child
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher.py, test_local_matcher_waits.py, test_matcher_box.py, test_matcher_serve.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_worker_run.py.

scenarios.title: Cloud Run has no AI, and says so
scenarios.asserts: the same frame in a cloud run -> Null matcher, `how: none`, the log says no local AI in Google Cloud, the delivery is kept and the admin's points are next; only `worker/runtime.py` injects the local matcher
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_local_ai_job.py.

scenarios.title: The sidecar lives only while a frame wants it, beside a loop that keeps reading /state
scenarios.asserts: a frame wants the AI -> the starter probes and starts the sidecar and goes on polling `/state`, one running sidecar left alone; the run ends -> `/state` stops saying `wanted` (the panel still reads the device) and the sidecar is removed, so the next frame probes the card again and gets the image it names, the earlier image removed; SIGTERM ends the sidecar at once, as the container's PID 1
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts, pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py, test_matcher_serve.py

scenarios.title: The Windows starter parses and holds the same loop
scenarios.asserts: every string of the PowerShell part ends where it should, in the file that installs and in the file that removes; the loop looks at its supervisor and a new supervisor stops the loops an earlier one left. Read by a small string reader in the gate (the quality image has no PowerShell), parsed for real with pwsh's parser by hand
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: functions/test/worker/starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: What Windows PowerShell 5.1 does to arguments cannot cost the Windows worker
scenarios.asserts: no call of docker holds an empty argument (5.1 drops it: `probe gpu` would exit 78 and every card read as none) or a quote inside one (5.1 strips it: the refusal would not read as JSON and the worker would wait 30 minutes); a backslash-quote, a parse error of the whole file, is refused by the reader of strings
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: functions/test/worker/starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A fault nobody named goes to the admin's points, never a failed job
scenarios.asserts: a disk that fills while the files are fetched or a request is written, a volume that refuses, a box that cannot be cleared, a warp that raises -> no proposal, `how: none`, the job not failed; a full disk reads `disk` on the panel, anything else `no-answer`, the log has the rest; no `.part` left; a disk too full for the cancel file still stops a cancelled job
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py, test_ai_files.py.

scenarios.title: A request lost costs that request, not the proposals in hand
scenarios.asserts: one request proposes, a later child dies -> the proposal goes to the proof and the remaining starts are asked; a sidecar gone stops the asking and keeps it; with nothing proposed, the loss is the run's reason on the panel
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py.

scenarios.title: An old child's late answer is nobody's
scenarios.asserts: each request's id names its run, so a child a dead worker left cannot answer a new run's request; the sidecar stops a child whose request file is gone, and writes no answer for it
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py, test_matcher_serve.py.

scenarios.title: A hung sidecar costs one frame half an hour, not every frame
scenarios.asserts: a sidecar that does not answer -> `/state` stops saying `wanted`, and the starter removes it; the worker's later runs wait 5 minutes, not 30, until a sidecar beats again; a worker that stops answering loses its sidecar at the second miss; a cancelled or lost run leaves no AI wanted
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An arm computer says so, whatever an emulated image reads
scenarios.asserts: Docker's own architecture reaches the worker (`HCM_DOCKER_ARCH`): arm64 -> `arm64` on the panel from the start, nothing fetched, no wait, though the image reads x86_64 under Rosetta or QEMU
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_local_matcher_faults.py, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A proof over 30 km does not speak for the whole town
scenarios.asserts: a matcher's proposal proved over the wider box, with its agreeing tiles only in a corner of the city's window -> `measuredPct` is measured over the window, under the bar, and the version waits for a click; a town covered across reads over the bar; the gates are the same, none softened
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py.

scenarios.title: The admin is not shown figures of another map

scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_local_ai_job.py.

scenarios.title: A frame the AI is not offered says why
scenarios.asserts: the votes spent every proof -> the matcher is not asked, by the design, and the job's log says so; a cloud run says it has no local AI there too
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_matcher_chain.py.

scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. scenarios.title: The panel says why the local AI is unavailable
scenarios.asserts: each reason (a new starter needed, arm, disk, pull, tampered, unreachable, no answer, garbage) -> Local AI unavailable and the reason in the page's language; a worker older than the AI, or not connected, says nothing of it; the starter tells the worker through the box when the disk is short or the pull fails
scenarios.notes: docs/research/M10-local-ai.md. Tests: e2e/admin/specs/imagery/worker.spec.ts, packages/ui/test/admin/worker/worker.test.ts, packages/admin/test/worker/feed.test.ts, packages/shared/test/api/worker.test.ts, functions/test/worker/starter-sidecar.test.ts.
