scenarios.title: GDAL's cache and a warp's memory follow the machine
scenarios.asserts: a process that may use 4 GB -> a 256 MB cache and a 512 MB warp; 16 GB or more, or unknown -> the 1024 and 2048 MB of before; the container's limit and the free memory are read, HCM_GDAL_CACHE_MB and HCM_WARP_MEMORY_MB win
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: No limit, a busy machine, an unreadable one or a bad override still give usable settings
scenarios.asserts: no cgroup file and no /proc/meminfo -> the large machine's settings; a limit of max -> the free memory decides; an override that is no positive number is not taken
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: A warp and an export on a 4 GB machine stay within their memory budget
scenarios.asserts: a 20,000 by 5,000 scan warped (thin plate) and exported as a COG in a process of its own with a 4 GB machine's settings -> its peak memory stays under the budget measured between the old and the new settings
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: An atlas's canvas is composed part by part within its budget, pixel for pixel as before
scenarios.asserts: 36 colour sheets composed in a process of its own -> peak memory and CPU under the budget; the canvas equals the one composed on whole canvases (an atlas exactly, turned overlapping parts within two grey levels at under 1 % of the pixels)
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: A part off the canvas or over its edge leaves the rest as it was
scenarios.asserts: a part placed wholly outside the canvas is skipped and one over the edge is cut at it -> the same canvas as before, the other parts untouched
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: Two large colour sheets are laid out and mosaicked within 800 MB whatever GDAL's thread count
scenarios.asserts: two 12,000 px colour sheets laid out and mosaicked in a child process started as python -m hcm_pipeline starts (at most two malloc arenas) -> peak resident memory under 800 MB on one thread and on every core (ALL_CPUS); the C heap's free pages are given back before the first sheet and after each one; the pixels are the same on any thread count
scenarios.notes: 2026-11-13, the NUC: one thread 636 MB, every core 870 MB before (the threads' malloc arenas kept the layout's reads); 588 / 653 MB on 1 / 16 threads after (tcmalloc, the worker image: 650 to 690 MB either way), no slower. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_placing_canvas_window.py, test_heap.py.

scenarios.title: Where the C library is not glibc, or there is nothing to give back, the heap calls do nothing and nothing fails
scenarios.asserts: no libc.so.6, or one without mallopt and malloc_trim -> limit_arenas and give_back answer False and the step goes on; malloc_trim returning 0 (nothing to return) is not an error
scenarios.notes: Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_heap.py.

scenarios.title: The tiles are cut by the cores but one, at most what a quarter of the memory holds
scenarios.asserts: 16 cores and 31 GB -> 15 processes; 16 cores and 4 GB -> 4; GDAL_NUM_THREADS as a number is a ceiling, never a floor
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: A city crop and an upload's preview never hold the raster whole
scenarios.asserts: DS1103-1058DF027's 35,664 by 8,172 crop copied out of two segments 1,024 rows at a time and previewed by a shrunk read, and the preview of a 20,000 px colour upload, each in a process of its own -> peak memory under the budget
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: A small or grey scan's preview is the scan itself
scenarios.asserts: a scan under the preview's size is not enlarged and a grey one stays grey; a colour scan wider than the preview is averaged down band by band
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: A one-core or nearly memoryless machine still cuts its tiles with one process
scenarios.asserts: 1 core, an unknown core count or 100 MB of memory -> one process, never none
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_gdal_memory.py, test_compose_canvas.py, pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py.

scenarios.title: The worker is capped in memory, light on the processor and leaves a core free
scenarios.asserts: the starter's worker container gets --memory and --memory-swap at 60 % of what Docker has and --cpu-shares 256 (POSIX run over stand-ins, the Windows text); the worker process is niced by 10 and GDAL takes the cores but one
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_worker_loop.py, test_worker_app.py, functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts, claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: The owner's own limits win
scenarios.asserts: HCM_WORKER_MEMORY (a size, or none for no limit), HCM_WORKER_THREADS and HCM_WORKER_NICE (0: not niced; not a number: 10) are taken as given; GDAL_NUM_THREADS in the environment stays the worker's thread count
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_worker_loop.py, test_worker_app.py, functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts, claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: An idle worker asks for a job less and less often, and often again after a job or the admin's look
scenarios.asserts: ten minutes after its start, its last job or the admin's last GET /state the waits grow from pollSeconds up to idlePollSeconds (60 s, so a new job starts within a minute) with a tenth of jitter; a job that ran or the admin's page looking ends a long wait; the worker still counts as connected (WORKER_FRESH_SECONDS covers the longest wait)
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_worker_loop.py, test_worker_app.py, functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts, claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A server that names no idle interval is asked as before
scenarios.asserts: worker.hello without idlePollSeconds (a server older than the image) -> a claim every pollSeconds, so its three-minute presence still holds; a longest wait under the poll changes nothing
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_worker_loop.py, test_worker_app.py, functions/test/worker/starter.test.ts, starter-windows.test.ts, claim.test.ts.

scenarios.title: A hot or busy computer leaves a queued job to a cooler or idler worker of the same city
scenarios.asserts: every wait before a claim is stretched by 1 + 3 x (1 - headroom): headroom 1 with room, the heat's share from 80 to 95 C and other programs' load lower it, 0 while paused; with room the worker asks every pollSeconds (30 s), half the room 75 s, none 120 s (240 s when idle), so the cooler worker asks first; a lone worker still takes the job
scenarios.notes: The owner, 2026-11-13: three workers (laptop, NUC, PC); the laptop held jobs paused for heat. Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_governor_loop.py.

scenarios.title: A headroom out of range neither speeds a claim past the poll nor stretches it past four polls
scenarios.asserts: a headroom over 1 -> the plain poll; under 0 -> four polls; before the governor's first tick the headroom is 1
scenarios.notes: Tests: pipeline/tests/unit/test_worker_pace.py, test_governor_loop.py.

scenarios.title: An atlas holds its pages grey and reads each in colour only to paste it
scenarios.asserts: 36 colour sheets on disk composed as placing/maps.py does, in a process of its own -> peak memory under the budget; the canvas equals the one made of pages held in colour, a framed page cut the same way; the canvas is written once and published as the stitched picture
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_compose_canvas.py.

scenarios.title: A 4 GB computer's worker assembles a 60-sheet colour atlas and crops a Corona strip
scenarios.asserts: 60 colour sheets of 2,222 px and a 35,664 by 8,172 city crop, each in a process of its own -> peak memory under 60 % of 4 GB, the worker's cap there
scenarios.notes: reports/resource-audit.md (2026-11-12, track/stripfix); docs/research/M7-local-worker.md, Addendum of 2026-11-12. Tests: pipeline/tests/integration/test_memory_budgets.py, pipeline/tests/unit/test_compose_canvas.py.
